1233.e: Subduing my mind, I have realized the pure status; I am totally imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord.

1233.g: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੬॥
1233.t: ekas bin mai avar na jaanaa(n) satigur boojh bujhaiee ||6||
1233.e: I do not know any other except the Lord. The True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||6||

1233.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
1233.t: agam agochar anaath ajonee gurmat eko jaaniaa ||
1233.e: God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable, Unmastered and Unborn; through the Guru's Teachings, I know the One Lord.

1233.g: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਡੋਲੈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੭॥
1233.t: subhar bhare naahee chit ddolai man hee te man maaniaa ||7||
1233.e: Filled to overflowing, my consciousness does not waver; through the Mind, my mind is pleased and appeased. ||7||

1233.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਕਥਉ ਕਥੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
1233.t: gur parasaadhee akathau katheeaai kahau kahaavai soiee ||
1233.e: By Guru's Grace, I speak the Unspoken; I speak what He makes me speak.

1233.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੨॥
1233.t: naanak dheen dhiaal hamaare avar na jaaniaa koiee ||8||2||
1233.e: O Nanak, my Lord is Merciful to the meek; I do not know any other at all. ||8||2||

1233.g: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧
1233.t: saarag mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa ghar pehilaa
1233.e: Saarang, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

1233.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1233.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1233.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1233.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
1233.t: man mere har kai naam vaddaiee ||
1233.e: O my mind, the Name of the Lord is glorious and great.

1233.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1233.t: har bin avar na jaanaa koiee har kai naam mukat gat paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1233.e: I know of none, other than the Lord; through the Lord's Name, I have attained liberation and emancipation. ||1||Pause||

1233.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਜਮਕਾਲ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
1233.t: sabadh bhau bha(n)jan jamakaal nikha(n)jan har setee liv laiee ||
1233.e: Through the Word of the Shabad, I am lovingly attuned to the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, the Destroyer of the Messenger of Death.

1233.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
1233.t: har sukhadhaataa gurmukh jaataa sahaje rahiaa samaiee ||1||
1233.e: As Gurmukh, I have realized the Lord, the Giver of peace; I remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||1||

1233.g: ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪੈਨੑਣੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
1233.t: bhagataa(n) kaa bhojan har naam nira(n)jan pain(h)n bhagat baddaiee ||
1233.e: The Immaculate Name of the Lord is the food of His devotees; they wear the glory of devotional worship.

1233.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
1233.t: nij ghar vaasaa sadhaa har sevan har dhar sobhaa paiee ||2||
1233.e: They abide in the home of their inner beings, and they serve the Lord forever; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

1233.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਾਚੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਕਥੈ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
1233.t: manmukh budh kaachee manooaa ddolai akath na kathai kahaanee ||
1233.e: The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is false; his mind wavers and wobbles, and he cannot speak the Unspoken Speech.

1233.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
1233.t: gurmat nihachal har man vasiaa a(n)mirat saachee baanee ||3||
1233.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Eternal Unchanging Lord abides within the mind; the True Word of His Bani is Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

1233.g: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
1233.t: man ke tara(n)g sabadh nivaare rasanaa sahaj subhaiee ||
1233.e: The Shabad calms the turbulent waves of the mind; the tongue is intuively imbued with peace.

1233.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਸਦ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
1233.t: satigur mil raheeaai sadh apune jin har setee liv laiee ||4||
1233.e: So remain united forever with your True Guru, who is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||4||

1233.g: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
1233.t: man sabadh marai taa mukato hovai har charanee chit laiee ||
1233.e: If the mortal dies in the Shabad, then he is liberated; he focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

1233.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
1233.t: har sar saagar sadhaa jal niramal naavai sahaj subhaiee ||5||
1233.e: The Lord is an Ocean; His Water is Forever Pure. Whoever bathes in it is intuitively imbued with peace. ||5||

1233.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
1233.t: sabadh veechaar sadhaa ra(n)g raate haumai tirasanaa maaree ||
1233.e: Those who contemplate the Shabad are forever imbued with His Love; their egotism and desires are subdued.

1233.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
1233.t: a(n)tar nihakeval har raviaa sabh aatam raam muraaree ||6||
1233.e: The Pure, Unattached Lord permeates their inner beings; the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is pervading all. ||6||

1233.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
1233.t: sevak sev rahe sach raate jo terai man bhaane ||
1233.e: Your humble servants serve You, O Lord; those who are imbued with the Truth are pleasing to Your Mind.

1233.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਗਿ ਝੂਠੀ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥੭॥
1233.t: dhubidhaa mahal na paavai jag jhooThee gun avagan na pachhaane ||7||
1233.e: Those who are involved in duality do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; caught in the false nature of the world, they do not discriminate between merits and demerits. ||7||

1233.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1233.t: aape mel le akath katheeaai sach sabadh sach baanee ||
1233.e: When the Lord merges us into Himself, we speak the Unspoken Speech; True is the Shabad, and True is the Word of His Bani.

1233.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
1233.t: naanak saache sach samaane har kaa naam vakhaanee ||8||1||
1233.e: O Nanak, the true people are absorbed in the Truth; they chant the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||

1233.g: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1233.t: saarag mahalaa teejaa ||
1233.e: Saarang, Third Mehla:

1233.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
1233.t: man mere har kaa naam at meeThaa ||
1233.e: O my mind, the Name of the Lord is supremely sweet.

1234.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1234.t: janam janam ke kilavikh bhau bha(n)jan gurmukh eko ddeeThaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1234.e: It is the Destroyer of the sins, the guilt and fears of countless incarnations; the Gurmukh sees the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

1234.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1234.t: koT koTa(n)tar ke paap binaasan har saachaa man bhaiaa ||
1234.e: Millions upon millions of sins are erased, when the mind comes to love the True Lord.

1234.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1234.t: har bin avar na soojhai dhoojaa satigur ek bujhaiaa ||1||
1234.e: I do not know any other, except the Lord; the True Guru has revealed the One Lord to me. ||1||

1234.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜਿਨ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
1234.t: prem padhaarath jin ghaT vasiaa sahaje rahe samaiee ||
1234.e: Those whose hearts are filled with the wealth of the Lord's Love, remain intuitively absorbed in Him.

1234.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੇ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥
1234.t: sabadh rate se ra(n)g chaloole raate sahaj subhaiee ||2||
1234.e: Imbued with the Shabad, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love. They are imbued with the Lord's celestial peace and poise. ||2||

1234.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਲਾਲ ਭਈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
1234.t: rasanaa sabadh veechaar ras raatee laal bhiee ra(n)g laiee ||
1234.e: Contemplating the Shabad, the tongue is imbued with joy; embracing His Love, it is dyed a deep crimson.

1234.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿਆ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
1234.t: raam naam nihakeval jaaniaa man tirapatiaa saa(n)t aaiee ||3||
1234.e: I have come to know the Name of the Pure Detached Lord; my mind is satisfied and comforted. ||3||

1234.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਿੑ ਪੜਿੑ ਮੋਨੀ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
1234.t: pa(n)ddit paRi(h) paRi(h) monee sabh thaake bhram bhekh thake bhekhadhaaree ||
1234.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and study, and all the silent sages have grown weary; they have grown weary of wearing their religious robes and wandering all around.

1234.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
1234.t: gur parasaadh nira(n)jan paiaa saachai sabadh veechaaree ||4||
1234.e: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Immaculate Lord; I contemplate the True Word of the Shabad. ||4||

1234.g: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1234.t: aavaa gaun nivaar sach raate saach sabadh man bhaiaa ||
1234.e: My coming and going in reincarnation is ended, and I am imbued with Truth; the True Word of the Shabad is pleasing to my mind.

1234.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
1234.t: satigur sev sadhaa sukh paieeaai jin vichahu aap gavaiaa ||5||
1234.e: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is found, and self-conceit is eliminated from within. ||5||

1234.g: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
1234.t: saachai sabadh sahaj dhun upajai man saachai liv laiee ||
1234.e: Through the True Word of the Shabad, the celestial melody wells up, and the mind is lovingly focused on the True Lord.

1234.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੬॥
1234.t: agam agochar naam nira(n)jan gurmukh ma(n)n vasaiee ||6||
1234.e: The Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord, abides in the mind of the Gurmukh. ||6||

1234.g: ਏਕਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
1234.t: ekas meh sabh jagato varatai viralaa ek pachhaanai ||
1234.e: The whole world is contained in the One Lord. How rare are those who understand the One Lord.

1234.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੭॥
1234.t: sabadh marai taa sabh kichh soojhai anadhin eko jaanai ||7||
1234.e: One who dies in the Shabad comes to know everything; night and day, he realizes the One Lord. ||7||

1234.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1234.t: jis no nadhar kare soiee jan boojhai hor kahanaa kathan na jaiee ||
1234.e: That humble being, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, understands. Nothing else can be said.

1234.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥੨॥
1234.t: naanak naam rate sadhaa bairaagee ek sabadh liv laiee ||8||2||
1234.e: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are forever detached from the world; they are lovingly attuned to the One Word of the Shabad. ||8||2||

1234.g: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1234.t: saarag mahalaa teejaa ||
1234.e: Saarang, Third Mehla:

1234.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
1234.t: man mere har kee akath kahaanee ||
1234.e: O my mind, the Speech of the Lord is unspoken.

1234.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1234.t: har nadhar kare soiee jan paae gurmukh viralai jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
1234.e: That humble being who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, obtains it. How rare is that Gurmukh who understands. ||1||Pause||

1234.g: ਹਰਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
1234.t: har gahir ga(n)bheer gunee gaheer gur kai sabadh pachhaaniaa ||
1234.e: The Lord is Deep, Profound and Unfathomable, the Ocean of Excellence; He is realized through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1234.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਬਉਰਾਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
1234.t: bahu bidh karam kareh bhai dhoojai bin sabadhai bauraaniaa ||1||
1234.e: Mortals do their deeds in all sorts of ways, in the love of duality; but without the Shabad, they are insane. ||1||

1234.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੈਲਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1234.t: har naam naavai soiee jan niramal fir mailaa mool na hoiee ||
1234.e: That humble being who bathes in the Lord's Name becomes immaculate; he never becomes polluted again.

1234.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਮੈਲਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੨॥
1234.t: naam binaa sabh jag hai mailaa dhoojai bharam pat khoiee ||2||
1234.e: Without the Name, the whole world is polluted; wandering in duality, it loses its honor. ||2||

1234.g: ਕਿਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਂ ਕਿਆ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਮੈ ਤਾ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
1234.t: kiaa dhiraRaa(n) kiaa sa(n)greh tiaagee mai taa boojh na paiee ||
1234.e: What should I grasp? What should I gather up or leave behind? I do not know.

1234.g: ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੋ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
1234.t: hoh dhiaal kirapaa kar har jeeau naamo hoi sakhaiee ||3||
1234.e: O Dear Lord, Your Name is the Help and Support of those whom You bless with Your kindness and compassion. ||3||

1234.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਏ ॥
1234.t: sachaa sach dhaataa karam bidhaataa jis bhaavai tis nai laae ||
1234.e: The True Lord is the True Giver, the Architect of Destiny; as He pleases, He links mortals to the Name.

1234.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥
1234.t: guroo dhuaarai soiee boojhai jis no aap bujhaae ||4||
1234.e: He alone comes to understand, who enters the Guru's Gate, whom the Lord Himself instructs. ||4||

1234.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤੇ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
1234.t: dhekh bisamaadh ih man nahee chete aavaa gaun sa(n)saaraa ||
1234.e: Even gazing upon the wonders of the Lord, this mind does not think of Him. The world comes and goes in reincarnation.

1234.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੫॥
1234.t: satigur seve soiee boojhai paae mokh dhuaaraa ||5||
1234.e: Serving the True Guru, the mortal comes to understand, and finds the Door of Salvation. ||5||

1234.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਦਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਸੇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਗਾੜਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
1234.t: jin(h) dhar soojhai se kadhe na vigaaReh satigur boojh bujhaiee ||
1234.e: Those who understand the Lord's Court, never suffer separation from him. The True Guru has imparted this understanding.

1234.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
1234.t: sach sa(n)jam karanee kirat kamaaveh aavan jaan rahaiee ||6||
1234.e: They practice truth, self-restraint and good deeds; their comings and goings are ended. ||6||

1234.g: ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥
1234.t: se dhar saachai saach kamaaveh jin gurmukh saach adhaaraa ||
1234.e: In the Court of the True Lord, they practice Truth. The Gurmukhs take the Support of the True Lord.

1235.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
1235.t: manmukh dhoojai bharam bhulaae naa boojheh veechaaraa ||7||
1235.e: The self-willed manmukhs wander, lost in doubt and duality. They do not know how to contemplate the Lord. ||7||

1235.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
1235.t: aape gurmukh aape dhevai aape kar kar vekhai ||
1235.e: He Himself is the Gurmukh, and He Himself gives; He Himself creates and beholds.

1235.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
1235.t: naanak se jan thai pe hai jin kee pat paavai lekhai ||8||3||
1235.e: O Nanak, those humble beings are approved, whose honor the Lord Himself accepts. ||8||3||

1235.g: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧
1235.t: saarag mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadheeaa ghar pehilaa
1235.e: Saarang, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

1235.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1235.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1235.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1235.g: ਗੁਸਾੲਂੀ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
1235.t: gusaae(n)ee parataap tuhaaro ddeeThaa ||
1235.e: O Lord of the World, I gaze upon Your wondrous glory.

1235.g: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਬੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1235.t: karan karaavan upai samaavan sagal chhatrapat beeThaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1235.e: You are the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Creator and Destroyer. You are the Sovereign Lord of all. ||1||Pause||

1235.g: ਰਾਣਾ ਰਾਉ ਰਾਜ ਭਏ ਰੰਕਾ ਉਨਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥
1235.t: raanaa raau raaj bhe ra(n)kaa un jhooThe kahan kahaio ||
1235.e: The rulers and nobles and kings shall become beggars. Their ostentatious shows are false

1235.g: ਹਮਰਾ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
1235.t: hamaraa raajan sadhaa salaamat taa ko sagal ghaTaa jas gaio ||1||
1235.e: . My Sovereign Lord King is eternally stable. His Praises are sung in every heart. ||1||

1235.g: ਉਪਮਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਕਹਤ ਜੇਤ ਪਾਹੂਚਾ ॥
1235.t: aupamaa sunahu raajan kee sa(n)tahu kahat jet paahoochaa ||
1235.e: Listen to the Praises of my Lord King, O Saints. I chant them as best I can.

1235.g: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ਊਚੇ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥੨॥
1235.t: besumaar vadd saeh dhaataaraa uooche hee te uoochaa ||2||
1235.e: My Lord King, the Great Giver, is Immeasurable. He is the Highest of the high. ||2||

1235.g: ਪਵਨਿ ਪਰੋਇਓ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਰਾ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾਸਟ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
1235.t: pavan paroio sagal akaaraa paavak kaasaT sa(n)ge ||
1235.e: He has strung His Breath throughout the creation; He locked the fire in the wood.

1235.g: ਨੀਰੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਏਕਤ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
1235.t: neer dharan kar raakhe ekat koi na kis hee sa(n)ge ||3||
1235.e: He placed the water and the land together, but neither blends with the other. ||3||

1235.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਥਾ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
1235.t: ghaT ghaT kathaa raajan kee chaalai ghar ghar tujheh umaahaa ||
1235.e: In each and every heart, the Story of our Sovereign Lord is told; in each and every home, they yearn for Him.

1235.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਥਮੇ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥
1235.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh paachhai kariaa prathame rijak samaahaa ||4||
1235.e: Afterwards, He created all beings and creatures; but first, He provided them with sustenance. ||4||

1235.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣਾ ਮਸਲਤਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਨੑੀ ॥
1235.t: jo kichh karanaa su aape karanaa masalat kaahoo dheen(h)ee ||
1235.e: Whatever He does, He does by Himself. Who has ever given Him advice?

1235.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਹ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਚੀਨੑੀ ॥੫॥
1235.t: anik jatan kar kareh dhikhaae saachee saakhee cheen(h)ee ||5||
1235.e: The mortals make all sorts of efforts and showy displays, but He is realized only through the Teachings of Truth. ||5||

1235.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਅਪਨੇ ਦੀਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
1235.t: har bhagataa kar raakhe apane dheenee naam vaddaiee ||
1235.e: The Lord protects and saves His devotees; He blesses them with the glory of His Name.

1235.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰੀ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਤੇ ਤੈਂ ਦੀਏ ਰੁੜੑਾਈ ॥੬॥
1235.t: jin jin karee avagiaa jan kee te tai(n) dhe'ee ruR(h)aiee ||6||
1235.e: Whoever is disrespectful to the humble servant of the Lord, shall be swept away and destroyed. ||6||

1235.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਅਵਗਨ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ॥
1235.t: mukat bhe saadhasa(n)gat kar tin ke avagan sabh parahariaa ||
1235.e: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are liberated; all their demerits are taken away.

1235.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
1235.t: tin kau dhekh bhe kirapaalaa tin bhav saagar tariaa ||7||
1235.e: Seeing them, God becomes merciful; they are carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||7||

1235.g: ਹਮ ਨਾਨੑੇ ਨੀਚ ਤੁਮੇੑ ਬਡ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1235.t: ham naan(h)e neech tume(h) badd saahib kudharat kaun beechaaraa ||
1235.e: I am lowly, I am nothing at all; You are my Great Lord and Master - how can I even contemplate Your creative potency?

1235.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥
1235.t: man tan seetal gur dharas dhekhe naanak naam adhaaraa ||8||1||
1235.e: My mind and body are cooled and soothed, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Nanak takes the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||

1235.g: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੬
1235.t: saarag mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadhee ghar chhayvaa
1235.e: Saarang, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Sixth House:

1235.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1235.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1235.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1235.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਕਥਾ ॥
1235.t: agam agaadh sunahu jan kathaa ||
1235.e: Listen to the Story of the Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

1235.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਸਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1235.t: paarabraham kee acharaj sabhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1235.e: The glory of the Supreme Lord God is wondrous and amazing! ||1||Pause||

1235.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
1235.t: sadhaa sadhaa satigur namasakaar ||
1235.e: Forever and ever, humbly bow to the True Guru.

1235.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
1235.t: gur kirapaa te gun gai apaar ||
1235.e: By Guru's Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Infinite Lord.

1235.g: ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
1235.t: man bheetar hovai paragaas ||
1235.e: His Light shall radiate deep within your mind.

1235.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
1235.t: giaan a(n)jan agiaan binaas ||1||
1235.e: With the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom, ignorance is dispelled. ||1||

1235.g: ਮਿਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
1235.t: mit naahee jaa kaa bisathaar ||
1235.e: There is no limit to His Expanse.

1235.g: ਸੋਭਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
1235.t: sobhaa taa kee apar apaar ||
1235.e: His Glory is Infinite and Endless.

1235.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
1235.t: anik ra(n)g jaa ke gane na jaeh ||
1235.e: His many plays cannot be counted.

1235.g: ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਦੁਹਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
1235.t: sog harakh dhuhahoo meh naeh ||2||
1235.e: He is not subject to pleasure or pain. ||2||

1235.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਬੇਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਰਹਿ ॥
1235.t: anik brahame jaa ke bedh dhun kareh ||
1235.e: Many Brahmas vibrate Him in the Vedas.

1235.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਹੇਸ ਬੈਸਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
1235.t: anik mahes bais dhiaan dhareh ||
1235.e: Many Shivas sit in deep meditation.

1236.e: Many beings take incarnation.
Many Indras stand at the Lord's Door. ||3||
Many winds, fires and waters.
Many jewels, and oceans of butter and milk.
Many suns, moons and stars.
Many gods and goddesses of so many kinds. ||4||
Many earths, many wish-fulfilling cows.
Many miraculous Elysian trees, many Krishnas playing the flute.
Many Akaashic ethers, many nether regions of the underworld.
Many mouths chant and meditate on the Lord. ||5||
Many Shaastras, Simritees and Puraanas.
Many ways in which we speak.
Many listeners listen to the Lord of Treasure.
The Lord God totally permeates all beings. ||6||
Many righteous judges of Dharma, many gods of wealth.
Many gods of water, many mountains of gold.
Many thousand-headed snakes, chanting ever-new Names of God.
They do not know the limits of the Supreme Lord God. ||7||
Many solar systems, many galaxies.
Many forms, colors and celestial realms.
Many gardens, many fruits and roots.
He Himself is mind, and He Himself is matter. ||8||
Many ages, days and nights.
Many apocalypses, many creations.

1236.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1236.t: anik jeea jaa ke gireh maeh ||
1236.e: Many beings are in His home.
The Lord is perfectly pervading all places. ||9||

1236.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1236.t: anik maiaa jaa kee lakhee na jai ||
1236.e: Many Mayas, which cannot be known.
Many are the ways in which our Sovereign Lord plays.
Many exquisite melodies sing of the Lord.
Many recording scribes of the conscious and subconscious are revealed there. ||10||

1236.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
1236.t: sabh te uooch bhagat jaa kai sa(n)g ||
1236.e: He is above all, and yet He dwells with His devotees.
Twenty-four hours a day, they sing His Praises with love.
Many unstruck melodies resound and resonate with bliss.

1236.g: ਉਆ ਰਸ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥੧੧॥
1236.t: auaa ras kaa kachh a(n)t na paar ||11||
1236.e: There is no end or limit of that sublime essence. ||11||
True is the Primal Being, and True is His dwelling.
He is the Highest of the high, Immaculate and Detached, in Nirvaanaa.
He alone knows His handiwork.
He Himself pervades each and every heart.
The Merciful Lord is the Treasure of Compassion, O Nanak.

1236.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧੨॥੧॥੨॥੨॥੩॥੭॥
1236.t: jin japiaa naanak te bhe nihaal ||12||1||2||2||3||7||
1236.e: Those who chant and meditate on Him, O Nanak, are exalted and enraptured. ||12||1||2||2||3||7||
Saarang, Chhant, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
See the Giver of fearlessness in all.
The Detached Lord is totally permeating each and every heart.

1236.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨੁ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਰਚਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
1236.t: ghaT ghaT pooran kar bisatheeran jal tara(n)g jiau rachan keeaa ||
1236.e: Like waves in the water, He created the creation.

1236.g: ਹਭਿ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ ਭੋਗ ਘਟਾਣੇ ਆਨ ਨ ਬੀਆ ਕੋ ਥੀਆ ॥
1236.t: habh ras maane bhog ghaTaane aan na beeaa ko theeaa ||
1236.e: He enjoys all tastes, and takes pleasure in all hearts. There is no other like Him at all.

1236.g: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
1236.t: har ra(n)gee ik ra(n)gee Thaakur sa(n)tasa(n)g prabh jaataa ||
1236.e: The color of the Lord's Love is the one color of our Lord and Master; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, God is realized.

1236.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨਾ ਸਭ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਅਨਭੈ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
1236.t: naanak dharas leenaa jiau jal meenaa sabh dhekheeaai anabhai kaa dhaataa ||1||
1236.e: O Nanak, I am drenched with the Blessed Vision of the Lord, like the fish in the water. I see the Giver of fearlessness in all. ||1||
What praises should I give, and what approval should I offer to Him?
The Perfect Lord is totally pervading and permeating all places.

1236.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਸੋਹਨ ਜਬ ਖਿੰਚੈ ਤਬ ਛਾਈ ॥
1236.t: pooran manmohan ghaT ghaT sohan jab khi(n)chai tab chhaiee ||
1236.e: The Perfect Enticing Lord adorns each and every heart. When He withdraws, the mortal turns to dust.

1237.g: ਕਿਉ ਨ ਅਰਾਧਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਹੁ ਘਰੀ ਮੁਹਤਕ ਬੇਲਾ ਆਈ ॥
1237.t: kiau na araadhahu mil kar saadhahu gharee muhatak belaa aaiee ||
1237.e: Why do you not worship and adore Him? Join together with the Holy Saints; any instant, your time shall come.

1237.g: ਅਰਥੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਸਭੁ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਛਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥
1237.t: arath dharab sabh jo kichh dheesai sa(n)g na kachhahoo jaiee ||
1237.e: All your property and wealth, and all that you see - none of it will go along with you.

1237.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੨॥
1237.t: kahu naanak har har aaraadhahu kavan upamaa dheau kavan baddaiee ||2||
1237.e: Says Nanak, worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har. What praise, and what approval, can I offer to Him? ||2||

1237.g: ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
1237.t: poochhau sa(n)t mero Thaakur kaisaa ||
1237.e: I ask the Saints, what is my Lord and Master like?

1237.g: ਹਂੀਉ ਅਰਾਪਉਂ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਦੇਸਾ ॥
1237.t: ha(n)eeau araapau(n) dheh sadhesaa ||
1237.e: I offer my heart, to one who brings me news of Him.

1237.g: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਦੇਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਕਹ ਮੋਹਨ ਪਰਵੇਸਾ ॥
1237.t: dheh sadhesaa prabh jeeau kaisaa keh mohan paravesaa ||
1237.e: Give me news of my Dear God; where does the Enticer live?

1237.g: ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਈ ਥਾਨ ਥਾਨੰਤਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
1237.t: a(n)g a(n)g sukhadhaiee pooran brahamaiee thaan thaana(n)tar dhesaa ||
1237.e: He is the Giver of peace to life and limb; God is totally permeating all places, interspaces and countries.

1237.g: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜੈਸਾ ॥
1237.t: ba(n)dhan te mukataa ghaT ghaT jugataa keh na sakau har jaisaa ||
1237.e: He is liberated from bondage, joined to each and every heart. I cannot say what the Lord is like.

1237.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਚਰਿਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਪੂਛੈ ਦੀਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥੩॥
1237.t: dhekh charit naanak man mohio poochhai dheen mero Thaakur kaisaa ||3||
1237.e: Gazing upon His wondrous play, O Nanak, my mind is fascinated. I humbly ask, what is my Lord and Master like? ||3||

1237.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
1237.t: kar kirapaa apune peh aaiaa ||
1237.e: In His Kindness, He has come to His humble servant.

1237.g: ਧੰਨਿ ਸੁ ਰਿਦਾ ਜਿਹ ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਇਆ ॥
1237.t: dha(n)n su ridhaa jeh charan basaiaa ||
1237.e: Blessed is that heart, in which the Lord's Feet are enshrined.

1237.g: ਚਰਨ ਬਸਾਇਆ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
1237.t: charan basaiaa sa(n)t sa(n)gaiaa agiaan a(n)dher gavaiaa ||
1237.e: His Feet are enshrined within, in the Society of the Saints; the darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

1237.g: ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਲਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੋੜੀਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1237.t: bhiaa pragaas ridhai ulaas prabh loReedhaa paiaa ||
1237.e: The heart is enlightened and illumined and enraptured; God has been found.

1237.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵੂਠਾ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਸਹਜਾਇਆ ॥
1237.t: dhukh naaThaa sukh ghar meh vooThaa mahaa ana(n)dh sahajaiaa ||
1237.e: Pain is gone, and peace has come to my house. The ultimate intuitive peace prevails.

1237.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
1237.t: kahu naanak mai pooraa paiaa kar kirapaa apune peh aaiaa ||4||1||
1237.e: Says Nanak, I have found the Perfect Lord; in His Kindness, He has come to His humble servant. ||4||1||

1237.g: ਸਾਰੰਗ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਰਾਇ ਮਹਮੇ ਹਸਨੇ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ
1237.t: saara(n)g kee vaar mahalaa chauthhaa rai mahame hasane kee dhun
1237.e: Vaar Of Saarang, Fourth Mehla, To Be Sung To The Tune Of Mehma-Hasna:

1237.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1237.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1237.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1237.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
1237.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
1237.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

1237.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਪਾਹੂ ਨਿਵਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਕੋਠਾ ਤਨੁ ਛਤਿ ॥
1237.t: gur ku(n)jee paahoo nival man koThaa tan chhat ||
1237.e: The key of the Guru opens the lock of attachment, in the house of the mind, under the roof of the body.

1237.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਤਾਕੁ ਨ ਉਘੜੈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਹਥਿ ॥੧॥
1237.t: naanak gur bin man kaa taak na ughaRai avar na ku(n)jee hath ||1||
1237.e: O Nanak, without the Guru, the door of the mind cannot be opened. No one else holds the key in hand. ||1||

1237.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1237.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1237.e: First Mehla:

1237.g: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਰਾਗੀ ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦਿ ॥
1237.t: n bheejai raagee naadhee bedh ||
1237.e: He is not won over by music, songs or the Vedas.

1237.g: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੋਗਿ ॥
1237.t: n bheejai suratee giaanee jog ||
1237.e: He is not won over by intuitive wisdom, meditation or Yoga.

1237.g: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੋਗੀ ਕੀਤੈ ਰੋਜਿ ॥
1237.t: n bheejai sogee keetai roj ||
1237.e: He is not won over by feeling sad and depressed forever.

1237.g: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਰੂਪਂੀ ਮਾਲਂੀ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
1237.t: n bheejai roopa(n)ee maala(n)ee ra(n)g ||
1237.e: He is not won over by beauty, wealth and pleasures.

1237.g: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਵਿਐ ਨੰਗਿ ॥
1237.t: n bheejai teerath bhaviaai na(n)g ||
1237.e: He is not won over by wandering naked at sacred shrines.

1237.g: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਦਾਤਂੀ ਕੀਤੈ ਪੁੰਨਿ ॥
1237.t: n bheejai dhaata(n)ee keetai pu(n)n ||
1237.e: He is not won over by giving donations in charity.

1237.g: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਸੁੰਨਿ ॥
1237.t: n bheejai baahar baiThiaa su(n)n ||
1237.e: He is not won over by living alone in the wilderness.

1237.g: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਭੇੜਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਿੜਿ ਸੂਰ ॥
1237.t: n bheejai bheR mareh bhiR soor ||
1237.e: He is not won over by fighting and dying as a warrior in battle.

1237.g: ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਕੇਤੇ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਧੂੜ ॥
1237.t: n bheejai kete hoveh dhooR ||
1237.e: He is not won over by becoming the dust of the masses.

1237.g: ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਮਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
1237.t: lekhaa likheeaai man kai bhai ||
1237.e: The account is written of the loves of the mind.

1237.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੨॥
1237.t: naanak bheejai saachai nai ||2||
1237.e: O Nanak, the Lord is won over only by His Name. ||2||

1237.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1237.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1237.e: First Mehla:

1237.g: ਨਵ ਛਿਅ ਖਟ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1237.t: nav chhia khaT kaa kare beechaar ||
1237.e: You may study the nine grammars, the six Shaastras and the six divions of the Vedas.

1237.g: ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨ ਉਚਰੈ ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰ ॥
1237.t: nis dhin ucharai bhaar aThaar ||
1237.e: You may recite the Mahaabhaarata.

1237.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਭੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੋਹਿ ॥
1237.t: tin bhee a(n)t na paiaa toh ||
1237.e: Even these cannot find the limits of the Lord.

1237.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
1237.t: naam bihoon mukat kiau hoi ||
1237.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone be liberated?

1237.g: ਨਾਭਿ ਵਸਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
1237.t: naabh vasat brahamai a(n)t na jaaniaa ||
1237.e: Brahma, in the lotus of the navel, does not know the limits of God.

1237.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
1237.t: gurmukh naanak naam pachhaaniaa ||3||
1237.e: The Gurmukh, O Nanak, realizes the Naam. ||3||

1237.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1237.t: pauRee ||
1237.e: Pauree:

1237.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
1237.t: aape aap nira(n)janaa jin aap upaiaa ||
1237.e: The Immaculate Lord Himself, by Himself, created Himself.

1237.g: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
1237.t: aape khel rachaion sabh jagat sabaiaa ||
1237.e: He Himself created the whole drama of all the world's play.

1237.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਆਪਿ ਸਿਰਜਿਅਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
1237.t: trai gun aap sirajian maiaa moh vadhaiaa ||
1237.e: He Himself formed the three gunas, the three qualities; He increased the attachment to Maya.

1237.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1237.t: gur parasaadhee ubare jin bhaanaa bhaiaa ||
1237.e: By Guru's Grace, they are saved - those who love the Will of God.

1237.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1237.t: naanak sach varatadhaa sabh sach samaiaa ||1||
1237.e: O Nanak, the True Lord is pervading everywhere; all are contained within the True Lord. ||1||

1238.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
1238.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
1238.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

1238.g: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਪੇ ਰਖੈ ਵੇਕ ॥
1238.t: aap upaae naanakaa aape rakhai vek ||
1238.e: He Himself creates, O Nanak; He establishes the various creatures.

1238.g: ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
1238.t: ma(n)dhaa kis no aakheeaai jaa(n) sabhanaa saahib ek ||
1238.e: How can anyone be called bad? We have only One Lord and Master.

1238.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਵੇਖੈ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ॥
1238.t: sabhanaa saahib ek hai vekhai dha(n)dhai lai ||
1238.e: There is One Lord and Master of all; He watches over all, and assigns all to their tasks.

1238.g: ਕਿਸੈ ਥੋੜਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਅਗਲਾ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1238.t: kisai thoRaa kisai agalaa khaalee koiee naeh ||
1238.e: Some have less, and some have more; no one is allowed to leave empty.

1238.g: ਆਵਹਿ ਨੰਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨੰਗੇ ਵਿਚੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਥਾਰ ॥
1238.t: aaveh na(n)ge jaeh na(n)ge viche kareh vithaar ||
1238.e: Naked we come, and naked we go; in between, we put on a show.

1238.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਗੈ ਕਾਈ ਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
1238.t: naanak hukam na jaaneeaai agai kaiee kaar ||1||
1238.e: O Nanak, one who does not understand the Hukam of God's Command - what will he have to do in the world hereafter? ||1||

1238.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1238.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1238.e: First Mehla:

1238.g: ਜਿਨਸਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਜੀਆਂ ਕਉ ਭੇਜੈ ਜਿਨਸਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
1238.t: jinas thaap jeeaa(n) kau bhejai jinas thaap lai jaavai ||
1238.e: He sends out the various created beings, and he calls back the various created beings again.

1238.g: ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੈ ਆਪੇ ਏਤੇ ਵੇਸ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
1238.t: aape thaap uthaapai aape ete ves karaavai ||
1238.e: He himself establishes, and He Himself disestablishes. He fashions them in various forms.

1238.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਉਧੂਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1238.t: jete jeea fireh aaudhootee aape bhikhiaa paavai ||
1238.e: And all the human beings who wander around as beggars, He Himself gives in charity to them.

1238.g: ਲੇਖੈ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਚਲਣੁ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਦਾਵੇ ॥
1238.t: lekhai bolan lekhai chalan kait keecheh dhaave ||
1238.e: As it is recorded, the mortals speak, and as it is recorded, they walk. So why put on all this show?

1238.g: ਮੂਲੁ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਏਹੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
1238.t: mool mat paravaanaa eho naanak aakh sunaae ||
1238.e: This is the basis of intelligence; this is certified and approved. Nanak speaks and proclaims it.

1238.g: ਕਰਣੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥੨॥
1238.t: karanee upar hoi tapaavas je ko kahai kahaae ||2||
1238.e: By past actions, each being is judged; what else can anyone say? ||2||

1238.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1238.t: pauRee ||
1238.e: Pauree:

1238.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
1238.t: gurmukh chalat rachaion gun paragaTee aaiaa ||
1238.e: The Guru's Word makes the drama play itself out. Through virtue, this becomes evident.

1238.g: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸਦ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
1238.t: gurbaanee sadh ucharai har ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
1238.e: Whoever utters the Word of the Guru's Bani - the Lord is enshrined in his mind.

1238.g: ਸਕਤਿ ਗਈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਿਵ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇਆ ॥
1238.t: sakat giee bhram kaTiaa siv jot jagaiaa ||
1238.e: Maya's power is gone, and doubt is eradicated; awaken to the Light of the Lord.

1238.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
1238.t: jin kai potai pu(n)n hai gur purakh milaiaa ||
1238.e: Those who hold onto goodness as their treasure meet the Guru, the Primal Being.

1238.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1238.t: naanak sahaje mil rahe har naam samaiaa ||2||
1238.e: O Nanak, they are intuitively absorbed and blended into the Name of the Lord. ||2||

1238.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
1238.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
1238.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

1238.g: ਸਾਹ ਚਲੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1238.t: saeh chale vanajaariaa likhiaa dhevai naal ||
1238.e: The merchants come from the Banker; He sends the account of their destiny with them.

1238.g: ਲਿਖੇ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਈਐ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
1238.t: likhe upar hukam hoi lieeaai vasat sam(h)aal ||
1238.e: On the basis of their accounts, He issues the Hukam of His Command, and they are left to take care of their merchandise.

1238.g: ਵਸਤੁ ਲਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਈ ਵਖਰੁ ਬਧਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
1238.t: vasat liee vanajaariee vakhar badhaa pai ||
1238.e: The merchants have purchased their merchandise and packed up their cargo.

1238.g: ਕੇਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
1238.t: keiee laahaa lai chale ik chale mool gavai ||
1238.e: Some depart after having earned a good profit, while others leave, having lost their investment altogether.

1238.g: ਥੋੜਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮੰਗਿਓ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
1238.t: thoRaa kinai na ma(n)gio kis kaheeaai saabaas ||
1238.e: No one asks to have less; who should be celebrated?

1238.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਲਾਏ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
1238.t: nadhar tinaa kau naanakaa j saabat laae raas ||1||
1238.e: The Lord casts His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, upon those who have preserved their capital investment. ||1||

1238.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1238.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1238.e: First Mehla:

1238.g: ਜੁੜਿ ਜੁੜਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜੁੜੇ ॥
1238.t: juR juR vichhuRe vichhuR juRe ||
1238.e: United, the united separate, and separated, they unite again.

1238.g: ਜੀਵਿ ਜੀਵਿ ਮੁਏ ਮੁਏ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
1238.t: jeev jeev mue mue jeeve ||
1238.e: Living, the living die, and dying, they live again.

1238.g: ਕੇਤਿਆ ਕੇ ਬਾਪ ਕੇਤਿਆ ਕੇ ਬੇਟੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲੇ ਹੂਏ ॥
1238.t: ketiaa ke baap ketiaa ke beTe kete gur chele hooe ||
1238.e: They become the fathers of many, and the sons of many; they become the gurus of many, and the disciples.

1238.g: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਤੀ ਕਿਆ ਹੁਣਿ ਹੂਏ ॥
1238.t: aagai paachhai ganat na aavai kiaa jaatee kiaa hun hooe ||
1238.e: No account can be made of the future or the past; who knows what shall be, or what was?

1238.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰੇ ॥
1238.t: sabh karanaa kirat kar likheeaai kar kar karataa kare kare ||
1238.e: All the actions and events of the past are recorded; the Doer did, He does, and He will do.

1238.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
1238.t: manmukh mareeaai gurmukh tareeaai naanak nadharee nadhar kare ||2||
1238.e: The self-willed manmukh dies, while the Gurmukh is saved; O Nanak, the Gracious Lord bestows His Glance of Grace. ||2||

1238.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1238.t: pauRee ||
1238.e: Pauree:

1238.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
1238.t: manmukh dhoojaa bharam hai dhoojai lobhaiaa ||
1238.e: The self-willed manmukh wanders in duality, lured and enticed by duality.

1238.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਕੂੜੋ ਆਲਾਇਆ ॥
1238.t: kooR kapaT kamaavadhe kooRo aalaiaa ||
1238.e: He practices falsehood and deception, telling lies.

1238.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
1238.t: putr kalatr moh het hai sabh dhukh sabaiaa ||
1238.e: Love and attachment to children and spouse is total misery and pain.

1238.g: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਭਰਮਹਿ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
1238.t: jam dhar badhe maare'eh bharameh bharamaiaa ||
1238.e: He is gagged and bound at the door of the Messenger of Death; he dies, and wanders lost in reincarnation.

1238.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1238.t: manmukh janam gavaiaa naanak har bhaiaa ||3||
1238.e: The self-willed manmukh wastes his life; Nanak loves the Lord. ||3||

1238.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
1238.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
1238.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

1238.g: ਜਿਨ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਤੇ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
1238.t: jin vaddiaaiee tere naam kee te rate man maeh ||
1238.e: Those who are blessed with the glorious greatness of Your Name - their minds are imbued with Your Love.

1238.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1238.t: naanak a(n)mrit ek hai dhoojaa a(n)mrit naeh ||
1238.e: O Nanak, there is only One Ambrosial Nectar; there is no other nectar at all.

1238.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1238.t: naanak a(n)mrit manai maeh paieeaai gur parasaadh ||
1238.e: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained within the mind, by Guru's Grace.

1238.g: ਤਿਨੑੀ ਪੀਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਦਿ ॥੧॥
1238.t: tin(h)ee peetaa ra(n)g siau jin(h) kau likhiaa aadh ||1||
1238.e: They alone drink it in with love, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

1239.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
1239.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
1239.e: Second Mehla:

1239.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਇ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
1239.t: keetaa kiaa saalaaheeaai kare soi saalaeh ||
1239.e: Why praise the created being? Praise the One who created all.

1239.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1239.t: naanak ekee baaharaa dhoojaa dhaataa naeh ||
1239.e: O Nanak, there is no other Giver, except the One Lord.

1239.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
1239.t: karataa so saalaaheeaai jin keetaa aakaar ||
1239.e: Praise the Creator Lord, who created the creation.

1239.g: ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
1239.t: dhaataa so saalaaheeaai j sabhasai dhe aadhaar ||
1239.e: Praise the Great Giver, who gives sustenence to all.

1239.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਸਦੀਵ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
1239.t: naanak aap sadheev hai pooraa jis bha(n)ddaar ||
1239.e: O Nanak, the treasure of the Eternal Lord is over-flowing.

1239.g: ਵਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
1239.t: vaddaa kar saalaaheeaai a(n)t na paaraavaar ||2||
1239.e: Praise and honor the One, who has no end or limitation. ||2||

1239.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1239.t: pauRee ||
1239.e: Pauree:

1239.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
1239.t: har kaa naam nidhaan hai seviaai sukh paiee ||
1239.e: The Name of the Lord is a treasure. Serving it, peace is obtained.

1239.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਉਚਰਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਂਈ ॥
1239.t: naam nira(n)jan ucharaa(n) pat siau ghar jaa(n)iee ||
1239.e: I chant the Name of the Immaculate Lord, so that I may go home with honor.

1239.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
1239.t: gurmukh baanee naam hai naam ridhai vasaiee ||
1239.e: The Word of the Gurmukh is the Naam; I enshrine the Naam within my heart.

1239.g: ਮਤਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਵਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆੲਂੀ ॥
1239.t: mat pa(n)kheroo vas hoi satiguroo dhiaae(n)ee ||
1239.e: The bird of the intellect comes under one's control, by meditating on the True Guru.

1239.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
1239.t: naanak aap dhiaal hoi naame liv laiee ||4||
1239.e: O Nanak, if the Lord becomes merciful, the mortal lovingly tunes in to the Naam. ||4||

1239.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
1239.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
1239.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

1239.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
1239.t: tis siau kaisaa bolanaa j aape jaanai jaan ||
1239.e: How can we speak of Him? Only He knows Himself.

1239.g: ਚੀਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
1239.t: cheeree jaa kee naa firai saahib so paravaan ||
1239.e: His decree cannot be challenged; He is our Supreme Lord and Master.

1239.g: ਚੀਰੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਮੀਰ ਮਲਕ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
1239.t: cheeree jis kee chalanaa meer malak salaar ||
1239.e: By His Decree, even kings, nobles and commanders must step down.

1239.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
1239.t: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa saiee bhalee kaar ||
1239.e: Whatever is pleasing to His Will, O Nanak, is a good deed.

1239.g: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਚੀਰੀ ਚਲਣਾ ਹਥਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1239.t: jin(h)aa cheeree chalanaa hath tin(h)aa kichh naeh ||
1239.e: By His Decree, we walk; nothing rests in our hands.

1239.g: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਠੀ ਕਰਲੈ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
1239.t: saahib kaa furamaan hoi uThee karalai paeh ||
1239.e: When the Order comes from our Lord and Master, all must rise up and take to the road.

1239.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਚੀਰੀ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
1239.t: jehaa cheeree likhiaa tehaa hukam kamaeh ||
1239.e: As His Decree is issued, so is His Command obeyed.

1239.g: ਘਲੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਦੇ ਉਠੀ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
1239.t: ghale aaveh naanakaa sadhe uThee jaeh ||1||
1239.e: Those who are sent, come, O Nanak; when they are called back, they depart and go. ||1||

1239.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੨ ॥
1239.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
1239.e: Second Mehla:

1239.g: ਸਿਫਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਉ ਬਖਸੀਐ ਸੇਈ ਪੋਤੇਦਾਰ ॥
1239.t: sifat jinaa kau bakhaseeaai seiee potedhaar ||
1239.e: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Praises, are the true keepers of the treasure.

1239.g: ਕੁੰਜੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਦਿਤੀਆ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਿਲੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
1239.t: ku(n)jee jin kau dhiteeaa tin(h)aa mile bha(n)ddaar ||
1239.e: Those who are blessed with the key - they alone receive the treasure.

1239.g: ਜਹ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਹੂ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ਤੇ ਕੀਅਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
1239.t: jeh bha(n)ddaaree hoo gun nikaleh te ke'eeh paravaan ||
1239.e: That treasure, from which virtue wells up - that treasure is approved.

1239.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
1239.t: nadhar tin(h)aa kau naanakaa naam jin(h)aa neesaan ||2||
1239.e: Those who are blessed by His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, bear the Insignia of the Naam. ||2||

1239.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1239.t: pauRee ||
1239.e: Pauree:

1239.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
1239.t: naam nira(n)jan niramalaa suniaai sukh hoiee ||
1239.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is immaculate and pure; hearing it, peace is obtained.

1239.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
1239.t: sun sun ma(n)n vasaieeaai boojhai jan koiee ||
1239.e: Listening and hearing, It is enshrined in the mind; how rare is that humble being who realizes it.

1239.g: ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
1239.t: bahadhiaa uThadhiaa na visarai saachaa sach soiee ||
1239.e: Sitting down and standing up, I shall never forget Him, the Truest of the true.

1239.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
1239.t: bhagataa kau naam adhaar hai naame sukh hoiee ||
1239.e: His devotees have the Support of His Name; in His Name, they find peace.

1239.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੫॥
1239.t: naanak man tan rav rahiaa gurmukh har soiee ||5||
1239.e: O Nanak, He permeates and pervades mind and body; He is the Lord, the Guru's Word. ||5||

1239.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1239.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1239.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1239.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਲੀਅਹਿ ਤੋਲ ਜੇ ਜੀਉ ਪਿਛੈ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
1239.t: naanak tule'eeh tol je jeeau pichhai paieeaai ||
1239.e: O Nanak, the weight is weighed out, when the soul is placed on the scale.

1239.g: ਇਕਸੁ ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਬੋਲ ਜੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ॥
1239.t: eikas na pujeh bol je poore pooraa kar milai ||
1239.e: Nothing is equal to speaking of the One, who perfectly unites us with the Perfect Lord.

1239.g: ਵਡਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਭਾਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥
1239.t: vaddaa aakhan bhaaraa tol ||
1239.e: To call Him glorious and great carries such a heavy weight.

1239.g: ਹੋਰ ਹਉਲੀ ਮਤੀ ਹਉਲੇ ਬੋਲ ॥
1239.t: hor haulee matee haule bol ||
1239.e: Other intellectualisms are lightweight; other words are lightweight as well.

1239.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਰਬਤ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
1239.t: dharatee paanee parabat bhaar ||
1239.e: The weight of the earth, water and mountains

1239.g: ਕਿਉ ਕੰਡੈ ਤੋਲੈ ਸੁਨਿਆਰੁ ॥
1239.t: kiau ka(n)ddai tolai suniaar ||
1239.e: - how can the goldsmith weigh it on the scale?

1239.g: ਤੋਲਾ ਮਾਸਾ ਰਤਕ ਪਾਇ ॥
1239.t: tolaa maasaa ratak pai ||
1239.e: What weights can balance the scale?

1239.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਪੁਜਾਇ ॥
1239.t: naanak puchhiaa dhei pujai ||
1239.e: O Nanak, when questioned, the answer is given.

1239.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੀ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
1239.t: moorakh a(n)dhiaa a(n)dhee dhaat ||
1239.e: The blind fool is running around, leading the blind.

1239.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਨਿ ਆਪੁ ॥੧॥
1239.t: keh keh kahan kahain aap ||1||
1239.e: The more they say, the more they expose themselves. ||1||

1239.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1239.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1239.e: First Mehla:

1239.g: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਆਖਿ ॥
1239.t: aakhan aaukhaa sunan aaukhaa aakh na jaapee aakh ||
1239.e: It is difficult to chant it; it is difficult to listen to it. It cannot be chanted with the mouth.

1239.g: ਇਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਭਾਖਹਿ ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
1239.t: eik aakh aakheh sabadh bhaakheh aradh uradh dhin raat ||
1239.e: Some speak with their mouths and chant the Word of the Shabad - the low and the high, day and night.

1239.g: ਜੇ ਕਿਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਕਿਹੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਜਾਪੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
1239.t: je kih hoi ta kih dhisai jaapai roop na jaat ||
1239.e: If He were something, then He would be visible. His form and state cannot be seen.

1239.g: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਟ ਅਉਘਟ ਘਟ ਥਾਪਿ ॥
1239.t: sabh kaaran karataa kare ghaT aaughaT ghaT thaap ||
1239.e: The Creator Lord does all deeds; He is established in the hearts of the high and the low.

1240.g: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਖਿ ॥੨॥
1240.t: aakhan aaukhaa naanakaa aakh na jaapai aakh ||2||
1240.e: It is so difficult to chant it, O Nanak; it cannot be chanted with the mouth. ||2||

1240.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1240.t: pauRee ||
1240.e: Pauree:

1240.g: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
1240.t: nai suniaai man rahaseeaai naame saa(n)t aaiee ||
1240.e: Hearing the Name, the mind is delighted. The Name brings peace and tranquility.

1240.g: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
1240.t: nai suniaai man tirapateeaai sabh dhukh gavaiee ||
1240.e: Hearing the Name, the mind is satisfied, and all pains are taken away.

1240.g: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1240.t: nai suniaai naau uoopajai naame vaddiaaiee ||
1240.e: Hearing the Name, one becomes famous; the Name brings glorious greatness.

1240.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
1240.t: naame hee sabh jaat pat naame gat paiee ||
1240.e: The Name brings all honor and status; through the Name, salvation is obtained.

1240.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
1240.t: gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai naanak liv laiee ||6||
1240.e: The Gurmukh meditates on the Name; Nanak is lovingly attuned to the Name. ||6||

1240.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1240.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1240.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1240.g: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਰਾਗਂੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਵੇਦਂੀ ॥
1240.t: jooTh na raaga(n)ee jooTh na vedha(n)ee ||
1240.e: Impurity does not come from music; impurity does not come from the Vedas.

1240.g: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਭੇਦੀ ॥
1240.t: jooTh na cha(n)dh sooraj kee bhedhee ||
1240.e: Impurity does not come from the phases of the sun and the moon.

1240.g: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਅੰਨੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਨਾਈ ॥
1240.t: jooTh na a(n)nee jooTh na naiee ||
1240.e: Impurity does not come from food; impurity does not come from ritual cleansing baths.

1240.g: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਮੀਹੁ ਵਰ੍ਹਿਐ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
1240.t: jooTh na meeh varihaai sabh thaiee ||
1240.e: Impurity does not come from the rain, which falls everywhere.

1240.g: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਧਰਤੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
1240.t: jooTh na dharatee jooTh na paanee ||
1240.e: Impurity does not come from the earth; impurity does not come from the water.

1240.g: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਉਣੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
1240.t: jooTh na paunai maeh samaanee ||
1240.e: Impurity does not come from the air which is diffused everywhere.

1240.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਗੁਰਿਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
1240.t: naanak niguriaa gun naahee koi ||
1240.e: O Nanak, the one who has no Guru, has no redeeming virtues at all.

1240.g: ਮੁਹਿ ਫੇਰਿਐ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੂਠਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
1240.t: muh feriaai muh jooThaa hoi ||1||
1240.e: Impurity comes from turning one's face away from God. ||1||

1240.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1240.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1240.e: First Mehla:

1240.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਚੁਲੀਆ ਸੁਚੀਆ ਜੇ ਭਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
1240.t: naanak chuleeaa sucheeaa je bhar jaanai koi ||
1240.e: O Nanak, the mouth is truly cleansed by ritual cleansing, if you really know how to do it.

1240.g: ਸੁਰਤੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਾ ਜਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1240.t: surate chulee giaan kee jogee kaa jat hoi ||
1240.e: For the intuitively aware, cleansing is spiritual wisdom. For the Yogi, it is self-control.

1240.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਚੁਲੀ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕੀ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
1240.t: brahaman chulee sa(n)tokh kee girahee kaa sat dhaan ||
1240.e: For the Brahmin, cleansing is contentment; for the householder, it is truth and charity.

1240.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਨਿਆਵ ਕੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
1240.t: raaje chulee niaav kee paRiaa sach dhiaan ||
1240.e: For the king, cleansing is justice; for the scholar, it is true meditation.

1240.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਧੋਪਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
1240.t: paanee chit na dhopiee mukh peetai tikh jai ||
1240.e: The consciousness is not washed with water; you drink it to quench your thirst.

1240.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਗਤ ਕਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
1240.t: paanee pitaa jagat kaa fir paanee sabh khai ||2||
1240.e: Water is the father of the world; in the end, water destroys it all. ||2||

1240.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1240.t: pauRee ||
1240.e: Pauree:

1240.g: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਪਿਛੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
1240.t: nai suniaai sabh sidh hai ridh pichhai aavai ||
1240.e: Hearing the Name, all supernatural spiritual powers are obtained, and wealth follows along.

1240.g: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1240.t: nai suniaai nau nidh milai man chi(n)dhiaa paavai ||
1240.e: Hearing the Name, the nine treasures are received, and the mind's desires are obtained.

1240.g: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਵਲਾ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
1240.t: nai suniaai sa(n)tokh hoi kavalaa charan dhiaavai ||
1240.e: Hearing the Name, contentment comes, and Maya meditates at one's feet.

1240.g: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1240.t: nai suniaai sahaj uoopajai sahaje sukh paavai ||
1240.e: Hearing the Name, intuitive peace and poise wells up.

1240.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੭॥
1240.t: gurmatee naau paieeaai naanak gun gaavai ||7||
1240.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained; O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||7||

1240.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1240.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1240.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1240.g: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਰਤਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
1240.t: dhukh vich ja(n)man dhukh maran dhukh varatan sa(n)saar ||
1240.e: In pain, we are born; in pain, we die. In pain, we deal with the world.

1240.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗੈ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੜਿੑ ਪੜਿੑ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
1240.t: dhukh dhukh agai aakheeaai paRi(h) paRi(h) kareh pukaar ||
1240.e: Hereafter, there is said to be pain, only pain; the more the mortals read, the more they cry out.

1240.g: ਦੁਖ ਕੀਆ ਪੰਡਾ ਖੁਲੑੀਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਲਿਓ ਕੋਇ ॥
1240.t: dhukh keeaa pa(n)ddaa khul(h)eeaa sukh na nikalio koi ||
1240.e: The packages of pain are untied, but peace does not emerge.

1240.g: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
1240.t: dhukh vich jeeau jalaiaa dhukheeaa chaliaa roi ||
1240.e: In pain, the soul burns; in pain, it departs weeping and wailing.

1240.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
1240.t: naanak sifatee ratiaa man tan hariaa hoi ||
1240.e: O Nanak, imbued with the Lord's Praise, the mind and body blossom forth, rejuvenated.

1240.g: ਦੁਖ ਕੀਆ ਅਗੀ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਭੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
1240.t: dhukh keeaa agee maare'eh bhee dhukh dhaaroo hoi ||1||
1240.e: In the fire of pain, the mortals die; but pain is also the cure. ||1||

1240.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1240.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1240.e: First Mehla:

1240.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਭਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਸੂ ਹੂ ਭਸੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
1240.t: naanak dhuneeaa bhas ra(n)g bhasoo hoo bhas kheh ||
1240.e: O Nanak, worldly pleasures are nothing more than dust. They are the dust of the dust of ashes.

1240.g: ਭਸੋ ਭਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭੀ ਭਸੁ ਭਰੀਐ ਦੇਹ ॥
1240.t: bhaso bhas kamaavanee bhee bhas bhareeaai dheh ||
1240.e: The mortal earns only the dust of the dust; his body is covered with dust.

1240.g: ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਢੀਐ ਭਸੂ ਭਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
1240.t: jaa jeeau vichahu kaddeeaai bhasoo bhariaa jai ||
1240.e: When the soul is taken out of the body, it too is covered with dust.

1240.g: ਅਗੈ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
1240.t: agai lekhai ma(n)giaai hor dhasoonee pai ||2||
1240.e: And when one's account is called for in the world hereafter, he receives only ten times more dust. ||2||

1240.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1240.t: pauRee ||
1240.e: Pauree:

1240.g: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
1240.t: nai suniaai such sa(n)jamo jam neR na aavai ||
1240.e: Hearing the Name, one is blessed with purity and self-control, and the Messenger of Death will not draw near.

1240.g: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਆਨੑੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
1240.t: nai suniaai ghaT chaananaa aan(h)er gavaavai ||
1240.e: Hearing the Name, the heart is illumined, and darkness is dispelled.

1240.g: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1240.t: nai suniaai aap bujheeaai laahaa naau paavai ||
1240.e: Hearing the Name, one comes to understand his own self, and the profit of the Name is obtained.

1240.g: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
1240.t: nai suniaai paap kaTe'eeh niramal sach paavai ||
1240.e: Hearing the Name, sins are eradicated, and one meets the Immaculate True Lord.

1240.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੮॥
1240.t: naanak nai suniaai mukh ujale naau gurmukh dhiaavai ||8||
1240.e: O Nanak, hearing the Name, one's face becomes radiant. As Gurmukh, meditate on the Name. ||8||

1240.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1240.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1240.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1240.g: ਘਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਭਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1240.t: ghar naarain sabhaa naal ||
1240.e: In your home, is the Lord God, along with all your other gods.

1241.g: ਪੂਜ ਕਰੇ ਰਖੈ ਨਾਵਾਲਿ ॥
1241.t: pooj kare rakhai naavaal ||
1241.e: You wash your stone gods and worship them.

1241.g: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਚੰਨਣੁ ਫੁਲ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
1241.t: ku(n)goo cha(n)nan ful chaRaae ||
1241.e: You offer saffron, sandalwood and flowers.

1241.g: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥
1241.t: pairee pai pai bahut manaae ||
1241.e: Falling at their feet, you try so hard to appease them.

1241.g: ਮਾਣੂਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਪੈਨੑੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
1241.t: maanooaa ma(n)g ma(n)g pain(h)ai khai ||
1241.e: Begging, begging from other people, you get things to wear and eat.

1241.g: ਅੰਧੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਅੰਧ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
1241.t: a(n)dhee ka(n)mee a(n)dh sajai ||
1241.e: For your blind deeds, you will be blindly punished.

1241.g: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਮਰਦਿਆ ਰਖੈ ॥
1241.t: bhukhiaa dhei na maradhiaa rakhai ||
1241.e: Your idol does not feed the hungry, or save the dying.

1241.g: ਅੰਧਾ ਝਗੜਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਸਥੈ ॥੧॥
1241.t: a(n)dhaa jhagaRaa a(n)dhee sathai ||1||
1241.e: The blind assembly argues in blindness. ||1||

1241.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1241.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1241.e: First Mehla:

1241.g: ਸਭੇ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਜੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
1241.t: sabhe suratee jog sabh sabhe bedh puraan ||
1241.e: All intuitive understanding, all Yoga, all the Vedas and Puraanas.

1241.g: ਸਭੇ ਕਰਣੇ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਗੀਤ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
1241.t: sabhe karane tap sabh sabhe geet giaan ||
1241.e: All actions, all penances, all songs and spiritual wisdom.

1241.g: ਸਭੇ ਬੁਧੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਥਾਨ ॥
1241.t: sabhe budhee sudh sabh sabh teerath sabh thaan ||
1241.e: All intellect, all enlightenment, all sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

1241.g: ਸਭਿ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਅਮਰ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਖਾਨ ॥
1241.t: sabh paatisaaheeaa amar sabh sabh khuseeaa sabh khaan ||
1241.e: All kingdoms, all royal commands, all joys and all delicacies.

1241.g: ਸਭੇ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਵ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ॥
1241.t: sabhe maanas dhev sabh sabhe jog dhiaan ||
1241.e: All mankind, all divinites, all Yoga and meditation.

1241.g: ਸਭੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਸਭਿ ਸਭੇ ਜੀਅ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
1241.t: sabhe pureeaa kha(n)dd sabh sabhe jeea jahaan ||
1241.e: All worlds, all celestial realms; all the beings of the universe.

1241.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਆਪਣੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਵਹੈ ਕਲਾਮ ॥
1241.t: hukam chalaae aapanai karamee vahai kalaam ||
1241.e: According to His Hukam, He commands them. His Pen writes out the account of their actions.

1241.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਸਚੁ ਸਭਾ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
1241.t: naanak sachaa sach nai sach sabhaa dheebaan ||2||
1241.e: O Nanak, True is the Lord, and True is His Name. True is His Congregation and His Court. ||2||

1241.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1241.t: pauRee ||
1241.e: Pauree:

1241.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
1241.t: nai ma(n)niaai sukh uoopajai naame gat hoiee ||
1241.e: With faith in the Name, peace wells up; the Name brings emancipation.

1241.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
1241.t: nai ma(n)niaai pat paieeaai hiradhai har soiee ||
1241.e: With faith in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord is enshrined in the heart.

1241.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1241.t: nai ma(n)niaai bhavajal la(n)gheeaai fir bighan na hoiee ||
1241.e: With faith in the Name, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, and no obstructions are ever again encountered.

1241.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪੰਥੁ ਪਰਗਟਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥
1241.t: nai ma(n)niaai pa(n)th paragaTaa naame sabh loiee ||
1241.e: With faith in the Name, the Path is revealed; through the Name, one is totally enlightened.

1241.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੯॥
1241.t: naanak satigur miliaai naau ma(n)neeaai jin dhevai soiee ||9||
1241.e: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, one comes to have faith in the Name; he alone has faith, who is blessed with it. ||9||

1241.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1241.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1241.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1241.g: ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਇਕ ਪੈਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
1241.t: pureeaa kha(n)ddaa sir kare ik pair dhiaae ||
1241.e: The mortal walks on his head through the worlds and realms; he meditates, balanced on one foot.

1241.g: ਪਉਣੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਤਲੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
1241.t: paun maar man jap kare sir mu(n)ddee talai dhei ||
1241.e: Controlling the wind of the breath, he meditates within his mind, tucking his chin down into his chest.

1241.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਟਿਕ ਟਿਕੈ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
1241.t: kis upar oh Tik Tikai kis no jor karei ||
1241.e: What does he lean on? Where does he get his power?

1241.g: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੇਇ ॥
1241.t: kis no kaheeaai naanakaa kis no karataa dhei ||
1241.e: What can be said, O Nanak? Who is blessed by the Creator?

1241.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਹਾਏ ਆਪਣੈ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਣੇਇ ॥੧॥
1241.t: hukam rahaae aapanai moorakh aap ganei ||1||
1241.e: God keeps all under His Command, but the fool shows off himself. ||1||

1241.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1241.e: First Mehla:

1241.g: ਹੈ ਹੈ ਆਖਾਂ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੀ ਹੂ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
1241.t: hai hai aakhaa(n) koT koT koTee hoo koT koT ||
1241.e: He is, He is - I say it millions upon millions, millions upon millions of times.

1241.g: ਆਖੂੰ ਆਖਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ॥
1241.t: aakhoo(n) aakhaa(n) sadhaa sadhaa kahan na aavai toT ||
1241.e: With my mouth I say it, forever and ever; there is no end to this speech.

1241.g: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਥਕਾਂ ਨ ਠਾਕੀਆ ਏਵਡ ਰਖਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
1241.t: naa hau thakaa(n) na Thaakeeaa evadd rakheh jot ||
1241.e: I do not get tired, and I will not be stopped; this is how great my determination is.

1241.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਚਸਿਅਹੁ ਚੁਖ ਬਿੰਦ ਉਪਰਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਦੋਸੁ ॥੨॥
1241.t: naanak chasiahu chukh bi(n)dh upar aakhan dhos ||2||
1241.e: O Nanak, this is tiny and insignificant. To say that it is more, is wrong. ||2||

1241.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1241.t: pauRee ||
1241.e: Pauree:

1241.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
1241.t: nai ma(n)niaai kul udharai sabh kuTa(n)b sabaiaa ||
1241.e: With faith in the Name, all one's ancestors and family are saved.

1241.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਿਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
1241.t: nai ma(n)niaai sa(n)gat udharai jin ridhai vasaiaa ||
1241.e: With faith in the Name, one's associates are saved; enshrine it within your heart.

1241.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਆ ॥
1241.t: nai ma(n)niaai sun udhare jin rasan rasaiaa ||
1241.e: With faith in the Name, those who hear it are saved; let your tongue delight in it.

1241.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਜਿਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
1241.t: nai ma(n)niaai dhukh bhukh giee jin naam chit laiaa ||
1241.e: With faith in the Name, pain and hunger are dispelled; let your consciousness be attached to the Name.

1241.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
1241.t: naanak naam tinee saalaahiaa jin guroo milaiaa ||10||
1241.e: O Nanak, they alone Praise the Name, who meet with the Guru. ||10||

1241.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1241.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1241.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1241.g: ਸਭੇ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਦਿਹ ਸਭਿ ਥਿਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਰ ॥
1241.t: sabhe raatee sabh dheh sabh thitee sabh vaar ||
1241.e: All nights, all days, all dates, all days of the week;

1241.g: ਸਭੇ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਤਂੀ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
1241.t: sabhe rutee maeh sabh sabh dharata(n)ee sabh bhaar ||
1241.e: All seasons, all months, all the earth and everything on it.

1241.g: ਸਭੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਉਣ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
1241.t: sabhe paanee paun sabh sabh aganee paataal ||
1241.e: All waters, all winds, all fires and underworlds.

1241.g: ਸਭੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਸਭਿ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਅ ਲੋਅ ਆਕਾਰ ॥
1241.t: sabhe pureeaa kha(n)dd sabh sabh loa loa aakaar ||
1241.e: All solar systems and galaxies, all worlds, people and forms.

1241.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੀ ਕੇਤੜਾ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਜੈ ਕਾਰ ॥
1241.t: hukam na jaapee ketaRaa keh na sakeejai kaar ||
1241.e: No one knows how great the Hukam of His Command is; no one can describe His actions.

1241.g: ਆਖਹਿ ਥਕਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਂੀ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
1241.t: aakheh thakeh aakh aakh kar sifata(n)ee veechaar ||
1241.e: Mortals may utter, chant, recite and contemplate His Praises until they grow weary.

1241.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
1241.t: tiran na paio bapuRee naanak kahai gavaar ||1||
1241.e: The poor fools, O Nanak, cannot find even a tiny bit of the Lord. ||1||

1241.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1241.e: First Mehla:

1241.g: ਅਖਂੀ ਪਰਣੈ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾਂ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
1241.t: akha(n)ee paranai je firaa(n) dhekhaa(n) sabh aakaar ||
1241.e: If I were to walk around with my eyes wide open, gazing at all the created forms;

1241.g: ਪੁਛਾ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਪੰਡਿਤਾਂ ਪੁਛਾ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
1241.t: puchhaa giaanee pa(n)dditaa(n) puchhaa bedh beechaar ||
1241.e: I could ask the spiritual teachers and religious scholars, and those who contemplate the Vedas;

1242.g: ਪੁਛਾ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਮਾਣਸਾਂ ਜੋਧ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
1242.t: puchhaa dhevaa(n) maanasaa(n) jodh kareh avataar ||
1242.e: I could ask the gods, mortal men, warriors and divine incarnations;

1242.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
1242.t: sidh samaadhee sabh sunee jai dhekhaa(n) dharabaar ||
1242.e: I could consult all the Siddhas in Samaadhi, and go to see the Lord's Court.

1242.g: ਅਗੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
1242.t: agai sachaa sach nai nirabhau bhai vin saar ||
1242.e: Hereafter, Truth is the Name of all; the Fearless Lord has no fear at all.

1242.g: ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਮਤੀ ਕਚੁ ਪਿਚੁ ਅੰਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1242.t: hor kachee matee kach pich a(n)dhiaa a(n)dh beechaar ||
1242.e: False are other intellectualisms, false and shallow; blind are the contemplations of the blind.

1242.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਏ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
1242.t: naanak karamee ba(n)dhagee nadhar la(n)ghaae paar ||2||
1242.e: O Nanak, by the karma of good actions, the mortal comes to meditate on the Lord; by His Grace, we are carried across. ||2||

1242.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1242.t: pauRee ||
1242.e: Pauree:

1242.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਈ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
1242.t: nai ma(n)niaai dhuramat giee mat paragaTee aaiaa ||
1242.e: With faith in the Name, evil-mindedness is eradicated, and the intellect is enlightened.

1242.g: ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
1242.t: naau ma(n)niaai haumai giee sabh rog gavaiaa ||
1242.e: With faith in the Name, egotism is eradicated, and all sickness is cured.

1242.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1242.t: nai ma(n)niaai naam uoopajai sahaje sukh paiaa ||
1242.e: Believing in the Name, The Name wells up, and intuitive peace and poise are obtained.

1242.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
1242.t: nai ma(n)niaai saa(n)t uoopajai har ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
1242.e: Believing in the Name, tranquility and peace well up, and the Lord is enshrined in the mind.

1242.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
1242.t: naanak naam rata(n)n hai gurmukh har dhiaaiaa ||11||
1242.e: O Nanak, the Name is a jewel; the Gurmukh meditates on the Lord. ||11||

1242.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1242.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1242.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1242.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਾਂ ॥
1242.t: hor sareek hovai koiee teraa tis agai tudh aakhaa(n) ||
1242.e: If there were any other equal to You, O Lord, I would speak to them of You.

1242.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਅਗੈ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ॥
1242.t: tudh agai tudhai saalaahee mai a(n)dhe naau sujaakhaa ||
1242.e: You, I praise You; I am blind, but through the Name, I am all-seeing.

1242.g: ਜੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੀ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
1242.t: jetaa aakhan saahee sabadhee bhaakhiaa bhai subhaiee ||
1242.e: Whatever is spoken, is the Word of the Shabad. Chanting it with love, we are embellished.

1242.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੋ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
1242.t: naanak bahutaa eho aakhan sabh teree vaddiaaiee ||1||
1242.e: Nanak, this is the greatest thing to say: all glorious greatness is Yours. ||1||

1242.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1242.e: First Mehla:

1242.g: ਜਾਂ ਨ ਸਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਜੰਮੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਰ ॥
1242.t: jaa(n) na siaa kiaa chaakaree jaa(n) ja(n)me kiaa kaar ||
1242.e: When there was nothing, what happened? What happens when one is born?

1242.g: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
1242.t: sabh kaaran karataa kare dhekhai vaaro vaar ||
1242.e: The Creator, the Doer, does all; He watches over all, again and again

1242.g: ਜੇ ਚੁਪੈ ਜੇ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
1242.t: je chupai je ma(n)giaai dhaat kare dhaataar ||
1242.e: . Whether we keep silent or beg out loud, the Great Giver blesses us with His gifts.

1242.g: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
1242.t: eik dhaataa sabh ma(n)gate fir dhekheh aakaar ||
1242.e: The One Lord is the Giver; we are all beggars. I have seen this throughout the Universe.

1242.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
1242.t: naanak evai jaaneeaai jeevai dhevanahaar ||2||
1242.e: Nanak knows this: the Great Giver lives forever. ||2||

1242.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1242.t: pauRee ||
1242.e: Pauree:

1242.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
1242.t: nai ma(n)niaai surat uoopajai naame mat hoiee ||
1242.e: With faith in the Name, intuitive awareness wells up; through the Name, intelligence comes.

1242.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
1242.t: nai ma(n)niaai gun ucharai naame sukh soiee ||
1242.e: With faith in the Name, chant the Glories of God; through the Name, peace is obtained.

1242.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1242.t: nai ma(n)niaai bhram kaTeeaai fir dhukh na hoiee ||
1242.e: With faith in the Name, doubt is eradicated, and the mortal never suffers again.

1242.g: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਮਤਿ ਧੋਈ ॥
1242.t: nai ma(n)niaai saalaaheeaai paapaa(n) mat dhoiee ||
1242.e: With faith in the Name, sing His Praises, and your sinful intellect shall be washed clean.

1242.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧੨॥
1242.t: naanak poore gur te naau ma(n)neeaai jin dhevai soiee ||12||
1242.e: O Nanak, through the Perfect Guru, one comes to have faith in the Name; they alone receive it, unto whom He gives it. ||12||

1242.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1242.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1242.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1242.g: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੜੑੰਤਾ ॥
1242.t: saasatr bedh puraan paR(h)(n)taa ||
1242.e: Some read the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

1242.g: ਪੂਕਾਰੰਤਾ ਅਜਾਣੰਤਾ ॥
1242.t: pookaara(n)taa ajaana(n)taa ||
1242.e: They recite them, out of ignorance.

1242.g: ਜਾਂ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾਂ ਸੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
1242.t: jaa(n) boojhai taa(n) soojhai soiee ||
1242.e: If they really understood them, they would realize the Lord.

1242.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
1242.t: naanak aakhai kook na hoiee ||1||
1242.e: Nanak says, there is no need to shout so loud. ||1||

1242.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1242.e: First Mehla:

1242.g: ਜਾਂ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਹਿ ॥
1242.t: jaa(n) hau teraa taa(n) sabh kichh meraa hau naahee too hoveh ||
1242.e: When I am Yours, then everything is mine. When I am not, You are.

1242.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਕਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਵਹਿ ॥
1242.t: aape sakataa aape surataa sakatee jagat paroveh ||
1242.e: You Yourself are All-powerful, and You Yourself are the Intuitive Knower. The whole world is strung on the Power of Your Shakti.

1242.g: ਆਪੇ ਭੇਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਸਦੇ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
1242.t: aape bheje aape sadhe rachanaa rach rach vekhai ||
1242.e: You Yourself send out the mortal beings, and You Yourself call them back home. Having created the creation, You behold it.

1242.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਂਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
1242.t: naanak sachaa sachee naa(n)iee sach pavai dhur lekhai ||2||
1242.e: O Nanak, True is the Name of the True Lord; through Truth, one is accepted by the Primal Lord God. ||2||

1242.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1242.t: pauRee ||
1242.e: Pauree:

1242.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
1242.t: naam nira(n)jan alakh hai kiau lakhiaa jaiee ||
1242.e: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is unknowable. How can it be known?

1242.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
1242.t: naam nira(n)jan naal hai kiau paieeaai bhaiee ||
1242.e: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is with the mortal being. How can it be obtained, O Siblings of Destiny?

1242.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਂਈ ॥
1242.t: naam nira(n)jan varatadhaa raviaa sabh Thaa(n)iee ||
1242.e: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is all-pervading and permeating everywhere.

1242.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
1242.t: gur poore te paieeaai hiradhai dhei dhikhaiee ||
1242.e: Through the Perfect Guru, it is obtained. It is revealed within the heart.

1242.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
1242.t: naanak nadharee karam hoi gur mileeaai bhaiee ||13||
1242.e: O Nanak, when the Merciful Lord grants His Grace, the mortal meets with the Guru, O Siblings of Desitny. ||13||

1242.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1242.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1242.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1242.g: ਕਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਕੁਤੇ ਮੁਹੀ ਖਾਜੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
1242.t: kal hoiee kute muhee khaaj hoaa muradhaar ||
1242.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, people have faces like dogs; they eat rotting carcasses for food.

1242.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਭਉਕਣਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1242.t: kooR bol bol bhaukanaa chookaa dharam beechaar ||
1242.e: They bark and speak, telling only lies; all thought of righteousness has left them.

1242.g: ਜਿਨ ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆ ਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਮੰਦੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
1242.t: jin jeeva(n)dhiaa pat nahee muiaa ma(n)dhee soi ||
1242.e: Those who have no honor while alive, will have an evil reputation after they die.

1243.g: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
1243.t: likhiaa hovai naanakaa karataa kare su hoi ||1||
1243.e: Whatever is predestined, happens, O Nanak; whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. ||1||

1243.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1243.e: First Mehla:

1243.g: ਰੰਨਾ ਹੋਈਆ ਬੋਧੀਆ ਪੁਰਸ ਹੋਏ ਸਈਆਦ ॥
1243.t: ra(n)naa hoieeaa bodheeaa puras hoe sieeaadh ||
1243.e: Women have become advisors, and men have become hunters.

1243.g: ਸੀਲੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੁਚ ਭੰਨੀ ਖਾਣਾ ਖਾਜੁ ਅਹਾਜੁ ॥
1243.t: seel sa(n)jam such bha(n)nee khaanaa khaaj ahaaj ||
1243.e: Humility, self-control and purity have run away; people eat the uneatable, forbidden food.

1243.g: ਸਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਪਤਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1243.t: saram giaa ghar aapanai pat uTh chalee naal ||
1243.e: Modesty has left her home, and honor has gone away with her.

1243.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
1243.t: naanak sachaa ek hai aaur na sachaa bhaal ||2||
1243.e: O Nanak, there is only One True Lord; do not bother to search for any other as true. ||2||

1243.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1243.t: pauRee ||
1243.e: Pauree:

1243.g: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭਸਮ ਲੇਪਨ ਕਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੀ ॥
1243.t: baahar bhasam lepan kare a(n)tar gubaaree ||
1243.e: You smear your outer body with ashes, but within, you are filled with darkness.

1243.g: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਝੋਲੀ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
1243.t: khi(n)thaa jholee bahu bhekh kare dhuramat aha(n)kaaree ||
1243.e: You wear the patched coat and all the right clothes and robes, but you are still egotistical and proud.

1243.g: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਊਚਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
1243.t: saahib sabadh na uoocharai maiaa moh pasaaree ||
1243.e: You do not chant the Shabad, the Word of Your Lord and Master; you are attached to the expanse of Maya.

1243.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
1243.t: a(n)tar laalach bharam hai bharamai gaavaaree ||
1243.e: Within, you are filled with greed and doubt; you wander around like a fool.

1243.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੧੪॥
1243.t: naanak naam na chetiee jooaai baajee haaree ||14||
1243.e: Says Nanak, you never even think of the Naam; you have lost the game of life in the gamble. ||14||

1243.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1243.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1243.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1243.g: ਲਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਖ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਕਿਆ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਉ ॥
1243.t: lakh siau preet hovai lakh jeevan kiaa khuseeaa kiaa chaau ||
1243.e: You may be in love with tens of thousands, and live for thousands of years; but what good are these pleasures and occupations?

1243.g: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਵਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
1243.t: vichhuRiaa vis hoi vichhoRaa ek ghaRee meh jai ||
1243.e: And when you must separate from them, that separation is like poison, but they will be gone in an instant.

1243.g: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵਰ੍ਹਿਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਖਾਜੈ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਉੜਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
1243.t: je sau varihaa miThaa khaajai bhee fir kauRaa khai ||
1243.e: You may eat sweets for a hundred years, but eventually, you will have to eat the bitter as well.

1243.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਖਾਧਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਕਉੜਤਣੁ ਧਾਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
1243.t: miThaa khaadhaa chit na aavai kauRatan dhai jai ||
1243.e: Then, you will not remember eating the sweets; bitterness will permeate you.

1243.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਉੜਾ ਦੋਵੈ ਰੋਗ ॥
1243.t: miThaa kauRaa dhovai rog ||
1243.e: The sweet and the bitter are both diseases.

1243.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੇ ਭੋਗ ॥
1243.t: naanak a(n)t vigute bhog ||
1243.e: O Nanak, eating them, you will come to ruin in the end.

1243.g: ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਣਾ ਝਗੜਾ ਝਾਖ ॥
1243.t: jhakh jhakh jhakhanaa jhagaRaa jhaakh ||
1243.e: It is useless to worry and struggle to death.

1243.g: ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਝਖਹਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
1243.t: jhakh jhakh jaeh jhakheh tin(h) paas ||1||
1243.e: Entangled in worries and struggles, people exhaust themselves. ||1||

1243.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1243.e: First Mehla:

1243.g: ਕਾਪੜੁ ਕਾਠੁ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਂਗਿ ॥
1243.t: kaapaR kaaTh ra(n)gaiaa raa(n)g ||
1243.e: They have fine clothes and furniture of various colors.

1243.g: ਘਰ ਗਚ ਕੀਤੇ ਬਾਗੇ ਬਾਗ ॥
1243.t: ghar gach keete baage baag ||
1243.e: Their houses are painted beautifully white.

1243.g: ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲਾਇਆ ॥
1243.t: saadh sahaj kar man khelaiaa ||
1243.e: In pleasure and poise, they play their mind games.

1243.g: ਤੈ ਸਹ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥
1243.t: tai seh paasahu kahan kahaiaa ||
1243.e: When they approach You, O Lord, they shall be spoken to.

1243.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕਉੜਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
1243.t: miThaa kar kai kauRaa khaiaa ||
1243.e: They think it is sweet, so they eat the bitter.

1243.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਕਉੜੈ ਤਨਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਜਮਾਇਆ ॥
1243.t: tin kauRai tan rog jamaiaa ||
1243.e: The bitter disease grows in the body.

1243.g: ਜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਿਠਾ ਪੇੜੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
1243.t: je fir miThaa peRai pai ||
1243.e: If, later on, they receive the sweet,

1243.g: ਤਉ ਕਉੜਤਣੁ ਚੂਕਸਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
1243.t: tau kauRatan chookas mai ||
1243.e: then their bitterness shall be gone, O mother.

1243.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
1243.t: naanak gurmukh paavai soi ||
1243.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is blessed to receive

1243.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
1243.t: jis no praapat likhiaa hoi ||2||
1243.e: what he is predestined to receive. ||2||

1243.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1243.t: pauRee ||
1243.e: Pauree:

1243.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਧੋਵਾਇਆ ॥
1243.t: jin kai hiradhai mail kapaT hai baahar dhovaiaa ||
1243.e: Those whose hearts are filled with the filth of deception, may wash themselves on the outside.

1243.g: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
1243.t: kooR kapaT kamaavadhe kooR paragaTee aaiaa ||
1243.e: They practice falsehood and deception, and their falsehood is revealed.

1243.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਨਹ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
1243.t: a(n)dhar hoi su nikalai neh chhapai chhapaiaa ||
1243.e: That which is within them, comes out; it cannot be concealed by concealment.

1243.g: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1243.t: kooRai laalach lagiaa fir joonee paiaa ||
1243.e: Attached to falsehood and greed, the mortal is consigned to reincarnation over and over again.

1243.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
1243.t: naanak jo beejai so khaavanaa karatai likh paiaa ||15||
1243.e: O Nanak, whatever the mortal plants, he must eat. The Creator Lord has written our destiny. ||15||

1243.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
1243.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
1243.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

1243.g: ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਬੇਦਂੀ ਆਣੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1243.t: kathaa kahaanee bedha(n)ee aanee paap pu(n)n beechaar ||
1243.e: The Vedas bring forth stories and legends, and thoughts of vice and virtue.

1243.g: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਲੈਣਾ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਦੇਣਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
1243.t: dhe dhe lainaa lai lai dhenaa narak surag avataar ||
1243.e: What is given, they receive, and what is received, they give. They are reincarnated in heaven and hell.

1243.g: ਉਤਮ ਮਧਿਮ ਜਾਤੀਂ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
1243.t: autam madhim jaatee(n) jinasee bharam bhavai sa(n)saar ||
1243.e: High and low, social class and status - the world wanders lost in superstition.

1243.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਈ ॥
1243.t: a(n)mirat baanee tat vakhaanee giaan dhiaan vich aaiee ||
1243.e: The Ambrosial Word of Gurbani proclaims the essence of reality. Spiritual wisdom and meditation are contained within it.

1243.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਂੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
1243.t: gurmukh aakhee gurmukh jaatee surata(n)ee karam dhiaaiee ||
1243.e: The Gurmukhs chant it, and the Gurmukhs realize it. Intuitively aware, they meditate on it.

1243.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
1243.t: hukam saaj hukamai vich rakhai hukamai a(n)dhar vekhai ||
