1254.t: jehee rut kaiaa sukh tehaa teho jehee dhehee ||
1254.e: As is the season, so is the comfort of the body, and so is the body itself.

1254.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਕੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
1254.t: naanak rut suhaavee saiee bin naavai rut kehee ||4||1||
1254.e: O Nanak, that season is beautiful; without the Name, what season is it? ||4||1||

1254.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1254.t: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
1254.e: Malaar, First Mehla:

1254.g: ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
1254.t: karau binau gur apane preetam har var aan milaavai ||
1254.e: I offer prayers to my Beloved Guru, that He may unite me with my Husband Lord.

1254.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਘਨ ਘੋਰ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਲਾਲ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
1254.t: sun ghan ghor seetal man moraa laal ratee gun gaavai ||1||
1254.e: I hear the thunder in the clouds, and my mind is cooled and soothed; imbued with the Love of my Dear Beloved, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

1254.g: ਬਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ॥
1254.t: baras ghanaa meraa man bheenaa ||
1254.e: The rain pours down, and my mind is drenched with His Love.

1254.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਨੀ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1254.t: a(n)mirat boo(n)dh suhaanee heearai gur mohee man har ras leenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1254.e: The drop of Ambrosial Nectar pleases my heart; the Guru has fascinated my mind, which is drenched in the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1254.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਖੀ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
1254.t: sahaj sukhee var kaaman piaaree jis gur bachanee man maaniaa ||
1254.e: With intuitive peace and poise, the soul-bride is loved by her Husband Lord; her mind is pleased and appeased by the Guru's Teachings.

1254.g: ਹਰਿ ਵਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਭਈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸੁਖਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
1254.t: har var naar bhiee sohaagan man tan prem sukhaaniaa ||2||
1254.e: She is the happy soul-bride of her Husband Lord; her mind and body are filled with joy by His Love. ||2||

1254.g: ਅਵਗਣ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਭਈ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਵਰੁ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
1254.t: avagan tiaag bhiee bairaagan asathir var sohaag haree ||
1254.e: Discarding her demerits, she becomes detached; with the Lord as her Husband, her marriage is eternal.

1254.g: ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥੩॥
1254.t: sog vijog tis kadhe na viaapai har prabh apanee kirapaa karee ||3||
1254.e: She never suffers separation or sorrow; her Lord God showers her with His Grace. ||3||

1254.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥
1254.t: aavan jaan nahee man nihachal poore gur kee oT gahee ||
1254.e: Her mind is steady and stable; she does not come and go in reincarnation.

1254.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਹੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
1254.t: naanak raam naam jap gurmukh dhan sohaagan sach sahee ||4||2||
1254.e: She takes the Shelter of the Perfect Guru. O Nanak, as Gurmukh, chant the Naam; you shall be accepted as the true soul-bride of the Lord. ||4||2||

1254.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1254.t: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
1254.e: Malaar, First Mehla:

1254.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
1254.t: saachee surat naam nahee tirapate haumai karat gavaiaa ||
1254.e: They pretend to understand the Truth, but they are not satisfied by the Naam; they waste their lives in egotism.

1255.g: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1255.t: par dhan par naaree rat ni(n)dhaa bikh khaiee dhukh paiaa ||
1255.e: Caught in slander and attachment to the wealth and women of others, they eat poison and suffer in pain.

1255.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਭੈ ਕਪਟ ਨ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1255.t: sabadh cheen bhai kapaT na chhooTe man mukh maiaa maiaa ||
1255.e: They think about the Shabad, but they are not released from their fear and fraud; the minds and mouths are filled with Maya, Maya.

1255.g: ਅਜਗਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1255.t: ajagar bhaar ladhe at bhaaree mar janame janam gavaiaa ||1||
1255.e: Loading the heavy and crushing load, they die, only to be reborn, and waste their lives again. ||1||

1255.g: ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
1255.t: man bhaavai sabadh suhaiaa ||
1255.e: The Word of the Shabad is so very beautiful; it is pleasing to my mind.

1255.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1255.t: bhram bhram jon bhekh bahu keen(h)e gur raakhe sach paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1255.e: The mortal wanders lost in reincarnation, wearing various robes and clothes; when he is saved and protected by the Guru, then he finds the Truth. ||1||Pause||

1255.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਤੇਜੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਨੑਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1255.t: teerath tej nivaar na n(h)aate har kaa naam na bhaiaa ||
1255.e: He does not try to wash away his angry passions by bathing at sacred shrines. He does not love the Name of the Lord.

1255.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਜਤ ਕੋ ਤਤ ਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
1255.t: ratan padhaarath parahar tiaagiaa jat ko tat hee aaiaa ||
1255.e: He abandons and discards the priceless jewel, and he goes back from where he came.

1255.g: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੀਟ ਭਏ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
1255.t: bisaTaa keeT bhe ut hee te ut hee maeh samaiaa ||
1255.e: And so he becomes a maggot in manure, and in that, he is absorbed.

1255.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਸੁਆਦ ਰੋਗ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1255.t: adhik suaadh rog adhikaiee bin gur sahaj na paiaa ||2||
1255.e: The more he tastes, the more he is diseased; without the Guru, there is no peace and poise. ||2||

1255.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਰਹਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1255.t: sevaa surat rahas gun gaavaa gurmukh giaan beechaaraa ||
1255.e: Focusing my awareness on selfless service, I joyfully sing His Praises. As Gurmukh, I contemplate spiritual wisdom.

1255.g: ਖੋਜੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਾਦੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
1255.t: khojee upajai baadhee binasai hau bal bal gur karataaraa ||
1255.e: The seeker comes forth, and the debater dies down; I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Guru, the Creator Lord.

1255.g: ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਹੋੁਤੇ ਹੀਣਮਤਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਤੂ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1255.t: ham neech huote heenamat jhooThe too sabadh savaaranahaaraa ||
1255.e: I am low and wretched, with shallow and false understanding; You embellish and exalt me through the Word of Your Shabad.

1255.g: ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨਿ ਤਹਾ ਤੂ ਤਾਰਣ ਸਚੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
1255.t: aatam cheen tahaa too taaran sach taare taaranahaaraa ||3||
1255.e: And wherever there is self-realization, You are there; O True Lord Savior, You save us and carry us across. ||3||

1255.g: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਕਥਉ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
1255.t: bais suthaan kahaa(n) gun tere kiaa kiaa kathau apaaraa ||
1255.e: Where should I sit to chant Your Praises; which of Your Infinite Praises should I chant?

1255.g: ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਾਥਾਂ ਨਾਥਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
1255.t: alakh na lakheeaai agam ajonee too(n) naathaa(n) naathanahaaraa ||
1255.e: The Unknown cannot be known; O Inaccessible, Unborn Lord God, You are the Lord and Master of masters.

1255.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਉ ਤੂ ਕੈਸਾ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚਕ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
1255.t: kis peh dhekh kahau too kaisaa sabh jaachak too dhaataaraa ||
1255.e: How can I compare You to anyone else I see? All are beggars - You are the Great Giver.

1255.g: ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
1255.t: bhagatiheen naanak dhar dhekhahu ik naam milai ur dhaaraa ||4||3||
1255.e: Lacking devotion, Nanak looks to Your Door; please bless him with Your One Name, that he may enshrine it in his heart. ||4||3||

1255.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1255.t: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
1255.e: Malaar, First Mehla:

1255.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸਾ ਬਿਲਖ ਬਦਨ ਕੁਮਲਾਨੀ ॥
1255.t: jin dhan pir kaa saadh na jaaniaa saa bilakh badhan kumalaanee ||
1255.e: The soul-bride who has not known delight with her Husband Lord, shall weep and wail with a wretched face.

1255.g: ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
1255.t: bhiee niraasee karam kee faasee bin gur bharam bhulaanee ||1||
1255.e: She becomes hopeless, caught in the noose of her own karma; without the Guru, she wanders deluded by doubt. ||1||

1255.g: ਬਰਸੁ ਘਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
1255.t: baras ghanaa meraa pir ghar aaiaa ||
1255.e: So rain down, O clouds. My Husband Lord has come home.

1255.g: ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਾਂ ਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਣਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1255.t: bal jaavaa(n) gur apane preetam jin har prabh aan milaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1255.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has led me to meet my Lord God. ||1||Pause||

1255.g: ਨਉਤਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
1255.t: nautan preet sadhaa Thaakur siau anadhin bhagat suhaavee ||
1255.e: My love, my Lord and Master is forever fresh; I am embellished with devotional worship night and day.

1255.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵੀ ॥੨॥
1255.t: mukat bhe gur dharas dhikhaiaa jug jug bhagat subhaavee ||2||
1255.e: I am liberated, gazing on the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. Devotional worship has made me glorious and exalted throughout the ages. ||2||

1255.g: ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਜਗੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
1255.t: ham thaare tirabhavan jag tumaraa too meraa hau teraa ||
1255.e: I am Yours; the three worlds are Yours as well. You are mine, and I am Yours.

1255.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
1255.t: satigur miliaai nira(n)jan paiaa bahur na bhavajal feraa ||3||
1255.e: Meeting with the True Guru, I have found the Immaculate Lord; I shall not be consigned to this terrifying world-ocean ever again. ||3||

1255.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪਿਰ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਤਉ ਧਨ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
1255.t: apune pir har dhekh vigaasee tau dhan saach seegaaro ||
1255.e: If the soul-bride is filled with delight on seeing her Husband Lord, then her decorations are true.

1255.g: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਸਚਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥
1255.t: akul nira(n)jan siau sach saachee gurmat naam adhaaro ||4||
1255.e: With the Immaculate Celestial Lord, she becomes the truest of the true. Following the Guru's Teachings, she leans on the Support of the Naam. ||4||

1255.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਈ ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੑੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
1255.t: mukat bhiee ba(n)dhan gur khol(h)e sabadh surat pat paiee ||
1255.e: She is liberated; the Guru has untied her bonds. Focusing her awareness on the Shabad, she attains honor.

1255.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੫॥੪॥
1255.t: naanak raam naam ridh a(n)tar gurmukh mel milaiee ||5||4||
1255.e: O Nanak, the Lord's Name is deep within her heart; as Gurmukh, she is united in His Union. ||5||4||

1255.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਮਲਾਰ ॥
1255.t: mahalaa pehilaa malaar ||
1255.e: First Mehla, Malaar:

1255.g: ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਪਰ ਧਨੁ ਪਰ ਲੋਭਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
1255.t: par dhaaraa par dhan par lobhaa haumai bikhai bikaar ||
1255.e: Others' wives, others' wealth, greed, egotism, corruption and poison;

1255.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਭਾਉ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦ ਪਰਾਈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥
1255.t: dhusaT bhaau taj ni(n)dh paraiee kaam karodh cha(n)ddaar ||1||
1255.e: evil passions, slander of others, sexual desire and anger - give up all these. ||1||

1255.g: ਮਹਲ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
1255.t: mahal meh baiThe agam apaar ||
1255.e: The Inaccessible, Infinite Lord is sitting in His Mansion.

1255.g: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਆਚਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1255.t: bheetar a(n)mrit soiee jan paavai jis gur kaa sabadh ratan aachaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1255.e: That humble being, whose conduct is in harmony with the jewel of the Guru's Shabad, obtains the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

1256.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਦੋਊ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
1256.t: dhukh sukh dhouoo sam kar jaanai buraa bhalaa sa(n)saar ||
1256.e: He sees pleasure and pain as both the same, along with good and bad in the world.

1256.g: ਸੁਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
1256.t: sudh budh surat naam har paieeaai satasa(n)gat gur piaar ||2||
1256.e: Wisdom, understanding and awareness are found in the Name of the Lord. In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, embrace love for the Guru. ||2||

1256.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
1256.t: ahinis laahaa har naam paraapat gur dhaataa dhevanahaar ||
1256.e: Day and night, profit is obtained through the Lord's Name. The Guru, the Giver, has given this gift.

1256.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
1256.t: gurmukh sikh soiee jan paae jis no nadhar kare karataar ||3||
1256.e: That Sikh who becomes Gurmukh obtains it. The Creator blesses him with His Glance of Grace. ||3||

1256.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਮਹਲੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
1256.t: kaiaa mahal ma(n)dhar ghar har kaa tis meh raakhee jot apaar ||
1256.e: The body is a mansion, a temple, the home of the Lord; He has infused His Infinite Light into it.

1256.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੫॥
1256.t: naanak gurmukh mahal bulaieeaai har mele melanahaar ||4||5||
1256.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is invited to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; the Lord unites him in His Union. ||4||5||
Malaar, First Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Know that the creation was formed through air and water;
have no doubt that the body was made through fire.
And if you know where the soul comes from,
you shall be known as a wise religious scholar. ||1||
Who can know the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, O mother?
Without seeing Him, we cannot say anything about Him.

1256.g: ਕਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1256.t: kiaa kar aakh vakhaaneeaai mai ||1|| rahaau ||
1256.e: How can anyone speak and describe Him, O mother? ||1||Pause||
He is high above the sky, and beneath the nether worlds.
How can I speak of Him? Let me understand.

1256.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਹਿਆਇ ॥ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੈਸਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
1256.t: bin jihavaa jo japai hiaai || koiee jaanai kaisaa naau ||2||
1256.e: Who knows what sort of Name is chanted, in the heart, without the tongue? ||2||
Undoubtedly, words fail me.
He alone understands, who is blessed.
Day and night, deep within, he remains lovingly attuned to the Lord.
He is the true person, who is merged in the True Lord. ||3||
If someone of high social standing becomes a selfless servant,

1256.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
1256.t: taa kaa kahanaa kahahu na koi ||
1256.e: then his praises cannot even be expressed.
And if someone from a low social class becomes a selfless servant,
O Nanak, he shall wear shoes of honor. ||4||1||6||
Malaar, First Mehla:
The pain of separation - this is the hungry pain I feel.
Another pain is the attack of the Messenger of Death.

1256.g: ਇਕੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਨਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
1256.t: eik dhukh rog lagai tan dhai ||
1256.e: Another pain is the disease consuming my body.
O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine. ||1||
O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine.
The pain persists, and the body continues to suffer.

1256.g: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਬੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1256.t: aaisaa dhaaroo lagai na beer ||1|| rahaau ||
1256.e: Your medicine has no effect on me. ||1||Pause||
Forgetting his Lord and Master, the mortal enjoys sensual pleasures;
then, disease rises up in his body.
The blind mortal receives his punishment.
O foolish doctor, don't give me medicine. ||2||
The value of sandalwood lies in its fragrance.

1256.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਕਾ ਫਲੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
1256.t: maanas kaa fal ghaT meh saas ||
1256.e: The value of the human lasts only as long as the breath in the body.
When the breath is taken away, the body crumbles into dust.

1256.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
1256.t: taa kai paachhai koi na khai ||3||
1256.e: After that, no one takes any food. ||3||
The mortal's body is golden, and the soul-swan is immaculate and pure,
if even a tiny particle of the Immaculate Naam is within.
All pain and disease are eradicated.
O Nanak, the mortal is saved through the True Name. ||4||2||7||
Malaar, First Mehla:
Pain is the poison. The Lord's Name is the antidote.
Grind it up in the mortar of contentment, with the pestle of charitable giving.

1257.g: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਲੇਹੁ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥
1257.t: nit nit leh na chheejai dheh ||
1257.e: Take it each and every day, and your body shall not waste away.
At the very last instant, you shall strike down the Messenger of Death. ||1||
So take such medicine, O fool,

1257.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1257.t: jit khaadhai tere jaeh vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1257.e: by which your corruption shall be taken away. ||1||Pause||
Power, wealth and youth are all just shadows,
as are the vehicles you see moving around.

1257.g: ਦੇਹ ਨ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਾਤਿ ॥
1257.t: dheh na naau na hovai jaat ||
1257.e: Neither your body, nor your fame, nor your social status shall go along with you.
In the next world it is day, while here, it is all night. ||2||

1257.g: ਸਾਦ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਧਾਂ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਘਿਉ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
1257.t: saadh kar samadhaa(n) tirasanaa ghiau tel ||
1257.e: Let your taste for pleasures be the firewood, let your greed be the ghee,
and your sexual desire and anger the cooking oil; burn them in the fire.
Some make burnt offerings, hold sacred feasts, and read the Puraanas.
Whatever pleases God is acceptable. ||3||
Intense meditation is the paper, and Your Name is the insignia.
Those for whom this treasure is ordered,
look wealthy when they reach their true home.
O Nanak, blessed is that mother who gave birth to them. ||4||3||8||
Malaar, First Mehla:
You wear white clothes, and speak sweet words.
Your nose is sharp, and your eyes are black.
Have you ever seen your Lord and Master, O sister? ||1||

1257.g: ਊਡਾਂ ਊਡਿ ਚੜਾਂ ਅਸਮਾਨਿ ॥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਾਣਿ ॥
1257.t: uooddaa(n) uoodd chaRaa(n) asamaan || saahib sa(n)mrith terai taan ||
1257.e: O my All-powerful Lord and Master, by Your power, I fly and soar, and ascend to the heavens.
I see Him in the water, on the land, in the mountains, on the river-banks,
in all places and interspaces, O brother. ||2||

1257.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਦੀਏ ਨਾਲਿ ਖੰਭ ॥
1257.t: jin tan saaj dhe'ee naal kha(n)bh ||
1257.e: He fashioned the body, and gave it wings;
He gave it great thirst and desire to fly.
When He bestows His Glance of Grace, I am comforted and consoled.
As He makes me see, so do I see, O brother. ||3||

1257.g: ਨ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਜਾਇਗਾ ਨ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਖੰਭ ॥
1257.t: n ih tan jaigaa na jaahige kha(n)bh ||
1257.e: Neither this body, nor its wings, shall go to the world hereafter.
It is a fusion of air, water and fire.

1257.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਪੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੀਰੁ ॥
1257.t: naanak karam hovai japeeaai kar gur peer ||
1257.e: O Nanak, if it is in the mortal's karma, then he meditates on the Lord, with the Guru as his Spiritual Teacher.
This body is absorbed in the Truth. ||4||4||9||

1257.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
1257.e: Malaar, Third Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1257.g: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
1257.t: nira(n)kaar aakaar hai aape aape bharam bhulaae ||
1257.e: The Formless Lord is formed by Himself. He Himself deludes in doubt.

1257.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
1257.t: kar kar karataa aape vekhai jit bhaavai tit laae ||
1257.e: Creating the Creation, the Creator Himself beholds it; He enjoins us as He pleases.

1257.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਏਹਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਏ ॥੧॥
1257.t: sevak kau ehaa vaddiaaiee jaa kau hukam manaae ||1||
1257.e: This is the true greatness of His servant, that he obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command. ||1||

1257.g: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
1257.t: aapanaa bhaanaa aape jaanai gur kirapaa te laheeaai ||
1257.e: Only He Himself knows His Will. By Guru's Grace, it is grasped.

1257.g: ਏਹਾ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1257.t: ehaa sakat sivai ghar aavai jeevadhiaa mar raheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
1257.e: When this play of Shiva and Shakti comes to his home, he remains dead while yet alive. ||1||Pause||

1257.g: ਵੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸਾ ॥
1257.t: vedh paRai paR vaadh vakhaanai brahamaa bisan mahesaa ||
1257.e: They read the Vedas, and read them again, and engage in arguments about Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.

1257.g: ਏਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਸਹਸਾ ॥
1257.t: eh tiragun maiaa jin jagat bhulaiaa janam maran kaa sahasaa ||
1257.e: This three-phased Maya has deluded the whole world into cynicism about death and birth.

1257.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਹੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥
1257.t: gur parasaadhee eko jaanai chookai manahu a(n)dhesaa ||2||
1257.e: By Guru's Grace, know the One Lord, and the anxiety of your mind will be allayed. ||2||

1257.g: ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
1257.t: ham dheen moorakh aveechaaree tum chi(n)taa karahu hamaaree ||
1257.e: I am meek, foolish and thoughtless, but still, You take care of me.

1257.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਾ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
1257.t: hoh dhiaal kar dhaas dhaasaa kaa sevaa karee tumaaree ||
1257.e: Please be kind to me, and make me the slave of Your slaves, so that I may serve You.

1257.g: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਤੂ ਅਪਣਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
1257.t: ek nidhaan dheh too apanaa ahinis naam vakhaanee ||3||
1257.e: Please bless me with the treasure of the One Name, that I may chant it, day and night. ||3||

1257.g: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
1257.t: kahat naanak gur parasaadhee boojhahu koiee aaisaa kare veechaaraa ||
1257.e: Says Nanak, by Guru's Grace, understand. Hardly anyone considers this.

1257.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਊਪਰਿ ਫੇਨੁ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
1257.t: jiau jal uoopar fen budhabudhaa taisaa ih sa(n)saaraa ||
1257.e: Like foam bubbling up on the surface of the water, so is this world.

1258.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਚੂਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
1258.t: jis te hoaa tiseh samaanaa chook giaa paasaaraa ||4||1||
1258.e: It shall eventually merge back into that from which it came, and all its expanse shall be gone. ||4||1||

1258.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1258.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
1258.e: Malaar, Third Mehla:

1258.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
1258.t: jinee hukam pachhaaniaa se mele haumai sabadh jalai ||
1258.e: Those who realize the Hukam of the Lord's Command are united with Him; through the Word of His Shabad, their egotism is burnt away.

1258.g: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
1258.t: sachee bhagat kareh dhin raatee sach rahe liv lai ||
1258.e: They perform true devotional worship day and night; they remain lovingly attuned to the True Lord.

1258.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖਦੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
1258.t: sadhaa sach har vekhadhe gur kai sabadh subhai ||1||
1258.e: They gaze on their True Lord forever, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, with loving ease. ||1||

1258.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1258.t: man re hukam ma(n)n sukh hoi ||
1258.e: O mortal, accept His Will and find peace.

1258.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1258.t: prabh bhaanaa apanaa bhaavadhaa jis bakhase tis bighan na koi ||1|| rahaau ||
1258.e: God is pleased by the Pleasure of His Own Will. Whomever He forgives, meets no obstacles on the way. ||1||Pause||

1258.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
1258.t: trai gun sabhaa dhaat hai naa har bhagat na bhai ||
1258.e: Under the influence of the three gunas, the three dispositions, the mind wanders everywhere, without love or devotion to the Lord.

1258.g: ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
1258.t: gat mukat kadhe na hoviee haumai karam kamaeh ||
1258.e: No one is ever saved or liberated, by doing deeds in ego.

1258.g: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
1258.t: saahib bhaavai so theeaai piaai kirat firaeh ||2||
1258.e: Whatever our Lord and Master wills, comes to pass. People wander according to their past actions. ||2||

1258.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
1258.t: satigur bheTiaai man mar rahai har naam vasai man aai ||
1258.e: Meeting with the True Guru, the mind is overpowered; the Lord's Name comes to abide in the mind.

1258.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1258.t: tis kee keemat naa pavai kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||
1258.e: The value of such a person cannot be estimated; nothing at all can be said about him.

1258.g: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
1258.t: chauthai padh vaasaa hoiaa sachai rahai samai ||3||
1258.e: He comes to dwell in the fourth state; he remains merged in the True Lord. ||3||

1258.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਹੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1258.t: meraa har prabh agam agochar hai keemat kahan na jai ||
1258.e: My Lord God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. His value cannot be expressed.

1258.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
1258.t: gur parasaadhee bujheeaai sabadhe kaar kamai ||
1258.e: By Guru's Grace, he comes to understand, and live the Shabad.

1258.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
1258.t: naanak naam salaeh too har har dhar sobhaa pai ||4||2||
1258.e: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||4||2||

1258.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1258.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
1258.e: Malaar, Third Mehla:

1258.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
1258.t: gurmukh koiee viralaa boojhai jis no nadhar karei ||
1258.e: Rare is that person who, as Gurmukh, understands; the Lord has bestowed His Glance of Grace.

1258.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਖਸੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
1258.t: gur bin dhaataa koiee naahee bakhase nadhar karei ||
1258.e: There is no Giver except the Guru. He grants His Grace and forgives.

1258.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਇ ॥੧॥
1258.t: gur miliaai saa(n)t uoopajai anadhin naam lei ||1||
1258.e: Meeting the Guru, peace and tranquility well up; chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. ||1||

1258.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
1258.t: mere man har a(n)mirat naam dhiaai ||
1258.e: O my mind, meditate on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

1258.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1258.t: satigur purakh milai naau paieeaai har naame sadhaa samai ||1|| rahaau ||
1258.e: Meeting with the True Guru and the Primal Being, the Name is obtained, and one remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

1258.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1258.t: manmukh sadhaa vichhuRe fireh koi na kis hee naal ||
1258.e: The self-willed manmukhs are forever separated from the Lord; no one is with them.

1258.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
1258.t: haumai vaddaa rog hai sir maare jamakaal ||
1258.e: They are stricken with the great disease of egotism; they are hit on the head by the Messenger of Death.

1258.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
1258.t: gurmat satasa(n)gat na vichhuReh anadhin naam sam(h)aal ||2||
1258.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings are never separated from the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. They dwell on the Naam, night and day. ||2||

1258.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1258.t: sabhanaa karataa ek too nit kar dhekheh veechaar ||
1258.e: You are the One and Only Creator of all. You continually create, watch over and contemplate.

1258.g: ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
1258.t: eik gurmukh aap milaiaa bakhase bhagat bha(n)ddaar ||
1258.e: Some are Gurmukh - You unite them with Yourself. You bless then with the treasure of devotion.

1258.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰੀ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
1258.t: too aape sabh kichh jaanadhaa kis aagai karee pookaar ||3||
1258.e: You Yourself know everything. Unto whom should I complain? ||3||

1258.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
1258.t: har har naam a(n)mrit hai nadharee paiaa jai ||
1258.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. By the Lord's Grace, it is obtained.

1258.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
1258.t: anadhin har har ucharai gur kai sahaj subhai ||
1258.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, night and day, the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru is obtained.

1258.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
1258.t: naanak naam nidhaan hai naame hee chit lai ||4||3||
1258.e: O Nanak, the Naam is the greatest treasure. Focus your consciousness on the Naam. ||4||3||

1258.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1258.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
1258.e: Malaar, Third Mehla:

1258.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
1258.t: gur saalaahee sadhaa sukhadhaataa prabh naarain soiee ||
1258.e: I praise the Guru, the Giver of peace, forever. He truly is the Lord God.

1258.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਈ ॥
1258.t: gur parasaadh param padh paiaa vaddee vaddiaaiee hoiee ||
1258.e: By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. His glorious greatness is glorious!

1258.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
1258.t: anadhin gun gaavai nit saache sach samaavai soiee ||1||
1258.e: One who sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord, merges in the True Lord. ||1||

1258.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1258.t: man re gurmukh ridhai veechaar ||
1258.e: O mortal, contemplate the Guru's Word in your heart.

1258.g: ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਚਲਣੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1258.t: taj kooR kuTa(n)b haumai bikh tirasanaa chalan ridhai sam(h)aal ||1|| rahaau ||
1258.e: Abandon your false family, poisonous egotism and desire; remember in your heart, that you will have to leave. ||1||Pause||

1258.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1258.t: satigur dhaataa raam naam kaa hor dhaataa koiee naahee ||
1258.e: The True Guru is the Giver of the Lord's Name. There is no other giver at all.

1259.g: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥
1259.t: jeea dhaan dhei tirapataase sachai naam samaahee ||
1259.e: Bestowing the gift of the soul, He satisfies the mortal beings, and merges them in the True Name.

1259.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
1259.t: anadhin har raviaa ridh a(n)tar sahaj samaadh lagaahee ||2||
1259.e: Night and day, they ravish and enjoy the Lord within the heart; they are intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi. ||2||

1259.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੇਦਿਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1259.t: satigur sabadhee ih man bhedhiaa hiradhai saachee baanee ||
1259.e: The Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, has pierced my mind. The True Word of His Bani permeates my heart.

1259.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
1259.t: meraa prabh alakh na jaiee lakhiaa gurmukh akath kahaanee ||
1259.e: My God is Unseen; He cannot be seen. The Gurmukh speaks the Unspoken.

1259.g: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥੩॥
1259.t: aape dhiaa kare sukhadhaataa japeeaai saari(n)gapaanee ||3||
1259.e: When the Giver of peace grants His Grace, the mortal being meditates on the Lord, the Life of the Universe. ||3||

1259.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
1259.t: aavan jaanaa bahuR na hovai gurmukh sahaj dhiaaiaa ||
1259.e: He does not come and go in renicarnation any longer; the Gurmukh meditates intuitively.

1259.g: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਨੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
1259.t: man hee te man miliaa suaamee man hee ma(n)n samaiaa ||
1259.e: From the mind, the mind merges into our Lord and Master; the mind is absorbed into the Mind.

1259.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
1259.t: saache hee sach saach pateejai vichahu aap gavaiaa ||4||
1259.e: In truth, the True Lord is pleased with truth; eradicate egotism from within yourself. ||4||

1259.g: ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
1259.t: eko ek vasai man suaamee dhoojaa avar na koiee ||
1259.e: Our One and Only Lord and Master dwells within the mind; there is no other at all.

1259.g: ਏਕੋੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਜਗਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
1259.t: ekuo naam a(n)mrit hai meeThaa jag niramal sach soiee ||
1259.e: The One Name is Sweet Ambrosial Nectar; it is Immaculate Truth in the world.

1259.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੪॥
1259.t: naanak naam prabhoo te paieeaai jin kau dhur likhiaa hoiee ||5||4||
1259.e: O Nanak, the Name of God is obtained, by those who are so predestined. ||5||4||

1259.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1259.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
1259.e: Malaar, Third Mehla:

1259.g: ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1259.t: gan ga(n)dharab naame sabh udhare gur kaa sabadh veechaar ||
1259.e: All the heavenly heralds and celestial singers are saved through the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1259.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਦ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1259.t: haumai maar sadh ma(n)n vasaiaa har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
1259.e: They contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. Subduing their ego, the Name abides in their minds; they keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts.

1259.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
1259.t: jiseh bujhaae soiee boojhai jis no aape le milai ||
1259.e: He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand; the Lord unites him with Himself.

1259.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੇ ਗਾਂਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
1259.t: anadhin baanee sabadhe gaa(n)vai saach rahai liv lai ||1||
1259.e: Night and day, he sings the Word of the Shabad and the Guru's Bani; he remains lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||1||

1259.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
1259.t: man mere khin khin naam sam(h)aal ||
1259.e: O my mind, each and every moment, dwell on the Naam.

1259.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਖੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1259.t: gur kee dhaat sabadh sukh a(n)tar sadhaa nibahai terai naal ||1|| rahaau ||
1259.e: The Shabad is the Guru's Gift. It shall bring you lasting peace deep within; it shall always stand by you. ||1||Pause||

1259.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
1259.t: manmukh paakha(n)dd kadhe na chookai dhoojai bhai dhukh paae ||
1259.e: The self-willed manmukhs never give up their hypocrisy; in the love of duality, they suffer in pain.

1259.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
1259.t: naam visaar bikhiaa man raate birathaa janam gavaae ||
1259.e: Forgetting the Naam, their minds are imbued with corruption. They waste away their lives uselessly.

1259.g: ਇਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ॥
1259.t: eeh velaa fir hath na aavai anadhin sadhaa pachhutaae ||
1259.e: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; night and day, they shall always regret and repent.

1259.g: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
1259.t: mar mar janamai kadhe na boojhai visaTaa maeh samaae ||2||
1259.e: They die and die again and again, only to be reborn, but they never understand. They rot away in manure. ||2||

1259.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1259.t: gurmukh naam rate se udhare gur kaa sabadh veechaar ||
1259.e: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the Naam, and are saved; they contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1259.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1259.t: jeevan mukat har naam dhiaaiaa har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
1259.e: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, they are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive. They enshrine the Lord within their hearts.

1259.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
1259.t: man tan niramal niramal mat uootam uootam baanee hoiee ||
1259.e: Their minds and bodies are immaculate, their intellect is immaculate and sublime. Their speech is sublime as well.

1259.g: ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
1259.t: eko purakh ek prabh jaataa dhoojaa avar na koiee ||3||
1259.e: They realize the One Primal Being, the One Lord God. There is no other at all. ||3||

1259.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
1259.t: aape kare karaae prabh aape aape nadhar karei ||
1259.e: God Himself is the Doer, and He Himself is the Cause of causes. He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

1259.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮੇਇ ॥
1259.t: man tan raataa gur kee baanee sevaa surat samei ||
1259.e: My mind and body are imbued with the Word of the Guru's Bani. My consciousness is immersed in His service.

1259.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਇ ॥
1259.t: a(n)tar vasiaa alakh abhevaa gurmukh hoi lakhai ||
1259.e: The Unseen and Inscrutable Lord dwells deep within. He is seen only by the Gurmukh.

1259.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
1259.t: naanak jis bhaavai tis aape dhevai bhaavai tivai chalai ||4||5||
1259.e: O Nanak, He gives to whomever He pleases. According to the Pleasure of His Will, He leads the mortals on. ||4||5||

1259.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ॥
1259.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa dhutuke ||
1259.e: Malaar, Third Mehla, Dho-Thukay:

1259.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
1259.t: satigur te paavai ghar dhar mahalu su thaan ||
1259.e: Through the True Guru, the mortal obtains the special place, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence in his own home.

1259.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
1259.t: gur sabadhee chookai abhimaan ||1||
1259.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, his egotistical pride is dispelled. ||1||

1259.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
1259.t: jin kau lilaaT likhiaa dhur naam ||
1259.e: Those who have the Naam inscribed on their foreheads,

1259.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1259.t: anadhin naam sadhaa sadhaa dhiaaveh saachee dharageh paaveh maan ||1|| rahaau ||
1259.e: meditate on the Naam night and day, forever and ever. They are honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1259.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
1259.t: man kee bidh satigur te jaanai anadhin laagai sadh har siau dhiaan ||
1259.e: From the True Guru, they learn the ways and means of the mind. Night and day, they focus their meditation on the Lord forever.

1260.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਾਚੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
1260.t: gur sabadh rate sadhaa bairaagee har dharageh saachee paaveh maan ||2||
1260.e: Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they remain forever detached. They are honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||

1260.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਹੁਕਮ ਕਾ ਬਾਧਾ ਇਕ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
1260.t: eih man khelai hukam kaa baadhaa ik khin meh dheh dhis fir aavai ||
1260.e: This mind plays, subject to the Lord's Will; in an instant, it wanders out in the ten directions and returns home again.

1260.g: ਜਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਂ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਵਸਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
1260.t: jaa(n) aape nadhar kare har prabh saachaa taa(n) ih man gurmukh tatakaal vas aavai ||3||
1260.e: When the True Lord God Himself bestows His Glance of Grace, then this mind is instantly brought under control by the Gurmukh. ||3||

1260.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਹੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1260.t: eis man kee bidh man hoo jaanai boojhai sabadh veechaar ||
1260.e: The mortal comes to know the ways and means of the mind, realizing and contemplating the Shabad.

1260.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੬॥
1260.t: naanak naam dhiaai sadhaa too bhav saagar jit paaveh paar ||4||6||
1260.e: O Nanak, meditate forever on the Naam, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||6||

1260.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1260.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
1260.e: Malaar, Third Mehla:

1260.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
1260.t: jeeau pi(n)dd praan sabh tis ke ghaT ghaT rahiaa samaiee ||
1260.e: Soul, body and breath of life are all His; He is permeating and pervading each and every heart.

1260.g: ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥
1260.t: ekas bin mai avar na jaanaa satigur dheeaa bujhaiee ||1||
1260.e: Except the One Lord, I do not know any other at all. The True Guru has revealed this to me. ||1||

1260.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
1260.t: man mere naam rahau liv laiee ||
1260.e: O my mind, remain lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1260.g: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1260.t: adhisaT agochar apara(n)par karataa gur kai sabadh har dhiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1260.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I meditate on the Lord, the Unseen, Unfathomable and Infinite Creator. ||1||Pause||

1260.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
1260.t: man tan bheejai ek liv laagai sahaje rahe samaiee ||
1260.e: Mind and body are pleased, lovingly attuned to the One Lord, intuitively absorbed in peace and poise.

1260.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ਏਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
1260.t: gur parasaadhee bhram bhau bhaagai ek naam liv laiee ||2||
1260.e: By Guru's Grace, doubt and fear are dispelled, being lovingly attuned to the One Name. ||2||

1260.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
1260.t: gur bachanee sach kaar kamaavai gat mat tab hee paiee ||
1260.e: When the mortal follows the Guru's Teachings, and lives the Truth, then he attains the state of emancipation.

1260.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
1260.t: koT madhe kiseh bujhaae tin raam naam liv laiee ||3||
1260.e: Among millions, how rare is that one who understands, and is lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord. ||3||

1260.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਇਹ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
1260.t: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh eko soiee ieh gurmat budh paiee ||
1260.e: Wherever I look, there I see the One. This understanding has come through the Guru's Teachings.

1260.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਰਂੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
1260.t: man tan praan dhara(n)ee tis aagai naanak aap gavaiee ||4||7||
1260.e: I place my mind, body and breath of life in offering before Him; O Nanak, self-conceit is gone. ||4||7||

1260.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1260.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
1260.e: Malaar, Third Mehla:

1260.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
1260.t: meraa prabh saachaa dhookh nivaaran sabadhe paiaa jaiee ||
1260.e: My True Lord God, the Eradicator of suffering, is found through the Word of the Shabad.

1260.g: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
1260.t: bhagatee raate sadh bairaagee dhar saachai pat paiee ||1||
1260.e: Imbued with devotional worship, the mortal remains forever detached. He is honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||1||

1260.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਉ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
1260.t: man re man siau rahau samaiee ||
1260.e: O mind, remain absorbed in the Mind.

1260.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1260.t: gurmukh raam naam man bheejai har setee liv laiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1260.e: The mind of the Gurmukh is pleased with the Lord's Name, lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1260.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
1260.t: meraa prabh at agam agochar gurmat dhei bujhaiee ||
1260.e: My God is totally Inaccessible and Unfathomable; through the Guru's Teachings, He is understood.

1260.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
1260.t: sach sa(n)jam karanee har keerat har setee liv laiee ||2||
1260.e: True self-discipline rests in singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||2||

1260.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
1260.t: aape sabadh sach saakhee aape jin(h) jotee jot milaiee ||
1260.e: He Himself is the Shabad, and He Himself is the True Teachings; He merges our light into the Light.

1260.g: ਦੇਹੀ ਕਾਚੀ ਪਉਣੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
1260.t: dhehee kaachee paun vajaae gurmukh a(n)mrit paiee ||3||
1260.e: The breath vibrates through this frail body; the Gurmukh obtains the ambrosial nectar. ||3||

1260.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਭ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
1260.t: aape saaje sabh kaarai laae so sach rahiaa samaiee ||
1260.e: He Himself fashions, and He Himself links us to our tasks; the True Lord is pervading everywhere.

1260.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
1260.t: naanak naam binaa koiee kichh naahee naame dhei vaddaiee ||4||8||
1260.e: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no one is anything. Through the Naam,we are blessed with glory. ||4||8||

1260.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1260.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
1260.e: Malaar, Third Mehla:

1260.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਲਦਿਆ ਅਜਗਰ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
1260.t: haumai bikh man mohiaa ladhiaa ajagar bhaaree ||
1260.e: The mortal is enticed by the poison of corruption, burdened with such a heavy load.

1260.g: ਗਰੁੜੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
1260.t: garuR sabadh mukh paiaa haumai bikh har maaree ||1||
1260.e: The Lord has placed the magic spell of the Shabad into his mouth, and destroyed the poison of ego. ||1||

1260.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
1260.t: man re haumai moh dhukh bhaaree ||
1260.e: O mortal, egotism and attachment are such heavy loads of pain.

1260.g: ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤਰਣਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1260.t: eih bhavajal jagat na jaiee taranaa gurmukh tar har taaree ||1|| rahaau ||
1260.e: This terrifying world-ocean cannot be crossed; through the Lord's Name, the Gurmukh crosses over to the other side. ||1||Pause||

1260.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਆਕਾਰੀ ॥
1260.t: trai gun maiaa moh pasaaraa sabh varatai aakaaree ||
1260.e: Attachment to the three-phased show of Maya pervades all the created forms.

1260.g: ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
1260.t: tureeaa gun satasa(n)gat paieeaai nadharee paar utaaree ||2||
1260.e: In the Sat Sangat, the Society of the Saints, the state of supreme awareness is attained. The Merciful Lord carries us across. ||2||

1260.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਹਕਾਰਿ ॥
1260.t: cha(n)dhan ga(n)dh suga(n)dh hai bahu baasanaa bahakaar ||
1260.e: The smell of sandalwood is so sublime; its fragrance spreads out far and wide.

1261.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਊਤਮ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
1261.t: har jan karanee uootam hai har keerat jag bisathaar ||3||
1261.e: The lifestyle of the Lord's humble servant is exalted and sublime. He spreads the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises throughout the world. ||3||

1261.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1261.t: kirapaa kirapaa kar Thaakur mere har har har ur dhaar ||
1261.e: O my Lord and Master, please be merciful, merciful to me, that I may enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, Har, within my heart.

1261.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੯॥
1261.t: naanak satigur pooraa paiaa man japiaa naam muraar ||4||9||
1261.e: Nanak has found the Perfect True Guru; in his mind, he chants the Name of the Lord. ||4||9||
Malaar, Third Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1261.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
1261.t: eih man girahee k ih man udhaasee ||
1261.e: Is this mind a householder, or is this mind a detached renunciate?

1261.g: ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਵਰਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
1261.t: k ih man avaran sadhaa avinaasee ||
1261.e: Is this mind beyond social class, eternal and unchanging?

1261.g: ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
1261.t: k ih man cha(n)chal k ih man bairaagee ||
1261.e: Is this mind fickle, or is this mind detached?

1261.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
1261.t: eis man kau mamataa kithahu laagee ||1||
1261.e: How has this mind been gripped by possessiveness? ||1||

1261.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1261.t: pa(n)ddit is man kaa karahu beechaar ||
1261.e: O Pandit, O religious scholar, reflect on this in your mind.

1261.g: ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਉਠਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1261.t: avar k bahutaa paReh uThaaveh bhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
1261.e: Why do you read so many other things, and carry such a heavy load? ||1||Pause||
The Creator has attached it to Maya and possessiveness.
Enforcing His Order, He created the world.
By Guru's Grace, understand this, O Siblings of Destiny.
Remain forever in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||

1261.g: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋ ਤਿਹਾਂ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੀ ਪੰਡ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
1261.t: so pa(n)ddit jo tihaa(n) gunaa kee pa(n)dd utaarai ||
1261.e: He alone is a Pandit, who sheds the load of the three qualities.
Night and day, he chants the Name of the One Lord.
He accepts the Teachings of the True Guru.
He offers his head to the True Guru.
He remains forever unattached in the state of Nirvaanaa.
Such a Pandit is accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
He preaches that the One Lord is within all beings.

1261.g: ਜਾਂ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਾਂ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
1261.t: jaa(n) eko vekhai taa(n) eko jaanai ||
1261.e: As he sees the One Lord, he knows the One Lord.
That person, whom the Lord forgives, is united with Him.
He finds eternal peace, here and hereafter. ||4||

1261.g: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
1261.t: kahat naanak kavan bidh kare kiaa koi ||
1261.e: Says Nanak, what can anyone do?

1261.g: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
1261.t: soiee mukat jaa kau kirapaa hoi ||
1261.e: He alone is liberated, whom the Lord blesses with His Grace.
Night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

1261.g: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੦॥
1261.t: saasatr bedh kee fir kook na hoi ||5||1||10||
1261.e: Then, he no longer bothers with the proclamations of the Shaastras or the Vedas. ||5||1||10||
Malaar, Third Mehla:
The self-willed manmukhs wander lost in reincarnation, confused and deluded by doubt.
The Messenger of Death constantly beats them and disgraces them.

1261.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥
1261.t: satigur sevaa jam kee kaan chukaiee ||
1261.e: Serving the True Guru, the mortal's subservience to Death is ended.

1261.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
1261.t: har prabh miliaa mahal ghar paiee ||1||
1261.e: He meets the Lord God, and enters the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||
O mortal, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1261.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਇਆ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1261.t: janam padhaarath dhubidhaa khoiaa kauddee badhalai jai ||1|| rahaau ||
1261.e: In duality, you are ruining and wasting this priceless human life. You trade it away in exchange for a shell. ||1||Pause||
The Gurmukh falls in love with the Lord, by His Grace.

1261.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
1261.t: a(n)tar bhagat har har ur dhaar ||
1261.e: He enshrines loving devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, deep within his heart.
The Word of the Shabad carries him across the terrifying world-ocean.
He appears true in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||

1261.g: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1261.t: bahu karam kare satigur nahee paiaa ||
1261.e: Performing all sorts of rituals, they do not find the True Guru.

1261.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1261.t: bin gur bharam bhoole bahu maiaa ||
1261.e: Without the Guru, so many wander lost and confused in Maya.
Egotism, possessiveness and attachment rise up and increase within them.
In the love of dualty, the self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain. ||3||
The Creator Himself is Inaccessible and Infinite.
Chant the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and earn the true profit.
The Lord is Independent, Ever-present, here and now.

1262.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in the Naam. ||4||2||11||
Malaar, Third Mehla:
Those who are attached to the Guru's Teachings, are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive.

1262.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
1262.t: har kee bhagat anadhin sadh jaage ||
1262.e: They remain forever awake and aware night and day, in devotional worship of the Lord.
They serve the True Guru, and eradicate their self-conceit.

1262.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
1262.t: hau tin jan ke sadh laagau pai ||1||
1262.e: I fall at the feet of such humble beings. ||1||

1262.g: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
1262.t: hau jeevaa(n) sadhaa har ke gun gaiee ||
1262.e: Constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I live.

1262.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1262.t: gur kaa sabadh mahaa ras meeThaa har kai naam mukat gat paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1262.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is such totally sweet elixir. Through the Name of the Lord, I have attained the state of liberation. ||1||Pause||
Attachment to Maya leads to the darkness of ignorance.
The self-willed manukhs are attached, foolish and ignorant.
Night and day, their lives pass away in worldly entanglements.
They die and die again and again, only to be reborn and receive their punishment. ||2||
The Gurmukh is lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord.
He does not cling to false greed.
Whatever he does, he does with intuitive poise.
He drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; his tongue delights in its flavor. ||3||
Among millions, hardly any understand.
The Lord Himself forgives, and bestows His glorious greatness.

1262.g: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1262.t: jo dhur miliaa su vichhuR na jaiee ||
1262.e: Whoever meets with the Primal Lord God, shall never be separated again.
Nanak is absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||12||
Malaar, Third Mehla:
Everyone speaks the Name of the Lord with the tongue.
But only by serving the True Guru does the mortal receive the Name.
His bonds are shattered, and he stays in the house of liberation.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he sits in the eternal, unchanging house. ||1||
O my mind, why are you angry?

1262.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1262.t: laahaa kalajug raam naam hai gurmat anadhin hiradhai raveejai ||1|| rahaau ||
1262.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the source of profit. Contemplate and appreciate the Guru's Teachings within your heart, night and day. ||1||Pause||
Each and every instant, the rainbird cries and calls.

1262.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
1262.t: bin pir dhekhe na(n)eedh na pai ||
1262.e: Without seeing her Beloved, she does not sleep at all.
She cannot endure this separation.
When she meets the True Guru, then she intuitively meets her Beloved. ||2||
Lacking the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal suffers and dies.
He is burnt in the fire of desire, and his hunger does not depart.

1262.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
1262.t: vin bhaagaa naam na paiaa jai ||
1262.e: Without good destiny, he cannot find the Naam.
He performs all sorts of rituals until he is exhausted. ||3||
The mortal thinks about the Vedic teachings of the three gunas, the three dispositions.
He deals in corruption, filth and vice.
He dies, only to be reborn; he is ruined over and over again.
The Gurmukh enshrines the glory of the supreme state of celestial peace. ||4||
One who has faith in the Guru - everyone has faith in him.
Through the Guru's Word, the mind is cooled and soothed.

1262.g: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
1262.t: chahu jug sobhaa niramal jan soi ||
1262.e: Throughout the four ages, that humble being is known to be pure.
O Nanak, that Gurmukh is so rare. ||5||4||13||9||13||22||

1262.t: raag malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
1262.e: Raag Malaar, Fourth Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1262.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
1262.t: anadhin har har dhiaaio hiradhai mat gurmat dhookh visaaree ||
1262.e: Night and day, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart; through the Guru's Teachings, my pain is forgotten.

1262.g: ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
1262.t: sabh aasaa manasaa ba(n)dhan tooTe har har prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||1||
1262.e: The chains of all my hopes and desires have been snapped; my Lord God has showered me with His Mercy. ||1||
My eyes gaze eternally on the Lord, Har, Har.

1262.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਓ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1262.t: satigur dhekh meraa man bigasio jan har bheTio banavaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
1262.e: Gazing on the True Guru, my mind blossoms forth. I have met with the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

1263.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਲਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਗਾਰੀ ॥
1263.t: jin aaisaa naam visaariaa meraa har har tis kai kul laagee gaaree ||
1263.e: One who forgets such a Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his family is dishonored.

1263.g: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਲਿ ਪਰਸੂਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਧਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
1263.t: har tis kai kul parasoot na kareeahu tis bidhavaa kar mahataaree ||2||
1263.e: His family is sterile and barren, and his mother is made a widow. ||2||

1263.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
1263.t: har har aan milaavahu gur saadhoo jis ahinis har ur dhaaree ||
1263.e: O Lord, let me meet the Holy Guru, who night and day keep the Lord enshrined in his heart.

1263.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਡੀਠੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
1263.t: gur ddeeThai gur kaa sikh bigasai jiau baarik dhekh mahataaree ||3||
1263.e: Seeing the Guru, the GurSikh blossoms forth, like the child seeing his mother. ||3||

1263.g: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਇਕ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਕਰਾਰੀ ॥
1263.t: dhan pir kaa ik hee sa(n)g vaasaa vich haumai bheet karaaree ||
1263.e: The soul-bride and the Husband Lord live together as one, but the hard wall of egotism has come between them.

1263.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਤੋਰੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
1263.t: gur poorai haumai bheet toree jan naanak mile banavaaree ||4||1||
1263.e: The Perfect Guru demolishes the wall of egotism; servant Nanak has met the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||4||1||

1263.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1263.t: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1263.e: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

1263.g: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਗੋਦਾਵਰੀ ਸਰਸੁਤੀ ਤੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ ॥
1263.t: ga(n)gaa jamunaa godhaavaree sarasutee te kareh udham dhoor saadhoo kee taiee ||
1263.e: The Ganges, the Jamunaa, the Godaavari and the Saraswati - these rivers strive for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

1263.g: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਪਰੇ ਹਮਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
1263.t: kilavikh mail bhare pare hamarai vich hamaree mail saadhoo kee dhoor gavaiee ||1||
1263.e: Overflowing with their filthy sins, the mortals take cleansing baths in them; the rivers' pollution is washed away by the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||1||

1263.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਈ ॥
1263.t: teerath aThasaTh majan naiee ||
1263.e: Instead of bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, take your cleansing bath in the Name.

1263.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੀ ਉਡਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1263.t: satasa(n)gat kee dhoor paree udd netree sabh dhuramat mail gavaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1263.e: When the dust of the feet of the Sat Sangat rises up into the eyes, all filthy evil-mindedness is removed. ||1||Pause||

1263.g: ਜਾਹਰਨਵੀ ਤਪੈ ਭਾਗੀਰਥਿ ਆਣੀ ਕੇਦਾਰੁ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਮਹਸਾਈ ॥
1263.t: jaaharanavee tapai bhaageerath aanee kedhaar thaapio mahasaiee ||
1263.e: Bhaageerat'h the penitent brought the Ganges down, and Shiva established Kaydaar.

1263.g: ਕਾਂਸੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਊ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
1263.t: kaa(n)see kirasan charaavat gaauoo mil har jan sobhaa paiee ||2||
1263.e: Krishna grazed cows in Kaashi; through the humble servant of the Lord, these places became famous. ||2||

1263.g: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵੀ ਥਾਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਲੋਚਹਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ ॥
1263.t: jitane teerath dhevee thaape sabh titane locheh dhoor saadhoo kee taiee ||
1263.e: And all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage established by the gods, long for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

1263.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਲੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
1263.t: har kaa sa(n)t milai gur saadhoo lai tis kee dhoor mukh laiee ||3||
1263.e: Meeting with the Lord's Saint, the Holy Guru, I apply the dust of His feet to my face. ||3||

1263.g: ਜਿਤਨੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਤਨੀ ਲੋਚੈ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ ॥
1263.t: jitanee sirasaT tumaree mere suaamee sabh titanee lochai dhoor saadhoo kee taiee ||
1263.e: And all the creatures of Your Universe, O my Lord and Master, long for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

1263.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
1263.t: naanak lilaaT hovai jis likhiaa tis saadhoo dhoor dhe har paar la(n)ghaiee ||4||2||
1263.e: O Nanak, one who has such destiny inscribed on his forehead, is blessed with the dust of the feet of the Holy; the Lord carries him across. ||4||2||

1263.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1263.t: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1263.e: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

1263.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
1263.t: tis jan kau har meeTh lagaanaa jis har har kirapaa karai ||
1263.e: The Lord seems sweet to that humble being who is blessed by the Grace of the Lord.

1263.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਸਭਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ॥੧॥
1263.t: tis kee bhookh dhookh sabh utarai jo har gun har ucharai ||1||
1263.e: His hunger and pain are totally taken away; he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

1263.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
1263.t: jap man har har har nisatarai ||
1263.e: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, the mortal is emancipated.

1263.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1263.t: gur ke bachan karan sun dhiaavai bhav saagar paar parai ||1|| rahaau ||
1263.e: One who listens to the Guru's Teachings and meditates on them, is carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

1263.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਹਾਟਿ ਬਿਹਾਝੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
1263.t: tis jan ke ham haaT bihaajhe jis har har kirapaa karai ||
1263.e: I am the slave of that humble being, who is blessed by the Grace of the Lord, Har, Har.

1263.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੈ ॥੨॥
1263.t: har jan kau miliaa(n) sukh paieeaai sabh dhuramat mail harai ||2||
1263.e: Meeting with the Lord's humble servant, peace is obtained; all the pollution and filth of evil-mindedness is washed away. ||2||

1263.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਜਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਿਚਰੈ ॥
1263.t: har jan kau har bhookh lagaanee jan tirapatai jaa har gun bicharai ||
1263.e: The humble servant of the Lord feels hunger only for the Lord. He is satisfied only when he chants the Lord's Glories.

1263.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਮੀਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੩॥
1263.t: har kaa jan har jal kaa meenaa har bisarat fooT marai ||3||
1263.e: The humble servant of the Lord is a fish in the Water of the Lord. Forgetting the Lord, he would dry up and die. ||3||

1263.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
1263.t: jin eh preet laiee so jaanai kai jaanai jis man dharai ||
1263.e: He alone knows this love, who enshrines it within his mind.

1263.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਟਰੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
1263.t: jan naanak har dhekh sukh paavai sabh tan kee bhookh Tarai ||4||3||
1263.e: Servant Nanak gazes upon the Lord and is at peace; The hunger of his body is totally satisfied. ||4||3||

1263.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1263.t: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1263.e: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

1263.g: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਲਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
1263.t: jitane jeea ja(n)t prabh keene titane sir kaar likhaavai ||
1263.e: All the beings and creatures which God has created - on their foreheds, He has written their destiny.

1263.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੑ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
1263.t: har jan kau har dheen(h) vaddaiee har jan har kaarai laavai ||1||
1263.e: The Lord blesses His humble servant with glorious greatness. The Lord enjoins him to his tasks. ||1||

1263.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
1263.t: satigur har har naam dhiraRaavai ||
1263.e: The True Guru implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within.

1264.g: ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1264.t: har bolahu gur ke sikh mere bhaiee har bhaujal jagat taraavai ||1|| rahaau ||
1264.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, O Sikhs of the Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny. Only the Lord will carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

1264.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1264.t: jo gur kau jan pooje seve so jan mere har prabh bhaavai ||
1264.e: That humble being who worships, adores and serves the Guru is pleasing to my Lord God.

1264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
1264.t: har kee sevaa satigur poojahu kar kirapaa aap taraavai ||2||
1264.e: To worship and adore the True Guru is to serve the Lord. In His Mercy, He saves us and carries us across. ||2||

1264.g: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਫੂਲ ਤੋਰਾਵੈ ॥
1264.t: bharam bhoole agiaanee a(n)dhule bhram bhram fool toraavai ||
1264.e: The ignorant and the blind wander deluded by doubt; deluded and confused, they pick flowers to offer to their idols.

1264.g: ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਮੜਾ ਸਰੇਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਘਾਲ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
1264.t: nirajeeau poojeh maRaa sareveh sabh birathee ghaal gavaavai ||3||
1264.e: They worship lifeless stones and serve the tombs of the dead; all their efforts are useless. ||3||

1264.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
1264.t: braham bi(n)dhe so satigur kaheeaai har har kathaa sunaavai ||
1264.e: He alone is said to be the True Guru, who realizes God, and proclaims the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har.

1264.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
1264.t: tis gur kau chhaadhan bhojan paaT paTa(n)bar bahu bidh sat kar mukh sa(n)chahu tis pu(n)n kee fir toT na aavai ||4||
1264.e: Offer the Guru sacred foods, clothes, silk and satin robes of all sorts; know that He is True. The merits of this shall never leave you lacking. ||4||

1264.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਉ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
1264.t: satigur dheau paratakh har moorat jo a(n)mirat bachan sunaavai ||
1264.e: The Divine True Guru is the Embodiment, the Image of the Lord; He utters the Ambrosial Word.

1264.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗ ਭਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੪॥
1264.t: naanak bhaag bhale tis jan ke jo har charanee chit laavai ||5||4||
1264.e: O Nanak, blessed and good is the destiny of that humble being, who focuses his consciousness on the Feet of the Lord. ||5||4||

1264.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1264.t: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1264.e: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

1264.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਭਲ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥
1264.t: jin(h) kai heearai basio meraa satigur te sa(n)t bhale bhal bhaa(n)t ||
1264.e: Those whose hearts are filled with my True Guru - those Saints are good and noble in every way.

1264.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਤ ॥੧॥
1264.t: tin(h) dhekhe meraa man bigasai hau tin kai sadh bal jaa(n)t ||1||
1264.e: Seeing them, my mind blossoms forth in bliss; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||1||

1264.g: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
1264.t: giaanee har bolahu dhin raat ||
1264.e: O spiritual teacher, chant the Name of the Lord, day and night.

1264.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1264.t: tin(h) kee tirasanaa bhookh sabh utaree jo gurmat raam ras khaa(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
1264.e: All hunger and thirst are satisfied, for those who partake of the sublime essence of the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

1264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸਾਧ ਸਖਾ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥
1264.t: har ke dhaas saadh sakhaa jan jin miliaa leh jai bharaa(n)t ||
1264.e: The slaves of the Lord are our Holy companions. Meeting with them, doubt is taken away.

1264.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਾਢੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ਤਿਉ ਦੇਹੀ ਤੇ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਾਢੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
1264.t: jiau jal dhudh bhi(n)n bhi(n)n kaaddai chun ha(n)sulaa tiau dhehee te chun kaaddai saadhoo haumai taat ||2||
1264.e: As the swan separates the milk from the water, the Holy Saint removes the fire of egotism from the body. ||2||

1264.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੇ ਕਪਟੀ ਨਰ ਨਿਤ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਂਤਿ ॥
1264.t: jin kai preet naahee har hiradhai te kapaTee nar nit kapaT kamaa(n)t ||
1264.e: Those who do not love the Lord in their hearts are deceitful; they continually practice deception.

1264.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਖਵਾਲੈ ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
1264.t: tin kau kiaa koiee dhei khavaalai oi aap beej aape hee khaa(n)t ||3||
1264.e: What can anyone give them to eat? Whatever they themselves plant, they must eat. ||3||

1264.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਾਂਤਿ ॥
1264.t: har kaa chihan soiee har jan kaa har aape jan meh aap rakhaa(n)t ||
1264.e: This is the Quality of the Lord, and of the Lord's humble servants as well; the Lord places His Own Essence within them.

1264.g: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤਰੀ ਤਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੪॥੫॥
1264.t: dhan dha(n)n guroo naanak samadharasee jin ni(n)dhaa usatat taree taraa(n)t ||4||5||
1264.e: Blessed, blessed, is Guru Nanak, who looks impartially on all; He crosses over and transcends both slander and praise. ||4||5||

1264.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1264.t: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1264.e: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

1264.g: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
1264.t: agam agochar naam har uootam har kirapaa te jap liaa ||
1264.e: The Name of the Lord is inaccessible, unfathomable, exalted and sublime. It is chanted by the Lord's Grace.

1264.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਾਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
1264.t: satasa(n)gat saadh paiee vaddabhaagee sa(n)g saadhoo paar piaa ||1||
1264.e: By great good fortune, I have found the True Congregation, and in the Company of the Holy, I am carried across. ||1||

1264.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
1264.t: merai man anadhin anadh bhiaa ||
1264.e: My mind is in ecstasy, night and day.

1264.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1264.t: gur parasaadh naam har japiaa mere man kaa bhram bhau giaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1264.e: By Guru's Grace, I chant the Name of the Lord. Doubt and fear are gone from my mind. ||1||Pause||

1264.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
1264.t: jin har gaiaa jin har japiaa tin sa(n)gat har melahu kar miaa ||
1264.e: Those who chant and meditate on the Lord - O Lord, in Your Mercy, please unite me with them.

1264.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੨॥
1264.t: tin kaa dharas dhekh sukh paiaa dhukh haumai rog giaa ||2||
1264.e: Gazing upon them, I am at peace; the pain and disease of egotism are gone. ||2||

1264.g: ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
1264.t: jo anadhin hiradhai naam dhiaaveh sabh janam tinaa kaa safal bhiaa ||
1264.e: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord in their hearts - their lives become totally fruitful.

1264.g: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਤਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੩॥
1264.t: oi aap tare sirasaT sabh taaree sabh kul bhee paar piaa ||3||
1264.e: They themselves swim across, and carry the world across with them. Their ancestors and family cross over as well. ||3||

1264.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
1264.t: tudh aape aap upaiaa sabh jag tudh aape vas kar liaa ||
1264.e: You Yourself created the whole world, and You Yourself keep it under Your control.

1265.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
1265.t: jan naanak kau prabh kirapaa dhaaree bikh ddubadhaa kaadd liaa ||4||6||
1265.e: God has showered His Mercy on servant Nanak; He has lifted him up, and rescued him from the ocean of poison. ||4||6||

1265.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1265.t: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1265.e: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

1265.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1265.t: gur parasaadhee a(n)mrit nahee peeaa tirasanaa bhookh na jaiee ||
1265.e: Those who do not drink in the Ambrosial Nectar by Guru's Grace - their thirst and hunger are not relieved.

1265.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜੑ ਜਲਤ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
1265.t: manmukh mooR(h) jalat aha(n)kaaree haumai vich dhukh paiee ||
1265.e: The foolish self-willed manmukh burns in the fire of egotistical pride; he suffers painfully in egotism.

1265.g: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
1265.t: aavat jaat birathaa janam gavaiaa dhukh laagai pachhutaiee ||
1265.e: Coming and going, he wastes his life uselessly; afflicted with pain, he regrets and repents.

1265.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
1265.t: jis te upaje tiseh na cheteh dhirag jeevan dhirag khaiee ||1||
1265.e: He does not even think of the One, from whom he originated. Cursed is his life, and cursed is his food. ||1||

1265.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
1265.t: praanee gurmukh naam dhiaaiee ||
1265.e: O mortal, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1265.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1265.t: har har kirapaa kare gur mele har har naam samaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1265.e: The Lord, Har, Har, in His Mercy leads the mortal to meet the Guru; he is absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

1265.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਲਜਾਈ ॥
1265.t: manmukh janam bhiaa hai birathaa aavat jaat lajaiee ||
1265.e: The life of the self-willed manmukh is useless; he comes and goes in shame.

1265.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
1265.t: kaam karodh ddoobe abhimaanee haumai vich jal jaiee ||
1265.e: In sexual desire and anger, the proud ones are drowned. They are burnt in their egotism.

1265.g: ਤਿਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
1265.t: tin sidh na budh bhiee mat madhim lobh lahar dhukh paiee ||
1265.e: They do not attain perfection or understanding; their intellect is dimmed. Tossed by the waves of greed, they suffer in pain.

1265.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਪਕਰੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
1265.t: gur bihoon mahaa dhukh paiaa jam pakare bilalaiee ||2||
1265.e: Without the Guru, they suffer in terrible pain. Seized by Death, they weep and wail. ||2||

1265.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
1265.t: har kaa naam agochar paiaa gurmukh sahaj subhaiee ||
1265.e: As Gurmukh, I have attained the Unfathomable Name of the Lord, with intuitive peace and poise.

1265.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
1265.t: naam nidhaan vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar rasanaa har gun gaiee ||
1265.e: The treasure of the Naam abides deep within my heart. My tongue sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

1265.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
1265.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai dhin raatee ek sabadh liv laiee ||
1265.e: I am forever in bliss, day and night, lovingly attuned to the One Word of the Shabad.

1265.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਇਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
1265.t: naam padhaarath sahaje paiaa ieh satigur kee vaddiaaiee ||3||
1265.e: I have obtained the treasure of the Naam with intuitive ease; this is the glorious greatness of the True Guru. ||3||

1265.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
1265.t: satigur te har har man vasiaa satigur kau sadh bal jaiee ||
1265.e: Through the True Guru, the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within my mind. I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru.

1265.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਰਖਉ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
1265.t: man tan arap rakhau sabh aagai gur charanee chit laiee ||
1265.e: I have dedicated my mind and body to Him, and placed everything before Him in offering. I focus my consciousness on His Feet.

1265.g: ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
1265.t: apanee kirapaa karahu gur poore aape laih milaiee ||
1265.e: Please be merciful to me, O my Perfect Guru, and unite me with Yourself.

1265.g: ਹਮ ਲੋਹ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਵ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
1265.t: ham loh gur naav bohithaa naanak paar la(n)ghaiee ||4||7||
1265.e: I am just iron; the Guru is the boat, to carry me across. ||4||7||

1265.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੩
1265.t: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa paRataal ghar teejaa
1265.e: Malaar, Fourth Mehla, Partaal, Third House:

1265.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1265.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1265.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1265.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਬੋਲਤ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੋਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1265.t: har jan bolat sreeraam naamaa mil saadhasa(n)gat har tor ||1|| rahaau ||
1265.e: The humble servant of the Lord chants the Name of the Supreme Lord; he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Lord's Holy. ||1||Pause||

1265.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਬਨਜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਤ ਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਚੋਰ ॥੧॥
1265.t: har dhan banajahu har dhan sa(n)chahu jis laagat hai nahee chor ||1||
1265.e: Deal only in the wealth of the Lord, and gather only the wealth of the Lord. No thief can ever steal it. ||1||

1265.g: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੋਰ ਬੋਲਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੁਨਿ ਘਨਿਹਰ ਕੀ ਘੋਰ ॥੨॥
1265.t: chaatirak mor bolat dhin raatee sun ghanihar kee ghor ||2||
1265.e: The rainbirds and the peacocks sing day and night, hearing the thunder in the clouds. ||2||

1265.g: ਜੋ ਬੋਲਤ ਹੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਤ ਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰ ॥੩॥
1265.t: jo bolat hai mirag meen pa(n)kheroo su bin har jaapat hai nahee hor ||3||
1265.e: Whatever the deer, the fish and the birds sing, they chant to the Lord, and no other. ||3||

1265.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਇਓ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਸੋਰ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
1265.t: naanak jan har keerat gaiee chhooT gio jam kaa sabh sor ||4||1||8||
1265.e: Servant Nanak sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; the sound and fury of Death has totally gone away. ||4||1||8||

1265.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
1265.t: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
1265.e: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

1265.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
1265.t: raam raam bol bol khojate baddabhaagee ||
1265.e: They speak and chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; the very fortunate ones seek Him.

1265.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਕੋਊ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1265.t: har kaa pa(n)th kouoo bataavai hau taa kai pai laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
1265.e: Whoever shows me the Way of the Lord - I fall at his feet. ||1||Pause||

1265.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
1265.t: har hamaaro meet sakhaiee ham har siau preet laagee ||
1265.e: The Lord is my Friend and Compansion; I am in love with the Lord.

1266.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੧॥
1266.t: har ham gaaveh har ham boleh aaur dhuteeaa preet ham tiaagee ||1||
1266.e: I sing of the Lord, and I speak of the Lord; I have discarded all other loves. ||1||

1266.g: ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਮੋਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
1266.t: manmohan moro preetam raam har paramaana(n)dh bairaagee ||
1266.e: My Beloved is the Enticer of the mind; The Detached Lord God is the Embodiment of Supreme bliss.

1266.g: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੀਵਤ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੯॥੯॥੧੩॥੯॥੩੧॥
1266.t: har dhekhe jeevat hai naanak ik nimakh palo mukh laagee ||2||2||9||9||13||9||31||
1266.e: Nanak lives by gazing upon the Lord; may I see Him for a moment, for even just an instant. ||2||2||9||9||13||9||31||

1266.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
1266.t: raag malaar mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
1266.e: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

1266.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1266.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1266.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1266.g: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਸੋਚਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
1266.t: kiaa too socheh kiaa too chitaveh kiaa too(n) kareh upaae ||
1266.e: What are you so worried about? What are you thinking? What have you tried?

1266.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਜਿਹ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਸਹਾਏ ॥੧॥
1266.t: taa kau kahahu paravaeh kaahoo kee jeh gopaal sahaae ||1||
1266.e: Tell me - the Lord of the Universe - who controls Him? ||1||

1266.g: ਬਰਸੈ ਮੇਘੁ ਸਖੀ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਆਏ ॥
1266.t: barasai megh sakhee ghar paahun aae ||
1266.e: The rain showers down from the clouds, O companion. The Guest has come into my home.

1266.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1266.t: moh dheen kirapaa nidh Thaakur nav nidh naam samaae ||1|| rahaau ||
1266.e: I am meek; my Lord and Master is the Ocean of Mercy. I am absorbed in the nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

1266.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਮਿਸਟਾਏ ॥
1266.t: anik prakaar bhojan bahu ke'ee bahu bi(n)jan misaTaae ||
1266.e: I have prepared all sorts of foods in various ways, and all sorts of sweet deserts.

1266.g: ਕਰੀ ਪਾਕਸਾਲ ਸੋਚ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੁਣਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਭੋਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
1266.t: karee paakasaal soch pavitraa hun laavahu bhog har raae ||2||
1266.e: I have made my kitchen pure and sacred. Now, O my Sovereign Lord King, please sample my food. ||2||

1266.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਰਹਸੇ ਇਹਿ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਘਰ ਅਪਨਾਏ ॥
1266.t: dhusaT bidhaare saajan rahase ieh ma(n)dhir ghar apanaae ||
1266.e: The villains have been destroyed, and my friends are delighted. This is Your Own Mansion and Temple, O Lord.

1266.g: ਜਉ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਰੰਗੀਓ ਆਇਆ ਤਉ ਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
1266.t: jau gireh laal ra(n)geeo aaiaa tau mai sabh sukh paae ||3||
1266.e: When my Playful Beloved came into my household, then I found total peace. ||3||

1266.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਓਟ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਏ ॥
1266.t: sa(n)t sabhaa oT gur poore dhur masatak lekh likhaae ||
1266.e: In the Society of the Saints, I have the Support and Protection of the Perfect Guru; this is the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead.

1266.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
1266.t: jan naanak ka(n)t ra(n)geelaa paiaa fir dhookh na laagai aae ||4||1||
1266.e: Servant Nanak has found his Playful Husband Lord. He shall never suffer in sorrow again. ||4||1||

1266.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1266.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1266.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1266.g: ਖੀਰ ਅਧਾਰਿ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਜਬ ਹੋਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਰੈ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1266.t: kheer adhaar baarik jab hotaa bin kheerai rahan na jaiee ||
1266.e: When the baby's only food is milk, it cannot survive without its milk.

1266.g: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨੀਰੈ ਤਬ ਓਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥
1266.t: saar sam(h)aal maataa mukh neerai tab oh tirapat aghaiee ||1||
1266.e: The mother takes care of it, and pours milk into its mouth; then, it is satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||

1266.g: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
1266.t: ham baarik pitaa prabh dhaataa ||
1266.e: I am just a baby; God, the Great Giver, is my Father.

1266.g: ਭੂਲਹਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ਅਨ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਹ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1266.t: bhooleh baarik anik lakh bareeaa an Thaur naahee jeh jaataa ||1|| rahaau ||
1266.e: The child is so foolish; it makes so many mistakes. But it has nowhere else to go. ||1||Pause||

1266.g: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਪ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਰ ਮੇਲੈ ॥
1266.t: cha(n)chal mat baarik bapure kee sarap agan kar melai ||
1266.e: The mind of the poor child is fickle; he touches even snakes and fire.

1266.g: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜਿ ਤਬ ਖੇਲੈ ॥੨॥
1266.t: maataa pitaa ka(n)Th lai raakhai anadh sahaj tab khelai ||2||
1266.e: His mother and father hug him close in their embrace, and so he plays in joy and bliss. ||2||

1266.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਭੂਖ ਕੈਸੀ ॥
1266.t: jis kaa pitaa too hai mere suaamee tis baarik bhookh kaisee ||
