1266.e: What hunger can the child ever have, O my Lord and Master, when You are his Father?

1266.g: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਸੋ ਲੈਸੀ ॥੩॥
1266.t: nav nidh naam nidhaan gireh terai man baa(n)chhai so laisee ||3||
1266.e: The treasure of the Naam and the nine treasures are in Your celestial household. You fulfill the desires of the mind. ||3||

1266.g: ਪਿਤਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਇਹ ਦੀਨੀ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਸੋ ਦੇਨਾ ॥
1266.t: pitaa kirapaal aagiaa ieh dheenee baarik mukh maa(n)gai so dhenaa ||
1266.e: My Merciful Father has issued this Command: whatever the child asks for, is put into his mouth.

1266.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਾਹੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
1266.t: naanak baarik dharas prabh chaahai moh hiradhai baseh nit charanaa ||4||2||
1266.e: Nanak, the child, longs for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. May His Feet always dwell within my heart. ||4||2||

1266.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1266.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1266.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1266.g: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧੀ ਜੁਰਿ ਆਹਰੁ ਕਰਿਆ ਤਜਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
1266.t: sagal bidhee jur aahar kariaa tajio sagal a(n)dhesaa ||
1266.e: I tried everything, and gathered all devices together; I have discarded all my anxieties.

1266.g: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਗਲ ਅਰੰਭਿਓ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਰੋਸਾ ॥੧॥
1266.t: kaaraj sagal ara(n)bhio ghar kaa Thaakur kaa bhaarosaa ||1||
1266.e: I have begun to set all my household affairs right; I have placed my faith in my Lord and Master. ||1||

1266.g: ਸੁਨੀਐ ਬਾਜੈ ਬਾਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
1266.t: suneeaai baajai baaj suhaavee ||
1266.e: I listen to the celestial vibrations resonating and resounding.

1266.g: ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖ ਪੇਖੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਹਲਾਵੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1266.t: bhor bhiaa mai pria mukh pekhe gireh ma(n)gal suhalaavee ||1|| rahaau ||
1266.e: Sunrise has come, and I gaze upon the Face of my Beloved. My household is filled with peace and pleasure. ||1||Pause||

1266.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਥਾਨਾਂ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
1266.t: manooaa lai savaare thaanaa(n) poochhau sa(n)taa jaae ||
1266.e: I focus my mind, and embellish and adorn the place within; then I go out to speak with the Saints.

1266.g: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
1266.t: khojat khojat mai paahun milio bhagat karau niv paae ||2||
1266.e: Seeking and searching, I have found my Husband Lord; I bow at His Feet and worship Him with devotion. ||2||

1267.g: ਜਬ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਆਇ ਬਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਸਨਿ ਤਬ ਹਮ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
1267.t: jab pria aai base gireh aasan tab ham ma(n)gal gaiaa ||
1267.e: When my Beloved came to live in my house, I began to sing the songs of bliss.

1267.g: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1267.t: meet saajan mere bhe suhele prabh pooraa guroo milaiaa ||3||
1267.e: My friends and companions are happy; God leads me to meet the Perfect Guru. ||3||

1267.g: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਹਮਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
1267.t: sakhee sahelee bhe ana(n)dhaa gur kaaraj hamare poore ||
1267.e: My friends and companions are in ecstasy; the Guru has completed all my projects.

1267.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
1267.t: kahu naanak var miliaa sukhadhaataa chhodd na jaiee dhoore ||4||3||
1267.e: Says Nanak, I have met my Husband, the Giver of peace; He shall never leave me and go away. ||4||3||

1267.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1267.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1267.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1267.g: ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਕੀਟ ਕੀਟ ਤੇ ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਖ ਜਠਰ ਕਉ ਭਰਤੇ ॥
1267.t: raaj te keeT keeT te surapat kar dhokh jaThar kau bharate ||
1267.e: From a king to a worm, and from a worm to the lord of gods, they engage in evil to fill their bellies.

1267.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਆਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ਹਰਤੇ ॥੧॥
1267.t: kirapaa nidh chhodd aan kau poojeh aatam ghaatee harate ||1||
1267.e: They renounce the Lord, the Ocean of Mercy, and worship some other; they are thieves and killers of the soul. ||1||

1267.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰਤੇ ॥
1267.t: har bisarat te dhukh dhukh marate ||
1267.e: Forgetting the Lord, they suffer in sorrow and die.

1267.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਭ੍ਰਮਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਧਰਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1267.t: anik baar bhrameh bahu jonee Tek na kaahoo dharate ||1|| rahaau ||
1267.e: They wander lost in reincarnation through all sorts of species; they do not find shelter anywhere. ||1||Pause||

1267.g: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨ ਕਉ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਖਲ ਖਰ ਤੇ ॥
1267.t: tiaag suaamee aan kau chitavat mooR mugadh khal khar te ||
1267.e: Those who abandon their Lord and Master and think of some other, are foolish, stupid, idiotic donkeys.

1267.g: ਕਾਗਰ ਨਾਵ ਲੰਘਹਿ ਕਤ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਕਥਤ ਹਮ ਤਰਤੇ ॥੨॥
1267.t: kaagar naav la(n)gheh kat saagar birathaa kathat ham tarate ||2||
1267.e: How can they cross over the ocean in a paper boat? Their eogtistical boasts that they will cross over are meaningless. ||2||

1267.g: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੁਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਰਤੇ ॥
1267.t: siv bira(n)ch asur sur jete kaal agan meh jarate ||
1267.e: Shiva, Brahma, angels and demons, all burn in the fire of death.

1267.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਨ ਕੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਨ ਡਾਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ॥੩॥੪॥
1267.t: naanak saran charan kamalan kee tum(h) na ddaarahu prabh karate ||3||4||
1267.e: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet; O God, Creator, please do not send me into exile. ||3||4||

1267.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
1267.t: raag malaar mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ghar pehilaa
1267.e: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay, First House:

1267.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1267.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1267.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1267.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਓਇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
1267.t: prabh mere oi bairaagee tiaagee ||
1267.e: My God is detached and free of desire.

1267.g: ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1267.t: hau ik khin tis bin reh na sakau preet hamaaree laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
1267.e: I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant. I am so in love with Him. ||1||Pause||

1267.g: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
1267.t: aun kai sa(n)g moh prabh chit aavai sa(n)t prasaadh moh jaagee ||
1267.e: Associating with the Saints, God has come into my consciousness. By their Grace, I have been awakened.

1267.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਂਗੀ ॥੧॥
1267.t: sun upadhes bhe man niramal gun gaae ra(n)g raa(n)gee ||1||
1267.e: Hearing the Teachings, my mind has become immaculate. Imbued with the Lord's Love, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

1267.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਕੀਏ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਬਡਭਾਗਂੀ ॥
1267.t: eih man dhei ke'ee sa(n)t meetaa kirapaal bhe baddabhaaga(n)ee ||
1267.e: Dedicating this mind, I have made friends with the Saints. They have become merciful to me; I am very fortunate.

1267.g: ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਰੇਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੫॥
1267.t: mahaa sukh paiaa baran na saakau ren naanak jan paagee ||2||1||5||
1267.e: I have found absolute peace - I cannot describe it. Nanak has obtained the dust of the feet of the humble. ||2||1||5||

1267.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1267.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1267.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1267.g: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
1267.t: maiee moh preetam dheh milaiee ||
1267.e: O mother, please lead me to union with my Beloved.

1267.g: ਸਗਲ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਸੁਖ ਭਰਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਜਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1267.t: sagal sahelee sukh bhar sootee jeh ghar laal basaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1267.e: All my friends and companions sleep totally in peace; their Beloved Lord has come into the homes of their hearts. ||1||Pause||

1267.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਵਗਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
1267.t: moh avagan prabh sadhaa dhiaalaa moh niragun kiaa chaturaiee ||
1267.e: I am worthless; God is forever Merciful. I am unworthy; what clever tricks could I try?

1267.g: ਕਰਉ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਂੀ ਇਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੀ ਢੀਠਾਈ ॥੧॥
1267.t: karau baraabar jo pria sa(n)g raata(n)ee ieh haumai kee ddeeThaiee ||1||
1267.e: I claim to be on a par with those who are imbued with the Love of their Beloved. This is my stubborn egotism. ||1||

1267.g: ਭਈ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਇਕ ਤਾਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
1267.t: bhiee nimaanee saran ik taakee gur satigur purakh sukhadhaiee ||
1267.e: I am dishonored - I seek the Sanctuary of the One, the Guru, the True Guru, the Primal Being, the Giver of peace.

1267.g: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਹਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੬॥
1267.t: ek nimakh meh meraa sabh dhukh kaaTiaa naanak sukh rain bihaiee ||2||2||6||
1267.e: In an instant, all my pains have been taken away; Nanak passes the night of his life in peace. ||2||2||6||

1267.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1267.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1267.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1267.g: ਬਰਸੁ ਮੇਘ ਜੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਲਾਉ ॥
1267.t: baras megh jee til bilam na laau ||
1267.e: Rain down, O cloud; do not delay.

1267.g: ਬਰਸੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੇ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1267.t: baras piaare maneh sadhaare hoi anadh sadhaa man chaau ||1|| rahaau ||
1267.e: O beloved cloud, O support of the mind, you bring lasting bliss and joy to the mind. ||1||Pause||

1267.g: ਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਧਰ ਸੁਆਮੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
1267.t: ham teree dhar suaameeaa mere too kiau manahu bisaare ||
1267.e: I take to Your Support, O my Lord and Master; how could You forget me?

1268.g: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਰੂਪ ਚੇਰੀ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਸੋਭ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
1268.t: eisatree roop cheree kee niaaiee sobh nahee bin bharataare ||1||
1268.e: I am Your beautiful bride, Your servant and slave. I have no nobility without my Husband Lord. ||1||

1268.g: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਜਬ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੈ ਬੇਗਿ ਆਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
1268.t: binau sunio jab Thaakur merai beg aaio kirapaa dhaare ||
1268.e: When my Lord and Master listened to my prayer, He hurried to shower me with His Mercy.

1268.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਨਿਓ ਸੁਹਾਗੋ ਪਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਲੇ ਅਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੭॥
1268.t: kahu naanak mero banio suhaago pat sobhaa bhale achaare ||2||3||7||
1268.e: Says Nanak, I have become just like my Husband Lord; I am blessed with honor, nobility and the lifestyle of goodness. ||2||3||7||

1268.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1268.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1268.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1268.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
1268.t: preetam saachaa naam dhiaai ||
1268.e: Meditate on the True Name of your Beloved.

1268.g: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1268.t: dhookh dharadh binasai bhav saagar gur kee moorat ridhai basai ||1|| rahaau ||
1268.e: The pains and sorrows of the terrifying world-ocean are dispelled, by enshrining the Image of the Guru within your heart. ||1||Pause||

1268.g: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਹਤੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
1268.t: dhusaman hate dhokhee sabh viaape har saranaiee aaiaa ||
1268.e: Your enemies shall be destroyed, and all the evil-doers shall perish, when you come to the Sanctuary of the Lord.

1268.g: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1268.t: raakhanahaarai haath dhe raakhio naam padhaarath paiaa ||1||
1268.e: The Savior Lord has given me His Hand and saved me; I have obtained the wealth of the Naam. ||1||

1268.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
1268.t: kar kirapaa kilavikh sabh kaaTe naam niramal man dheeaa ||
1268.e: Granting His Grace, He has eradicated all my sins; He has placed the Immaculate Naam within my mind.

1268.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੨॥੪॥੮॥
1268.t: gun nidhaan naanak man vasiaa baahuR dhookh na theeaa ||2||4||8||
1268.e: O Nanak, the Treasure of Virtue fills my mind; I shall never again suffer in pain. ||2||4||8||

1268.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1268.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1268.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1268.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
1268.t: prabh mere preetam praan piaare ||
1268.e: My Beloved God is the Lover of my breath of life.

1268.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਪਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1268.t: prem bhagat apano naam dheejai dhiaal anugrahu dhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
1268.e: Please bless me with the loving devotional worship of the Naam, O Kind and Compassionate Lord. ||1||Pause||

1268.g: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਚਰਨ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
1268.t: simarau charan tuhaare preetam ridhai tuhaaree aasaa ||
1268.e: I meditate in remembrance on Your Feet, O my Beloved; my heart is filled with hope.

1268.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥੧॥
1268.t: sa(n)t janaa peh karau benatee man dharasan kee piaasaa ||1||
1268.e: I offer my prayer to the humble Saints; my mind thirsts for the Blssed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

1268.g: ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਮਰਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
1268.t: bichhurat maran jeevan har milate jan kau dharasan dheejai ||
1268.e: Separation is death, and Union with the Lord is life. Please bless Your humble servant with Your Darshan.

1268.g: ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
1268.t: naam adhaar jeevan dhan naanak prabh mere kirapaa keejai ||2||5||9||
1268.e: O my God, please be Merciful, and bless Nanak with the support, the life and wealth of the Naam. ||2||5||9||

1268.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1268.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1268.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1268.g: ਅਬ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
1268.t: ab apane preetam siau ban aaiee ||
1268.e: Now, I have become just like my Beloved.

1268.g: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਰਸੁ ਮੇਘ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1268.t: raajaa raam ramat sukh paio baras megh sukhadhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1268.e: Dwelling on my Sovereign Lord King, I have found peace. Rain down, O peace-giving cloud. ||1||Pause||

1268.g: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
1268.t: eik pal bisarat nahee sukh saagar naam navai nidh paiee ||
1268.e: I cannot forget Him, even for an instant; He is the Ocean of peace. Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures.

1268.g: ਉਦੌਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਵੀ ਕੋ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
1268.t: audhauat bhio pooran bhaavee ko bheTe sa(n)t sahaiee ||1||
1268.e: My perfect destiny has been activated, meeting with the Saints, my help and support. ||1||

1268.g: ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
1268.t: sukh upaje dhukh sagal binaase paarabraham liv laiee ||
1268.e: Peace has welled up, and all pain has been dispelled, lovingly attuned to the Supreme Lord God.

1268.g: ਤਰਿਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਠਿਨ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੦॥
1268.t: tario sa(n)saar kaThin bhai saagar har naanak charan dhiaaiee ||2||6||10||
1268.e: The arduous and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, O Nanak, by meditating on the Feet of the Lord. ||2||6||10||

1268.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1268.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1268.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1268.g: ਘਨਿਹਰ ਬਰਸਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
1268.t: ghanihar baras sagal jag chhaiaa ||
1268.e: The clouds have rained down all over the world.

1268.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1268.t: bhe kirapaal preetam prabh mere anadh ma(n)gal sukh paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1268.e: My Beloved Lord God has become merciful to me; I am blessed with ecstasy, bliss and peace. ||1||Pause||

1268.g: ਮਿਟੇ ਕਲੇਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸਭ ਬੂਝੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
1268.t: miTe kales tirasan sabh boojhee paarabraham man dhiaaiaa ||
1268.e: My sorrows are erased, and all my thirsts are quenched, meditating on the Supreme Lord God.

1268.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
1268.t: saadhasa(n)g janam maran nivaare bahur na katahoo dhaiaa ||1||
1268.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, death and birth come to an end, and the mortal does not wander anywhere, ever again. ||1||

1268.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਾਤਉ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
1268.t: man tan naam nira(n)jan raatau charan kamal liv laiaa ||
1268.e: My mind and body are imbued with the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; I am lovingly attuned to His Lotus Feet.

1268.g: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੧॥
1268.t: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apanai naanak dhaas saranaiaa ||2||7||11||
1268.e: God has made Nanak His Own; slave Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||2||7||11||

1268.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1268.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1268.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1268.g: ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵੇ ਓਇ ਜੀਵਨ ॥
1268.t: bichhurat kiau jeeve oi jeevan ||
1268.e: Separated from the Lord, how can any living being live?

1268.g: ਚਿਤਹਿ ਉਲਾਸ ਆਸ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਸ ਪੀਵਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1268.t: chiteh ulaas aas milabe kee charan kamal ras peevan ||1|| rahaau ||
1268.e: My consciousness is filled with yearning and hope to meet my Lord, and drink in the sublime essence of His Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

1268.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1268.t: jin kau piaas tumaaree preetam tin kau a(n)tar naahee ||
1268.e: Those who are thirsty for You, O my Beloved, are not separated from You.

1268.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇ ਮੂਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਂਹੀਂ ॥੧॥
1268.t: jin kau bisarai mero raam piaaraa se mooe mar jaa(n)hee(n) ||1||
1268.e: Those who forget my Beloved Lord are dead and dying. ||1||

1269.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
1269.t: man tan rav rahiaa jagadheesur pekhat sadhaa hajoore ||
1269.e: The Lord of the Universe is permeating and pervading my mind and body; I see Him Ever-present, here and now

1269.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥
1269.t: naanak rav rahio sabh a(n)tar sarab rahiaa bharapoore ||2||8||12||
1269.e: . O Nanak, He is permeating the inner being of all; He is all-pervading everywhere. ||2||8||12||

1269.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1269.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1269.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1269.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਨਿ ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
1269.t: har kai bhajan kaun kaun na taare ||
1269.e: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord, who has not been carried across?

1269.g: ਖਗ ਤਨ ਮੀਨ ਤਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤਨ ਬਰਾਹ ਤਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1269.t: khag tan meen tan mirag tan baraeh tan saadhoo sa(n)g udhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
1269.e: Those reborn into the body of a bird, the body of a fish, the body of a deer, and the body of a bull - in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they are saved. ||1||Pause||

1269.g: ਦੇਵ ਕੁਲ ਦੈਤ ਕੁਲ ਜਖੵ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਨਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
1269.t: dhev kul dhait kul jakhaye ki(n)nar nar saagar utare paare ||
1269.e: The families of gods, the families of demons, titans, celestial singers and human beings are carried across the ocean.

1269.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
1269.t: jo jo bhajan karai saadhoo sa(n)g taa ke dhookh bidhaare ||1||
1269.e: Whoever meditates and vibrates on the Lord in the Saadh Sangat - his pains are taken away. ||1||

1269.g: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਇਨ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
1269.t: kaam karodh mahaa bikhiaa ras in te bhe niraare ||
1269.e: Sexual desire, anger and the pleasures of terrible corruption - he keeps away from these.

1269.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਪਹਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੩॥
1269.t: dheen dhiaal japeh karunaa mai naanak sadh balihaare ||2||9||13||
1269.e: He meditates on the Lord, Merciful to the meek, the Embodiment of Compassion; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||13||

1269.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1269.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1269.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1269.g: ਆਜੁ ਮੈ ਬੈਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਟ ॥
1269.t: aaj mai baisio har haaT ||
1269.e: Today, I am seated in the Lord's store.

1269.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਾਝੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਂਉ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਘਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1269.t: naam raas saajhee kar jan siau jaa(n)au na jam kai ghaaT ||1|| rahaau ||
1269.e: With the wealth of the Lord, I have entered into partnership with the humble; I shall not have take the Highway of Death. ||1||Pause||

1269.g: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਖੁਲੇੑ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
1269.t: dhaar anugrahu paarabraham raakhe bhram ke khule(h) kapaaT ||
1269.e: Showering me with His Kindness, the Supreme Lord God has saved me; the doors of doubt have been opened wide.

1269.g: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਸਾਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਖਾਟ ॥੧॥
1269.t: besumaar saahu prabh paiaa laahaa charan nidh khaaT ||1||
1269.e: I have found God, the Banker of Infinity; I have earned the profit of the wealth of His Feet. ||1||

1269.g: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਢੇ ਹੈ ਛਾਂਟਿ ॥
1269.t: saran gahee achut abinaasee kilabikh kaadde hai chhaa(n)T ||
1269.e: I have grasped the protection of the Sanctuary of the Unchanging, Unmoving, Imperishable Lord; He has picked up my sins and thrown them out.

1269.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਮਾਟ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੪॥
1269.t: kal kales miTe dhaas naanak bahur na jonee maaT ||2||10||14||
1269.e: Slave Nanak's sorrow and suffering has ended. He shall never again be squeezed into the mold of reincarnation. ||2||10||14||

1269.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1269.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1269.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1269.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਹਿਰਾਨੋ ॥
1269.t: bahu bidh maiaa moh hiraano ||
1269.e: In so many ways, attachment to Maya leads to ruin.

1269.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਊ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਤੁ ਚਿਰਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1269.t: koT madhe kouoo biralaa sevak pooran bhagat chiraano ||1|| rahaau ||
1269.e: Among millions, it is very rare to find a selfless servant who remains a perfect devotee for very long. ||1||Pause||

1269.g: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੋ ॥
1269.t: eit ut ddol ddol sram paio tan dhan hot biraano ||
1269.e: Roaming and wandering here and there, the mortal finds only trouble; his body and wealth become strangers to himself.

1269.g: ਲੋਗ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਕਰਤ ਠਗਿਆਈ ਹੋਤੌ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
1269.t: log dhurai karat Thagiaaiee hotau sa(n)g na jaano ||1||
1269.e: Hiding from people, he practices deception; he does not know the One who is always with him. ||1||

1269.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪੰਖੀ ਮੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਨੀਚ ਇਹ ਸੰਕਟ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਨੋ ॥
1269.t: mirag pa(n)khee meen dheen neech ieh sa(n)kaT fir aano ||
1269.e: He wanders through troubled incarnations of low and wretched species as a deer, a bird and a fish.

1269.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਹਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੧੫॥
1269.t: kahu naanak paahan prabh taarahu saadhasa(n)gat sukh maano ||2||11||15||
1269.e: Says Nanak, O God, I am a stone - please carry me across, that I may enjoy peace in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||11||15||

1269.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1269.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1269.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1269.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
1269.t: dhusaT mue bikh khaiee ree maiee ||
1269.e: The cruel and evil ones died after taking poison, O mother.

1269.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1269.t: jis ke jeea tin hee rakh leene mere prabh kau kirapaa aaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1269.e: And the One, to whom all creatures belong, has saved us. God has granted His Grace. ||1||Pause||

1269.g: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
1269.t: a(n)tarajaamee sabh meh varatai taa(n) bhau kaisaa bhaiee ||
1269.e: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is contained within all; why should I be afraid, O Siblings of Destiny?

1269.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਠਾੲਂੀ ॥੧॥
1269.t: sa(n)g sahaiee chhodd na jaiee prabh dheesai sabhanee Thaae(n)ee ||1||
1269.e: God, my Help and Support, is always with me. He shall never leave; I see Him everywhere. ||1||

1269.g: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
1269.t: anaathaa naath dheen dhukh bha(n)jan aap le'ee laR laiee ||
1269.e: He is the Master of the masterless, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor; He has attached me to the hem of His robe.

1269.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੧੬॥
1269.t: har kee oT jeeveh dhaas tere naanak prabh saranaiee ||2||12||16||
1269.e: O Lord, Your slaves live by Your Support; Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of God. ||2||12||16||

1269.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1269.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1269.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1269.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
1269.t: man mere har ke charan raveejai ||
1269.e: O my mind, dwell on the Feet of the Lord.

1269.g: ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪੰਖ ਲਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1269.t: dharas piaas mero man mohio har pa(n)kh lagai mileejai ||1|| rahaau ||
1269.e: My mind is enticed by thirst for the Blessed Vision of the Lord; I would take wings and fly out to meet Him. ||1||Pause||

1269.g: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
1269.t: khojat khojat maarag paio saadhoo sev kareejai ||
1269.e: Searching and seeking, I have found the Path, and now I serve the Holy.

1269.g: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
1269.t: dhaar anugrahu suaamee mere naam mahaa ras peejai ||1||
1269.e: O my Lord and Master, please be kind to me, that I may drink in Your most sublime essence. ||1||

1269.g: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਏ ਜਲਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
1269.t: traeh traeh kar saranee aae jalatau kirapaa keejai ||
1269.e: Begging and pleading, I have come to Your Sanctuary; I am on fire - please shower me with Your Mercy!

1269.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੧੭॥
1269.t: kar geh leh dhaas apune kau naanak apuno keejai ||2||13||17||
1269.e: Please give me Your Hand - I am Your slave, O Lord. Please make Nanak Your Own. ||2||13||17||

1270.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:
It is God's Nature to love His devotees.

1270.g: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਤਲ ਦੀਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਜਸੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1270.t: ni(n)dhak maar charan tal dheene apuno jas varataio ||1|| rahaau ||
1270.e: He destroys the slanderers, crushing them beneath His Feet. His Glory is manifest everywhere. ||1||Pause||

1270.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਦਇਆ ਜੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
1270.t: jai jai kaar keeno sabh jag meh dhiaa jeean meh paio ||
1270.e: His Victory is celebrated all throughout the world. He blesses all creatures with compassion.

1270.g: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਤਾਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
1270.t: ka(n)Th lai apuno dhaas raakhio taatee vaau na laio ||1||
1270.e: Hugging him close in His Embrace, the Lord saves and protects His slave. The hot winds cannot even touch him. ||1||

1270.g: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਸੁਖਾਇਓ ॥
1270.t: a(n)geekaar keeo mere suaamee bhram bhau meT sukhaio ||
1270.e: My Lord and Master has made me His Own; dispelling my doubts and fears, He has made me happy.

1270.g: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਆਇਓ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੧੮॥
1270.t: mahaa ana(n)dh karahu dhaas har ke naanak bisavaiaas man aaio ||2||14||18||
1270.e: The Lord's slaves enjoy ultimate ecstasy; O Nanak, faith has welled up in my mind. ||2||14||18||

1270.t: raag malaar mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar doojaa
1270.e: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Gurmukh sees God pervading everywhere.
The Gurmukh knows that the universe is the extension of the three gunas, the three dispositions.
The Gurmukh reflects on the Sound-current of the Naad, and the wisdom of the Vedas.
Without the Perfect Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness. ||1||

1270.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
1270.t: mere man gur gur karat sadhaa sukh paieeaai ||
1270.e: O my mind, calling on the Guru, eternal peace is found.

1270.g: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਓ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1270.t: gur upadhes har hiradhai vasio saas giraas apanaa khasam dhiaaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
1270.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord comes to dwell within the heart; I meditate on my Lord and Master with every breath and morsel of food. ||1||Pause||

1270.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
1270.t: gur ke charan viTahu bal jaau ||
1270.e: I am a sacrifice to the Guru's Feet.

1270.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ॥
1270.t: gur ke gun anadhin nit gaau ||
1270.e: Night and day, I continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Guru.
I take my cleansing bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.
I am honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||
The Guru is the boat, to carry me across the terrifying world-ocean.

1270.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ॥
1270.t: gur bheTiaai na hoi jon aautaar ||
1270.e: Meeting with the Guru, I shall not be reincarnated ever again.

1270.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
1270.t: gur kee sevaa so jan paae ||
1270.e: That humble being serves the Guru,

1270.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
1270.t: jaa kau karam likhiaa dhur aae ||3||
1270.e: who has such karma inscribed on his forehead by the Primal Lord. ||3||
The Guru is my life; the Guru is my support.
The Guru is my way of life; the Guru is my family.
The Guru is my Lord and Master; I seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

1270.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
1270.t: naanak gur paarabraham jaa kee keem na paiee ||4||1||19||
1270.e: O Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme Lord God; His value cannot be estimated. ||4||1||19||
Malaar, Fifth Mehla:
I enshrine the Lord's Feet within my heart;
in His Mercy, God has united me with Himself.

1270.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
1270.t: apane sevak kau le prabh lai ||
1270.e: God enjoins His servant to his tasks.

1270.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
1270.t: taa kee keemat kahee na jai ||1||
1270.e: His worth cannot be expressed. ||1||
Please be merciful to me, O Perfect Giver of peace.

1270.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1270.t: tum(h)ree kirapaa te too(n) chit aaveh aaTh pahar terai ra(n)g raate ||1|| rahaau ||
1270.e: By Your Grace, You come to mind; I am imbued with Your Love, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||Pause||
Singing and listening, it is all by Your Will.
One who understands the Hukam of Your Command is absorbed in Truth.
Chanting and meditating on Your Name, I live.
Without You, there is no place at all. ||2||
Pain and pleasure come by Your Command, O Creator Lord.
By the Pleasure of Your Will You forgive, and by the Pleasure of Your Will You award punishment.
You are the Creator of both realms.
I am a sacrifice to Your Glorious Grandeur. ||3||
You alone know Your value.

1270.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
1270.t: too aape boojheh sun aap vakhaaneh ||
1270.e: You alone understand, You Yourself speak and listen.
They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to Your Will.

1271.e: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||2||20||
Malaar, Fifth Mehla:
The Transcendent Lord God has become merciful;
Ambrosial Nectar is raining down from the clouds.
All beings and creatures are satisfied;
their affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||
O my mind, dwell on the Lord, forever and ever.

1271.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1271.t: gur poore kee sevaa paiaa aaithai othai nibahai naal ||1|| rahaau ||
1271.e: Serving the Perfect Guru, I have obtained it. It shall stay with me both here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||
He is the Destroyer of pain, the Eradicator of fear.
He takes care of His beings.
The Savior Lord is kind and compassionate forever.
I am a sacrifice to Him, forever and ever. ||2||
The Creator Himself has eliminated death.

1271.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
1271.t: sadhaa sadhaa man tis no jaap ||
1271.e: Meditate on Him forever and ever, O my mind.
He watches all with His Glance of Grace and protects them.
Continually and continuously, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God. ||3||
The One and Only Creator Lord is Himself by Himself.
The Lord's devotees know His Glorious Grandeur.
He preserves the Honor of His Name.
Nanak speaks as the Lord inspires him to speak. ||4||3||21||
Malaar, Fifth Mehla:
All treasures are found in the Sanctuary of the Guru.
Honor is obtained in the True Court of the Lord.

1271.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
1271.t: bhram bhau dhookh dharadh sabh jai ||
1271.e: Doubt, fear, pain and suffering are taken away,
forever singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
O my mind, praise the Perfect Guru.

1271.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1271.t: naam nidhaan japahu dhin raatee man chi(n)dhe fal pai ||1|| rahaau ||
1271.e: Chant the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||
No one else is as great as the True Guru.
The Guru is the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord God.
He saves us from the pains of death and birth,

1271.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
1271.t: maiaa bikh fir bahuR na chaakhai ||2||
1271.e: and we will not have to taste the poison of Maya ever again. ||2||

1271.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1271.t: gur kee mahimaa kathan na jai ||
1271.e: The Guru's glorious grandeur cannot be described.
The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, in the True Name.
True is His self-discipline, and True are all His actions.

1271.g: ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੀ ॥੩॥
1271.t: so man niramal jo gur sa(n)g raachee ||3||
1271.e: Immaculate and pure is that mind, which is imbued with love for the Guru. ||3||
The Perfect Guru is obtained by great good fortune.

1271.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
1271.t: kaam karodh lobh man te tiaag ||
1271.e: Drive out sexual desire, anger and greed from your mind.
By His Grace, the Guru's Feet are enshrined within.
Nanak offers his prayer to the True Lord God. ||4||4||22||

1271.t: raag malaar mahalaa panjavaa paRataal ghar teejaa
1271.e: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehla, Partaal, Third House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1271.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਨਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦਇਆਰ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
1271.t: gur manaar pria dhiaar siau ra(n)g keeaa ||
1271.e: Pleasing the Guru, I have fallen in love with my Merciful Beloved Lord.
I have made all my decorations,
and renounced all corruption;
my wandering mind has become steady and stable. ||1||Pause||

1271.g: ਐਸੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
1271.t: aaise re man pai kai aap gavai kai kar saadhan siau sa(n)g ||
1271.e: O my mind, lose your self-conceit by associating with the Holy, and you shall find Him.

1271.g: ਬਾਜੇ ਬਜਹਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਮਧੁਰ ਬੈਨ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਹੀਆ ॥੧॥
1271.t: baaje bajeh miradha(n)g anaahadh kokil ree raam naam bolai madhur bain at suheeaa ||1||
1271.e: The unstruck celestial melody vibrates and resounds; like a song-bird, chant the Lord's Name, with words of sweetness and utter beauty. ||1||

1271.g: ਐਸੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅਮੋਘ ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਬਨੇ ॥
1271.t: aaisee tere dharasan kee sobh at apaar pria amogh taise hee sa(n)g sa(n)t bane ||
1271.e: Such is the glory of Your Darshan, so utterly inifinte and fruitful, O my Love; so do we become by associating with the Saints.
Vibrating, chanting Your Name, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
They dwell on the Lord, Raam, Raam, chanting on their malas;

1272.e: their minds are turned towards the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
O servant Nanak, their Beloved Lord seems so sweet to them. ||2||1||23||
Malaar, Fifth Mehla:
My mind wanders through the dense forest.
It walks with eagerness and love,
hoping to meet God. ||1||Pause||

1272.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨ ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਈ ਕਹੰਉ ਬੇਦਨ ਕਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
1272.t: trai gun maiee moh aaiee kaha(n)au bedhan kaeh ||1||
1272.e: Maya with her three gunas - the three dispositions - has come to entice me; whom can I tell of my pain? ||1||

1272.g: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਰ ਕੀਏ ਨਹਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
1272.t: aan upaav sagar ke'ee neh dhookh saakeh laeh ||
1272.e: I tried everything else, but nothing could rid me of my sorrow.

1272.g: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੪॥
1272.t: bhaj saran saadhoo naanakaa mil gun gobi(n)dheh gaeh ||2||2||24||
1272.e: So hurry to the Sanctuary of the Holy, O Nanak; joining them, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||2||2||24||
Malaar, Fifth Mehla:
The glory of my Beloved is noble and sublime.

1272.g: ਹਾਹਾ ਹੂਹੂ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਅਪਸਰਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਗਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1272.t: haahaa hoohoo ga(n)dhrab apasaraa ana(n)dh ma(n)gal ras gaavanee neekee ||1|| rahaau ||
1272.e: The celestial singers and angels sing His Sublime Praises in ecstasy, happiness and joy. ||1||Pause||

1272.g: ਧੁਨਿਤ ਲਲਿਤ ਗੁਨਗੵ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੧॥
1272.t: dhunit lalit gunagaye anik bhaa(n)t bahu bidh roop dhikhaavanee neekee ||1||
1272.e: The most worthy beings sing God's Praises in beautiful harmonies, in all sorts of ways, in myriads of sublime forms. ||1||

1272.g: ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਥਲ ਜਲ ਭਵਨ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਲਾਲਨ ਛਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
1272.t: gir tar thal jal bhavan bharapur ghaT ghaT laalan chhaavanee neekee ||
1272.e: Throughout the mountains, trees, deserts, oceans and galaxies, permeating each and every heart, the sublime grandeur of my Love is totally pervading.

1272.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੫॥
1272.t: saadhasa(n)g raamieeaa ras paio naanak jaa kai bhaavanee neekee ||2||3||25||
1272.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Love of the Lord is found; O Nanak, sublime is that faith. ||2||3||25||
Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1272.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1272.t: gur preet piaare charan kamal ridh a(n)tar dhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
1272.e: With love for the Guru, I enshrine the Lotus Feet of my Lord deep within my heart. ||1||Pause||

1272.g: ਦਰਸੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਗਏ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ॥
1272.t: dharas safalio dharas pekhio ge kilabikh ge ||
1272.e: I gaze on the Blessed Vision of His Fruitful Darshan; my sins are erased and taken away.
My mind is immaculate and enlightened. ||1||
I am wonderstruck, stunned and amazed.
Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, millions of sins are destroyed.
I fall at His Feet, and touch my forehead to them.
You alone are, You alone are, O God.
Your devotees take Your Support.
Servant Nanak has come to the Door of Your Sanctuary. ||2||4||26||
Malaar, Fifth Mehla:
Rain down with happiness in God's Will.
Bless me with total bliss and good fortune. ||1||Pause||

1272.g: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਫੜੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੇਘ ਧਰ ਸੁਹਾਗ ॥੧॥
1272.t: sa(n)t sa(n)ge man parafaRai mil megh dhar suhaag ||1||
1272.e: My mind blossoms forth in the Society of the Saints; soaking up the rain, the earth is blessed and beautified. ||1||
The peacock loves the thunder of the rain clouds.
The rainbird's mind is drawn to the rain-drop
- so is my mind enticed by the Lord.
I have renounced Maya, the deceiver.
Joining with the Saints, Nanak is awakened. ||2||5||27||
Malaar, Fifth Mehla:
Sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World.
Enshrine the Lord's Name in your consciousness. ||1||Pause||

1272.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
1272.t: chhodd maan taj gumaan mil saadhooaa kai sa(n)g ||
1272.e: Forsake your pride, and abandon your ego; join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

1272.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਦੋਖ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
1272.t: har simar ek ra(n)g miT jaa(n)h dhokh meet ||1||
1272.e: Meditate in loving remembrance on the One Lord; your sorrows shall be ended, O friend. ||1||
The Supreme Lord God has become merciful;
corrupt entanglements have come to an end.
Grasping the feet of the Holy,
Nanak sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World. ||2||6||28||
Malaar, Fifth Mehla:
The Embodiment of the Lord of the Universe roars like the thunder-cloud.
Singing His Glorious Praises brings peace and bliss. ||1||Pause||

1272.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਤਾ ਰਸ ਬੈਨ ॥੧॥
1272.t: har charan saran taran saagar dhun anahataa ras bain ||1||
1272.e: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet carries us across the world-ocean. His Sublime Word is the unstruck celestial melody. ||1||

1272.g: ਪਥਿਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਆਤਮ ਜਲੁ ਲੈਨ ॥
1272.t: pathik piaas chit sarovar aatam jal lain ||
1272.e: The thirsty traveller's consciousness obtains the water of the soul from the pool of nectar.

1272.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੈਨ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੯॥
1272.t: har dharas prem jan naanak kar kirapaa prabh dhain ||2||7||29||
1272.e: Servant Nanak loves the Blessed Vision of the Lord; in His Mercy, God has blessed him with it. ||2||7||29||

1273.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1273.t: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
1273.e: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

1273.g: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਹੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਲਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1273.t: he gobi(n)dh he gopaal he dhiaal laal ||1|| rahaau ||
1273.e: O Lord of the Universe, O Lord of the World, O Dear Merciful Beloved. ||1||Pause||

1273.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਖੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
1273.t: praan naath anaath sakhe dheen dharadh nivaar ||1||
1273.e: You are the Master of the breath of life, the Companion of the lost and forsaken, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor. ||1||

1273.g: ਹੇ ਸਮ੍ਰਥ ਅਗਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
1273.t: he samrath agam pooran moh miaa dhaar ||2||
1273.e: O All-powerful, Inaccessible, Perfect Lord, please shower me with Your Mercy. ||2||

1273.g: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰ ॥੩॥੮॥੩੦॥
1273.t: a(n)dh koop mahaa bhiaan naanak paar utaar ||3||8||30||
1273.e: Please, carry Nanak across the terrible, deep dark pit of the world to the other side. ||3||8||30||

1273.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧
1273.t: malaar mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ghar pehilaa
1273.e: Malaar, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

1273.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1273.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1273.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1273.g: ਚਕਵੀ ਨੈਨ ਨਂੀਦ ਨਹਿ ਚਾਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
1273.t: chakavee nain na(n)eedh neh chaahai bin pir na(n)eedh na paiee ||
1273.e: The chakvi bird does not long for sleepy eyes; without her beloved, she does not sleep.

1273.g: ਸੂਰੁ ਚਰ੍ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਨੈਨੀ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
1273.t: soor charhai priau dhekhai nainee niv niv laagai paa(n)iee ||1||
1273.e: When the sun rises, she sees her beloved with her eyes; she bows and touches his feet. ||1||

1273.g: ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
1273.t: pir bhaavai prem sakhaiee ||
1273.e: The Love of my Beloved is pleasing; it is my Companion and Support.

1273.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨਹੀ ਜਗਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਐਸੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਤਿਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1273.t: tis bin ghaRee nahee jag jeevaa aaisee piaas tisaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1273.e: Without Him, I cannot live in this world even for an instant; such is my hunger and thirst. ||1||Pause||

1273.g: ਸਰਵਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
1273.t: saravar kamal kiran aakaasee bigasai sahaj subhaiee ||
1273.e: The lotus in the pool blossoms forth intuitively and naturally, with the rays of the sun in the sky.

1273.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਅਭ ਐਸੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
1273.t: preetam preet banee abh aaisee jotee jot milaiee ||2||
1273.e: Such is the love for my Beloved which imbues me; my light has merged into the Light. ||2||

1273.g: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਟੇਰੈ ਬਿਲਪ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥
1273.t: chaatirak jal bin priau priau Terai bilap karai bilalaiee ||
1273.e: Without water, the rainbird cries out, ""Pri-o! Pri-o! - Beloved! Beloved!"" It cries and wails and laments.

1273.g: ਘਨਹਰ ਘੋਰ ਦਸੌ ਦਿਸਿ ਬਰਸੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
1273.t: ghanahar ghor dhasau dhis barasai bin jal piaas na jaiee ||3||
1273.e: The thundering clouds rain down in the ten directions; its thirst is not quenched until it catches the rain-drop in its mouth. ||3||

1273.g: ਮੀਨ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
1273.t: meen nivaas upajai jal hee te sukh dhukh purab kamaiee ||
1273.e: The fish lives in water, from which it was born. It finds peace and pleasure according to its past actions.

1273.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਲੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਾਂਈ ॥੪॥
1273.t: khin til reh na sakai pal jal bin maran jeevan tis taa(n)iee ||4||
1273.e: It cannot survive without water for a moment, even for an instant. Life and death depend on it. ||4||

1273.g: ਧਨ ਵਾਂਢੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਸ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਠਾੲਂੀ ॥
1273.t: dhan vaa(n)ddee pir dhes nivaasee sache gur peh sabadh paThaae(n)ee ||
1273.e: The soul-bride is separated from her Husband Lord, who lives in His Own Country. He sends the Shabad, His Word, through the True Guru.

1273.g: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
1273.t: gun sa(n)greh prabh ridhai nivaasee bhagat ratee harakhaiee ||5||
1273.e: She gathers virtues, and enshrines God within her heart. Imbued with devotion, she is happy. ||5||

1273.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੈ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਾੲਂੀ ॥
1273.t: priau priau karai sabhai hai jetee gur bhaavai priau paae(n)ee ||
1273.e: Everyone cries out, ""Beloved! Beloved!"" But she alone finds her Beloved, who is pleasing to the Guru.

1273.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਨਾਲੇ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
1273.t: priau naale sadh hee sach sa(n)ge nadharee mel milaiee ||6||
1273.e: Our Beloved is always with us; through the Truth, He blesses us with His Grace, and unites us in His Union. ||6||

1273.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
1273.t: sabh meh jeeau jeeau hai soiee ghaT ghaT rahiaa samaiee ||
1273.e: He is the life of the soul in each and every soul; He permeates and pervades each and every heart.

1273.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
1273.t: gur parasaadh ghar hee paragaasiaa sahaje sahaj samaiee ||7||
1273.e: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed within the home of my heart; I am intuitively, naturally, absorbed into Him. ||7||

1273.g: ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਵਾਰਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਗੋਸਾਂੲਂੀ ॥
1273.t: apanaa kaaj savaarahu aape sukhadhaate gosaa(n)e(n)ee ||
1273.e: He Himself shall resolve all your affairs, when you meet with the Giver of peace, the Lord of the World.

1273.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੮॥੧॥
1273.t: gur parasaadh ghar hee pir paiaa tau naanak tapat bujhaiee ||8||1||
1273.e: By Guru's Grace, you shall find your Husband Lord within your own home; then, O Nanak, the fire within you shall be quenched. ||8||1||

1273.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1273.t: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
1273.e: Malaar, First Mehla:

1273.g: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1273.t: jaagat jaag rahai gur sevaa bin har mai ko naahee ||
1273.e: Remain awake and aware, serving the Guru; except for the Lord, no one is mine.

1273.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਚੁ ਕਾਚੁ ਢਰਿ ਪਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥
1273.t: anik jatan kar rahan na paavai aach kaach ddar paa(n)hee ||1||
1273.e: Even by making all sorts of efforts, you shall not remain here; it shall melt like glass in the fire. ||1||

1273.g: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
1273.t: eis tan dhan kaa kahahu garab kaisaa ||
1273.e: Tell me - why are you so proud of your body and wealth?

1273.g: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਵਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬਿ ਖਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਐਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1273.t: binasat baar na laagai bavare haumai garab khapai jag aaisaa ||1|| rahaau ||
1273.e: They shall vanish in an instant; O madman, this is how the world is wasting away, in egotism and pride. ||1||Pause||

1273.g: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਪਰਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
1273.t: jai jagadhees prabhoo rakhavaare raakhai parakhai soiee ||
1273.e: Hail to the Lord of the Universe, God, our Saving Grace; He judges and saves the mortal beings.

1273.g: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
1273.t: jetee hai tetee tujh hee te tum(h) sar avar na koiee ||2||
1273.e: All that is, belongs to You. No one else is equal to You. ||2||

1273.g: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਜਨੁ ॥
1273.t: jeea upai jugat vas keenee aape gurmukh a(n)jan ||
1273.e: Creating all beings and creatures, their ways and means are under Your control; You bless the Gurmukhs with the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

1273.g: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਰਬ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੋਰਾ ਕਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਲ ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਖੰਜਨੁ ॥੩॥
1273.t: amar anaath sarab sir moraa kaal bikaal bharam bhai kha(n)jan ||3||
1273.e: My Eternal, Unmastered Lord is over the heads of all. He is the Destroyer of death and rebirth, doubt and fear. ||3||

1274.g: ਕਾਗਦ ਕੋਟੁ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਰੰਗਨਿ ਚਿਹਨ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
1274.t: kaagadh koT ih jag hai bapuro ra(n)gan chihan chaturaiee ||
1274.e: This wretched world is a fortress of paper, of color and form and clever tricks.

1274.g: ਨਾਨੑੀ ਸੀ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਾੲਂੀ ॥੪॥
1274.t: naan(h)ee see boo(n)dh pavan pat khovai janam marai khin taae(n)ee ||4||
1274.e: A tiny drop of water or a little puff of wind destroys its glory; in an instant, its life is ended. ||4||

1274.g: ਨਦੀ ਉਪਕੰਠਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
1274.t: nadhee upaka(n)Th jaise ghar taravar sarapan ghar ghar maahee ||
1274.e: It is like a tree-house near the bank of a river, with a serpent's den in that house.

1274.g: ਉਲਟੀ ਨਦੀ ਕਹਾਂ ਘਰੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਡਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੫॥
1274.t: aulaTee nadhee kahaa(n) ghar taravar sarapan ddasai dhoojaa man maa(n)hee ||5||
1274.e: When the river overflows, what happens to the tree house? The snake bites, like duality in the mind. ||5||

1274.g: ਗਾਰੁੜ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
1274.t: gaaruR gur giaan dhiaan gur bachanee bikhiaa gurmat jaaree ||
1274.e: Through the magic spell of the Guru's spiritual wisdom, and meditation on the Word of the Guru's Teachings, vice and corruption are burnt away.

1274.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹੇਂਵ ਭਏ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
1274.t: man tan he(n)v bhe sach paiaa har kee bhagat niraaree ||6||
1274.e: The mind and body are cooled and soothed and Truth is obtained, through the wondrous and unique devotional worship of the Lord. ||6||

1274.g: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆਂ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
1274.t: jetee hai tetee tudh jaachai too sarab jeeaa(n) dhiaalaa ||
1274.e: All that exists begs of You; You are merciful to all beings.

1274.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
1274.t: tum(h)ree saran pare pat raakhahu saach milai gopaalaa ||7||
1274.e: I seek Your Sanctuary; please save my honor, O Lord of the World, and bless me with Truth. ||7||

1274.g: ਬਾਧੀ ਧੰਧਿ ਅੰਧ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ਬਧਿਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
1274.t: baadhee dha(n)dh a(n)dh nahee soojhai badhik karam kamaavai ||
1274.e: Bound in worldly affairs and entanglements, the blind one does not understand; he acts like a murderous butcher.

1274.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਬੂਝਸਿ ਸਚ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੮॥
1274.t: satigur milai ta soojhas boojhas sach man giaan samaavai ||8||
1274.e: But if he meets with the True Guru, then he comprehends and understands, and his mind is imbued with true spiritual wisdom. ||8||

1274.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦੇਹ ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਾਚੀ ਮੈ ਪੂਛਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
1274.t: niragun dheh saach bin kaachee mai poochhau gur apanaa ||
1274.e: Without the Truth, this worthless body is false; I have consulted my Guru on this.

1274.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੯॥੨॥
1274.t: naanak so prabh prabhoo dhikhaavai bin saache jag supanaa ||9||2||
1274.e: O Nanak, that God has revealed God to me; without the Truth, all the world is just a dream. ||9||2||

1274.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1274.t: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
1274.e: Malaar, First Mehla:

1274.g: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
1274.t: chaatirak meen jal hee te sukh paaveh saari(n)g sabadh suhaiee ||1||
1274.e: The rainbird and the fish find peace in water; the deer is pleased by the sound of the bell. ||1||

1274.g: ਰੈਨਿ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਬੋਲਿਓ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1274.t: rain babeehaa bolio meree maiee ||1|| rahaau ||
1274.e: The rainbird chirps in the night, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

1274.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਉਲਟੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਜੋ ਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
1274.t: pria siau preet na ulaTai kabahoo jo tai bhaavai saiee ||2||
1274.e: O my Beloved, my love for You shall never end, if it is Your Will. ||2||

1274.g: ਨੀਦ ਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਸਚ ਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
1274.t: needh giee haumai tan thaakee sach mat ridhai samaiee ||3||
1274.e: Sleep is gone, and egotism is exhausted from my body; my heart is permeated with the Teachings of Truth. ||3||

1274.g: ਰੂਖਂੀ ਬਿਰਖਂੀ ਊਡਉ ਭੂਖਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
1274.t: rookha(n)ee birakha(n)ee uooddau bhookhaa peevaa naam subhaiee ||4||
1274.e: Flying among the trees and plants, I remain hungry; lovingly drinking in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied. ||4||

1274.g: ਲੋਚਨ ਤਾਰ ਲਲਤਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
1274.t: lochan taar lalataa bilalaatee dharasan piaas rajaiee ||5||
1274.e: I stare at You, and my tongue cries out to You; I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||5||

1274.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੀ ਤੇਤਾ ਤਨੁ ਤਾਪੈ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
1274.t: pria bin seegaar karee tetaa tan taapai kaapar a(n)g na suhaiee ||6||
1274.e: Without my Beloved, the more I decorate myself, the more my body burns; these clothes do not look good on my body. ||6||

1274.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਂਉ ਬਿਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
1274.t: apane piaare bin ik khin reh na saka(n)au bin mile na(n)eedh na paiee ||7||
1274.e: Without my Beloved, I cannot survive even for an instant; without meeting Him, I cannot sleep. ||7||

1274.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਨਜੀਕਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੮॥
1274.t: pir najeek na boojhai bapuRee satigur dheeaa dhikhaiee ||8||
1274.e: Her Husband Lord is nearby, but the wretched bride does not know it. The True Guru reveals Him to her. ||8||

1274.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੯॥
1274.t: sahaj miliaa tab hee sukh paiaa tirasanaa sabadh bujhaiee ||9||
1274.e: When she meets Him with intuitive ease, she finds peace; the Word of the Shabad quenches the fire of desire. ||9||

1274.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੩॥
1274.t: kahu naanak tujh te man maaniaa keemat kahan na jaiee ||10||3||
1274.e: Says Nanak, through You, O Lord, my mind is pleased and appeased; I cannot express Your worth. ||10||3||

1274.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨
1274.t: malaar mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ghar doojaa
1274.e: Malaar, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

1274.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1274.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1274.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1274.g: ਅਖਲੀ ਊਂਡੀ ਜਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1274.t: akhalee uoo(n)ddee jal bhar naal ||
1274.e: The earth bends under the weight of the water,

1274.g: ਡੂਗਰੁ ਊਚਉ ਗੜੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ॥
1274.t: ddoogar uoochau gaR paataal ||
1274.e: the lofty mountains and the caverns of the underworld.

1274.g: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1274.t: saagar seetal gur sabadh veechaar ||
1274.e: Contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the oceans become calm.

1274.g: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
1274.t: maarag mukataa haumai maar ||1||
1274.e: The path of liberation is found by subduing the ego. ||1||

1274.g: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
1274.t: mai a(n)dhule naavai kee jot ||
1274.e: I am blind; I seek the Light of the Name.

1274.g: ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ਚਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1274.t: naam adhaar chalaa gur kai bhai bhet ||1|| rahaau ||
1274.e: I take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I walk on the path of mystery of the Guru's Fear. ||1||Pause||

1275.e: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, the Path is known.
With the Guru's Support, one is blessed with the strength of the True Lord.
Dwell on the Naam, and realize the Beauteous Word of His Bani.
If it is Your Will, Lord, You lead me to find Your Door. ||2||
Flying high or sitting down, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I take the Naam as my Suppport.

1275.g: ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਡੂੰਗਰੁ ਨ ਊਚੀ ਧਾਰ ॥
1275.t: naa jal ddoo(n)gar na uoochee dhaar ||
1275.e: There is no ocean of water, no mountain ranges rising up.

1275.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਤਹ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
1275.t: nij ghar vaasaa teh mag na chaalanahaar ||3||
1275.e: I dwell within the home of my own inner being, where there is no path and no one travelling on it. ||3||

1275.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬੀਜਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
1275.t: jit ghar vaseh toohai bidh jaaneh beejau mahal na jaapai ||
1275.e: You alone know the way to that House in which You dwell. No one else knows the Mansion of Your Presence.

1275.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਦਬਿਆ ਛਾਪੈ ॥
1275.t: satigur baajhahu samajh na hovee sabh jag dhabiaa chhaapai ||
1275.e: Without the True Guru, there is no understanding. The whole world is buried under its nightmare.

1275.g: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਤਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
1275.t: karan palaav karai bilalaatau bin gur naam na jaapai ||
1275.e: The mortal tries all sorts of things, and weeps and wails, but without the Guru, he does not know the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1275.g: ਪਲ ਪੰਕਜ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਏ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥੪॥
1275.t: pal pa(n)kaj meh naam chhaddaae je gur sabadh sin(j)aapai ||4||
1275.e: In the twinkling of an eye, the Naam saves him, if he realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||
Some are foolish, blind, stupid and ignorant.

1275.g: ਇਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
1275.t: eik satigur kai bhai naam adhaar ||
1275.e: Some, through fear of the True Guru, take the Support of the Naam.
The True Word of His Bani is sweet, the source of ambrosial nectar.
Whoever drinks it in, finds the Door of Salvation. ||5||

1275.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
1275.t: naam bhai bhai ridhai vasaahee gur karanee sach baanee ||
1275.e: One who, through the love and fear of God, enshrines the Naam within his heart, acts according to the Guru's Instructions and knows the True Bani.

1275.g: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
1275.t: ei(n)dh varasai dharat suhaavee ghaT ghaT jot samaanee ||
1275.e: When the clouds release their rain, the earth becomes beautiful; God's Light permeates each and every heart.

1275.g: ਕਾਲਰਿ ਬੀਜਸਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਐਸੀ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
1275.t: kaalar beejas dhuramat aaisee nigure kee neesaanee ||
1275.e: The evil-minded ones plant their seed in the barren soil; such is the sign of those who have no Guru.

1275.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
1275.t: satigur baajhahu ghor a(n)dhaaraa ddoob mue bin paanee ||6||
1275.e: Without the True Guru, there is utter darkness; they drown there, even without water. ||6||

1275.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
1275.t: jo kichh keeno su prabhoo rajai ||
1275.e: Whatever God does, is by His Own Will.

1275.g: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1275.t: jo dhur likhiaa su meTanaa na jai ||
1275.e: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.
Bound to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal does his deeds.
Permeated by the One Word of the Shabad, the mortal is immersed in Truth. ||7||

1275.g: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਤਾਲੰ ॥
1275.t: chahu dhis hukam varatai prabh teraa chahu dhis naam pataala(n) ||
1275.e: Your Command, O God, rules in the four directions; Your Name pervades the four corners of the nether regions as well.

1275.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੈਆਲੰ ॥
1275.t: sabh meh sabadh varatai prabh saachaa karam milai baiaala(n) ||
1275.e: The True Word of the Shabad is pervading amongst all. By His Grace, the Eternal One unites us with Himself.

1275.g: ਜਾਂਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਊਭੌ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਲੰ ॥
1275.t: jaa(n)man maranaa dheesai sir uoobhau khudhiaa nidhraa kaala(n) ||
1275.e: Birth and death hang over the heads of all beings, along with hunger, sleep and dying.

1275.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਰਸਾਲੰ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
1275.t: naanak naam milai man bhaavai saachee nadhar rasaala(n) ||8||1||4||
1275.e: The Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind; O True Lord, Source of bliss, please bless me with Your Grace. ||8||1||4||
Malaar, First Mehla:

1275.g: ਮਰਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
1275.t: maran mukat gat saar na jaanai ||
1275.e: You do not understand the nature of death and liberation.
You are sitting on the river-bank; realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
You stork! - how were you caught in the net?

1275.g: ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1275.t: alakh na jaacheh ridhai sam(h)aal ||1|| rahaau ||
1275.e: You do not remember in your heart the Unseen Lord God. ||1||Pause||
For your one life, you consume many lives.
You were supposed to swim in the water, but you are drowning in it instead. ||2||
You have tormented all beings.
When Death seizes you, then you shall regret and repent. ||3||

1275.g: ਜਬ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਸ ਪੜੀ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
1275.t: jab gal faas paRee at bhaaree ||
1275.e: When the heavy noose is placed around your neck,
you may spread your wings, but you shall not be able to fly. ||4||
You enjoy the tastes and flavors, you foolish self-willed manmukh.
You are trapped. You can only be saved by virtuous conduct, spiritual wisdom and contemplation. ||5||
Serving the True Guru, you will shatter the Messenger of Death.
In your heart, dwell on the True Word of the Shabad. ||6||
The Guru's Teachings, the True Word of the Shabad, is excellent and sublime.

1275.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
1275.t: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaar ||7||
1275.e: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||7||

1275.g: ਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਆਗੈ ਜਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸੇ ॥
1275.t: se dhukh aagai j bhog bilaase ||
1275.e: One who is obsessed with enjoying pleasures here, shall suffer in pain hereafter.

1275.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
1275.t: naanak mukat nahee bin naavai saache ||8||2||5||
1275.e: O Nanak, there is no liberation without the True Name. ||8||2||5||

1276.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
1276.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa ghar pehilaa ||
1276.e: Malaar, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

1276.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1276.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1276.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1276.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1276.t: karam hovai taa satigur paieeaai vin karamai paiaa na jai ||
1276.e: If it is in his karma, then he finds the True Guru; without such karma, He cannot be found.

1276.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਈਐ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
1276.t: satigur miliaai ka(n)chan hoieeaai jaa(n) har kee hoi rajai ||1||
1276.e: He meets the True Guru, and he is transformed into gold, if it is the Lord's Will. ||1||

1276.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
1276.t: man mere har har naam chit lai ||
1276.e: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

1276.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1276.t: satigur te har paieeaai saachaa har siau rahai samai ||1|| rahaau ||
1276.e: The Lord is found through the True Guru, and then he remains merged with the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

1276.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
1276.t: satigur te giaan uoopajai taa(n) ieh sa(n)saa jai ||
1276.e: Spiritual wisdom wells up through the True Guru, and then this cynicism is dispelled.

1276.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
1276.t: satigur te har bujheeaai garabh jonee neh pai ||2||
1276.e: Through the True Guru, the Lord is realized, and then, he is not consigned to the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||2||

1276.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
1276.t: gur parasaadhee jeevat marai mar jeevai sabadh kamai ||
1276.e: By Guru's Grace, the mortal dies in life, and by so dying, lives to practice the Word of the Shabad.

1276.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਜਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
1276.t: mukat dhuaaraa soiee paae j vichahu aap gavai ||3||
1276.e: He alone finds the Door of Salvation, who eradicates self-conceit from within himself. ||3||

1276.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
1276.t: gur parasaadhee siv ghar ja(n)mai vichahu sakat gavai ||
1276.e: By Guru's Grace, the mortal is reincarnated into the Home of the Lord, having eradicated Maya from within.

1276.g: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
1276.t: achar charai bibek budh paae purakhai purakh milai ||4||
1276.e: He eats the uneatable, and is blessed with a discriminating intellect; he meets the Supreme Person, the Primal Lord God. ||4||

1276.g: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਲੈ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
1276.t: dhaatur baajee sa(n)saar achet hai chalai mool gavai ||
1276.e: The world is unconscious, like a passing show; the mortal departs, having lost his capital.

1276.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
1276.t: laahaa har satasa(n)gat paieeaai karamee palai pai ||5||
1276.e: The profit of the Lord is obtained in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; by good karma, it is found. ||5||

1276.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1276.t: satigur vin kinai na paiaa man vekhahu ridhai beechaar ||
1276.e: Without the True Guru, no one finds it; see this in your mind, and consider this in your heart.

1276.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
1276.t: vaddabhaagee gur paiaa bhavajal utare paar ||6||
1276.e: By great good fortune, the mortal finds the Guru, and crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||

1276.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
1276.t: har naamaa(n) har Tek hai har har naam adhaar ||
1276.e: The Name of the Lord is my Anchor and Support. I take only the Support of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

1276.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਵਉ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
1276.t: kirapaa karahu gur melahu har jeeau paavau mokh dhuaar ||7||
1276.e: O Dear Lord, please be kind and lead me to meet the Guru, that I may find the Door of Salvation. ||7||

1276.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1276.t: masatak lilaaT likhiaa dhur Thaakur meTanaa na jai ||
1276.e: The pre-ordained destiny inscribed on the mortal's forehead by our Lord and Master cannot be erased.

1276.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
1276.t: naanak se jan pooran hoe jin har bhaanaa bhai ||8||1||
1276.e: O Nanak, those humble beings are perfect, who are pleased by the Lord's Will. ||8||1||

1276.g: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1276.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
1276.e: Malaar, Third Mehla:

1276.g: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1276.t: bedh baanee jag varatadhaa trai gun kare beechaar ||
1276.e: The world is involved with the words of the Vedas, thinking about the three gunas - the three dispositions.

1276.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
1276.t: bin naavai jam dda(n)dd sahai mar janamai vaaro vaar ||
1276.e: Without the Name, it suffers punishment by the Messenger of Death; it comes and goes in reincarnation, over and over again.

1276.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
1276.t: satigur bheTe mukat hoi paae mokh dhuaar ||1||
1276.e: Meeting with the True Guru, the world is liberated, and finds the Door of Salvation. ||1||

1276.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
1276.t: man re satigur sev samai ||
1276.e: O mortal, immerse yourself in service to the True Guru.

1276.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1276.t: vaddai bhaag gur pooraa paiaa har har naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
1276.e: By great good fortune, the mortal finds the Perfect Guru, and meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

1276.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
1276.t: har aapanai bhaanai sirasaT upaiee har aape dhei adhaar ||
1276.e: The Lord, by the Pleasure of His Own Will, created the Universe, and the Lord Himself gives it sustenance and support.

1276.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1276.t: har aapanai bhaanai man niramal keeaa har siau laagaa piaar ||
1276.e: The Lord, by His Own Will, makes the mortal's mind immaculate, and lovingly attunes him to the Lord.

1276.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
1276.t: har kai bhaanai satigur bheTiaa sabh janam savaaranahaar ||2||
1276.e: The Lord, by His Own Will, leads the mortal to meet the True Guru, the Embellisher of all his lives. ||2||

1276.g: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
1276.t: vaahu vaahu baanee sat hai gurmukh boojhai koi ||
1276.e: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Word of His Bani. Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand.

1276.g: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
1276.t: vaahu vaahu kar prabh saalaaheeaai tis jevadd avar na koi ||
1276.e: Waaho! Waaho! Praise God as Great! No one else is as Great as He.

1276.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
1276.t: aape bakhase mel le karam paraapat hoi ||3||
1276.e: When God's Grace is received, He Himself forgives the mortal, and unites him with Himself. ||3||

1276.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਾਹਰੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
1276.t: saachaa saahib maaharo satigur dheeaa dhikhai ||
1276.e: The True Guru has revealed our True, Supreme Lord and Master.

1276.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
1276.t: a(n)mrit varasai man sa(n)tokheeaai sach rahai liv lai ||
1276.e: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down and the mind is satisfied, remaining lovingly attuned to the True Lord.

1276.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਸੁਕੈ ਨਾ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
1276.t: har kai nai sadhaa hareeaavalee fir sukai naa kumalai ||4||
1276.e: In the Lord's Name, it is forever rejuvenated; it shall never wither and dry up again. ||4||

1277.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
1277.t: bin satigur kinai na paio man vekhahu ko pateeaai ||
1277.e: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; anyone can try and see.

1277.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭੇਟੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
1277.t: har kirapaa te satigur paieeaai bheTai sahaj subhai ||
1277.e: By the Lord's Grace, the True Guru is found, and then the Lord is met with intuitive ease.

1277.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
1277.t: manmukh bharam bhulaiaa bin bhaagaa har dhan na pai ||5||
1277.e: The self-willed manmukh is deluded by doubt; without good destiny, the Lord's wealth is not obtained. ||5||

1277.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1277.t: trai gun sabhaa dhaat hai paR paR kareh veechaar ||
1277.e: The three dispositions are completely distracting; people read and study and contemplate them.

1277.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਹੁ ਪਾਇਨਿੑ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
1277.t: mukat kadhe na hoviee nahu paini(h) mokh dhuaar ||
1277.e: Those people are never liberated; they do not find the Door of Salvation.

1277.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੰਧਨ ਨ ਤੁਟਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
1277.t: bin satigur ba(n)dhan na tuTahee naam na lagai piaar ||6||
1277.e: Without the True Guru, they are never released from bondage; they do not embrace love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

1277.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਬੇਦਾਂ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ॥
1277.t: paR paR pa(n)ddit monee thake bedhaa(n) kaa abhiaas ||
1277.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages, reading and studying the Vedas, have grown weary.

1277.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਹ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
1277.t: har naam chit na aaviee neh nij ghar hovai vaas ||
1277.e: They do not even think of the Lord's Name; they do not dwell in the home of their own inner being.

1277.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
1277.t: jamakaal sirahu na utarai a(n)tar kapaT vinaas ||7||
1277.e: The Messenger of Death hovers over their heads; they are ruined by the deceit within themselves. ||7||

1277.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਪਰਤਾਪਦਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1277.t: har naavai no sabh ko parataapadhaa vin bhaagaa(n) paiaa na jai ||
1277.e: Everyone longs for the Name of the Lord; without good destiny, it is not obtained.

1277.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
1277.t: nadhar kare gur bheTeeaai har naam vasai man aai ||
1277.e: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, the mortal meets the True Guru, and the Lord's Name comes to dwell within the mind.

1277.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
1277.t: naanak naame hee pat uoopajai har siau rahaa(n) samai ||8||2||
1277.e: O Nanak, through the Name, honor wells up, and the mortal remains immersed in the Lord. ||8||2||

1277.t: malaar mahalaa teejaa asaTapadhee ghar doojaa ||
1277.e: Malaar, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1277.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
1277.t: har har kirapaa kare gur kee kaarai laae ||
1277.e: When the Lord shows His Mercy, He enjoins the mortal to work for the Guru.
His pains are taken away, and the Lord's Name comes to dwell within.
True deliverance comes by focusing one's consciousness on the True Lord.
Listen to the Shabad, and the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||1||

1277.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
1277.t: man mere har har sev nidhaan ||
1277.e: O my mind, serve the Lord, Har, Har, the true treasure.

1277.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
1277.t: gur kirapaa te har dhan paieeaai anadhin laagai sahaj dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
1277.e: By Guru's Grace, the wealth of the Lord is obtained. Night and day, focus your meditation on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The soul-bride who adorns herself without her Husband Lord,
is ill-mannered and vile, wasted away into ruin.
This is the useless way of life of the self-willed manmukh.
Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he performs all sorts of empty rituals. ||2||
The bride who is Gurmukh is beautifully embellished.
Through the Word of the Shabad, she enshrines her Husband Lord within her heart.
She realizes the One Lord, and subdues her ego.
That soul-bride is virtuous and noble. ||3||

1277.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1277.t: bin gur dhaate kinai na paiaa ||
1277.e: Without the Guru, the Giver, no one finds the Lord.
The greedy self-willed manmukh is attracted and engrossed in duality.
Only a few spiritual teachers realize this,

1277.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
1277.t: bin gur bheTe mukat na hoi ||4||
1277.e: that without meeting the Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||4||

1277.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
1277.t: keh keh kahan kahai sabh koi ||
1277.e: Everyone tells the stories told by others.

1277.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਮੂਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
1277.t: bin man mooe bhagat na hoi ||
1277.e: Without subduing the mind, devotional worship does not come.
When the intellect achieves spiritual wisdom, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in that heart. ||5||
In egotism, everyone can pretend to worship God with devotion.

1277.g: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1277.t: naa man bheejai naa sukh hoi ||
1277.e: But this does not soften the mind, and it does not bring peace.
By speaking and preaching, the mortal only shows off his self-conceit.
His devotional worship is useless, and his life is a total waste. ||6||
They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to the Mind of the True Guru.
Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the Name.
They behold the Naam, the Name of the Lord, ever-present, near at hand.

1278.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੭॥
1278.t: gur kai sabadh rahiaa bharapoor ||7||
1278.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||7||

1278.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1278.t: aape bakhase dhei piaar ||
1278.e: God Himself forgives, and bestows His Love.

1278.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
1278.t: haumai rog vaddaa sa(n)saar ||
1278.e: The world is suffering from the terrible disease of egotism.

1278.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਏਹੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
1278.t: gur kirapaa te eh rog jai ||
1278.e: By Guru's Grace, this disease is cured.

1278.t: naanak saache saach samai ||8||1||3||5||8||
1278.e: O Nanak, through the Truth, the mortal remains immersed in the True Lord. ||8||1||3||5||8||

1278.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
1278.t: raag malaar chha(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ||
1278.e: Raag Malaar, Chhant, Fifth Mehla:

1278.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1278.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1278.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1278.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
1278.t: preetam prem bhagat ke dhaate ||
1278.e: My Beloved Lord is the Giver of loving devotional worship.

1278.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
1278.t: apane jan sa(n)g raate ||
1278.e: His humble servants are imbued with His Love.

1278.g: ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
1278.t: jan sa(n)g raate dhinas raate ik nimakh manahu na veesarai ||
1278.e: He is imbued with His servants, day and night; He does not forget them from His Mind, even for an instant.

1278.g: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
1278.t: gopaal gun nidh sadhaa sa(n)ge sarab gun jagadheesarai ||
1278.e: He is the Lord of the World, the Treasure of virtue; He is always with me. All glorious virtues belong to the Lord of the Universe.

1278.g: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਜਨ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
1278.t: man moh leenaa charan sa(n)ge naam ras jan maate ||
1278.e: With His Feet, He has fascinated my mind; as His humble servant, I am intoxicated with love for His Name.

1278.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸਦਹੂੰ ਕਿਨੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
1278.t: naanak preetam kirapaal sadhahoo(n) kinai koT madhe jaate ||1||
1278.e: O Nanak, my Beloved is forever Merciful; out of millions, hardly anyone realizes Him. ||1||

1278.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
1278.t: preetam teree gat agam apaare ||
1278.e: O Beloved, Your state is inaccessible and infinite.

1278.g: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਤੁਮੑ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
1278.t: mahaa patit tum(h) taare ||
1278.e: You save even the worst sinners.

1278.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸੁਆਮੀਆ ॥
1278.t: patit paavan bhagat vachhal kirapaa si(n)dh suaameeaa ||
1278.e: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His devotees, the Ocean of mercy, our Lord and Master.

1278.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗੇ ਭਜੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੇ ਰਂਉ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀਆ ॥
1278.t: sa(n)tasa(n)ge bhaj nisa(n)ge ra(n)au sadhaa a(n)tarajaameeaa ||
1278.e: In the Society of the Saints, vibrate and meditate on Him with commitment forever; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

1278.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਜੋਨੀ ਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
1278.t: koT janam bhrama(n)t jonee te naam simarat taare ||
1278.e: Those who wander in reincarnation through millions of births, are saved and carried across, by meditating in remembrance on the Naam.

1278.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
1278.t: naanak dharas piaas har jeeau aap leh sam(h)aare ||2||
1278.e: Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Dear Lord; please take care of him. ||2||

1278.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
1278.t: har charan kamal man leenaa ||
1278.e: My mind is absorbed in the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

1278.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਲ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
1278.t: prabh jal jan tere meenaa ||
1278.e: O God, You are the water; Your humble servants are fish.

1278.g: ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਏਕ ਤੂਹੈ ਭਿੰਨ ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
1278.t: jal meen prabh jeeau ek toohai bhi(n)n aan na jaaneeaai ||
1278.e: O Dear God, You alone are the water and the fish. I know that there is no difference between the two.

1278.g: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
1278.t: geh bhujaa levahu naam dhevahu tau prasaadhee maaneeaai ||
1278.e: Please take hold of my arm and bless me with Your Name. I am honored only by Your Grace.

1278.g: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਏਕ ਰੰਗੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
1278.t: bhaj saadhasa(n)ge ek ra(n)ge kirapaal gobidh dheenaa ||
1278.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate and meditate with love on the One Lord of the Universe, who is Merciful to the meek.

1278.g: ਅਨਾਥ ਨੀਚ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
1278.t: anaath neech saranai naanak kar miaa apunaa keenaa ||3||
1278.e: Nanak, the lowly and helpless, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, who in His Kindness has made him His Own. ||3||

1278.g: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
1278.t: aapas kau aap milaiaa ||
1278.e: He unites us with Himself.

1278.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
1278.t: bhram bha(n)jan har raiaa ||
1278.e: Our Sovereign Lord King is the Destroyer of fear.

1278.g: ਆਚਰਜ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
1278.t: aacharaj suaamee a(n)tarajaamee mile gun nidh piaariaa ||
1278.e: My Wondrous Lord and Master is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. My Beloved, the Treasure of virtue, has met me.

1278.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
1278.t: mahaa ma(n)gal sookh upaje gobi(n)dh gun nit saariaa ||
1278.e: Supreme happiness and peace well up, as I cherish the Glorious Virtues of the Lord of the Universe.

1278.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਹੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1278.t: mil sa(n)g sohe dhekh mohe purab likhiaa paiaa ||
1278.e: Meeting with Him, I am embellished and exalted; gazing on Him, I am fascinated, and I realize my pre-ordained destiny.

1278.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
1278.t: binava(n)t naanak saran tin kee jin(h)ee har har dhiaaiaa ||4||1||
1278.e: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||

1278.g: ਵਾਰ ਮਲਾਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਰਾਣੇ ਕੈਲਾਸ ਤਥਾ ਮਾਲਦੇ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ॥
1278.t: vaar malaar kee mahalaa pehilaa raane kailaas tathaa maaladhe kee dhun ||
1278.e: Vaar Of Malaar, First Mehla, Sung To The Tune Of Rana Kailaash And Malda:

1278.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1278.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
1278.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

1278.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
1278.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1278.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1278.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਵੁਠੈ ਧਰਣਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
1278.t: gur miliaai man rahaseeaai jiau vuThai dharan seegaar ||
1278.e: Meeting with the Guru, the mind is delighted, like the earth embellished by the rain.

1278.g: ਸਭ ਦਿਸੈ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਸਰ ਭਰੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਤਾਲ ॥
1278.t: sabh dhisai hareeaavalee sar bhare subhar taal ||
1278.e: Everything becomes green and lush; the pools and ponds are filled to overflowing.

1278.g: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਿਉ ਮੰਜੀਠੈ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
1278.t: a(n)dhar rachai sach ra(n)g jiau ma(n)jeeThai laal ||
1278.e: The inner self is imbued with the deep crimson color of love for the True Lord.

1278.g: ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
1278.t: kamal vigasai sach man gur kai sabadh nihaal ||
1278.e: The heart-lotus blossoms forth and the mind becomes true; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is ecstatic and exalted.

1279.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੀ ਤਰਫ ਹੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
1279.t: manmukh dhoojee taraf hai vekhahu nadhar nihaal ||
1279.e: The self-willed manmukh is on the wrong side. You can see this with your own eyes.

1279.g: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
1279.t: faahee faathe mirag jiau sir dheesai jamakaal ||
1279.e: He is caught in the trap like the deer; the Messenger of Death hovers over his head.

1279.g: ਖੁਧਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਕਰਾਲੁ ॥
1279.t: khudhiaa tirasanaa ni(n)dhaa buree kaam karodh vikaraal ||
1279.e: Hunger, thirst and slander are evil; sexual desire and anger are horrible.

1279.g: ਏਨੀ ਅਖੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1279.t: enee akhee nadhar na aaviee jichar sabadh na kare beechaar ||
1279.e: These cannot be seen with your eyes, until you contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

1279.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ਚੂਕੈ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
1279.t: tudh bhaavai sa(n)tokheeaa(n) chookai aal ja(n)jaal ||
1279.e: Whoever is pleasing to You is content; all his entanglements are gone.

1279.g: ਮੂਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ॥
