1279.t: mool rahai gur seviaai gur pauRee bohith ||
1279.e: Serving the Guru, his capital is preserved. The Guru is the ladder and the boat.

1279.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਗੀ ਤਤੁ ਲੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
1279.t: naanak lagee tat lai too(n) sachaa man sach ||1||
1279.e: O Nanak, whoever is attached to the Lord receives the essence; O True Lord, You are found when the mind is true. ||1||

1279.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
1279.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1279.e: First Mehla:

1279.g: ਹੇਕੋ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਹੇਕੁ ਦਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
1279.t: heko paadhar hek dhar gur pauRee nij thaan ||
1279.e: There is one path and one door. The Guru is the ladder to reach one's own place.

1279.g: ਰੂੜਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
1279.t: rooRau Thaakur naanakaa sabh sukh saachau naam ||2||
1279.e: Our Lord and Master is so beautiful, O Nanak; all comfort and peace are in the Name of the True Lord. ||2||

1279.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1279.t: pauRee ||
1279.e: Pauree:

1279.g: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
1279.t: aapeen(h)ai aap saaj aap pachhaaniaa ||
1279.e: He Himself created Himself; He Himself understands Himself.

1279.g: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿ ਚੰਦੋਆ ਤਾਣਿਆ ॥
1279.t: a(n)bar dharat vichhoR cha(n)dhoaa taaniaa ||
1279.e: Separating the sky and the earth, He has spread out His canopy.

1279.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਥੰਮੑਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
1279.t: vin tha(n)m(h)aa gagan rahai sabadh neesaaniaa ||
1279.e: Without any pillars, He supports the sky, through the insignia of His Shabad.

1279.g: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
1279.t: sooraj cha(n)dh upai jot samaaniaa ||
1279.e: Creating the sun and the moon, He infused His Light into them.

1279.g: ਕੀਏ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਿਆ ॥
1279.t: ke'ee raat dhina(n)t choj viddaaniaa ||
1279.e: He created the night and the day; Wondrous are His miraculous plays.

1279.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਨਾਵਣ ਪੁਰਬਾਣਿਆ ॥
1279.t: teerath dharam veechaar naavan purabaaniaa ||
1279.e: He created the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where people contemplate righteousness and Dharma, and take cleansing baths on special occasions.

1279.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
1279.t: tudh sar avar na koi k aakh vakhaaniaa ||
1279.e: There is no other equal to You; how can we speak and describe You?

1279.g: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੋਰ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
1279.t: sachai takhat nivaas hor aavan jaaniaa ||1||
1279.e: You are seated on the throne of Truth; all others come and go in reincarnation. ||1||

1279.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1279.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1279.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1279.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਚਹੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
1279.t: naanak saavan je vasai chahu omaahaa hoi ||
1279.e: O Nanak, when it rains in the month of Saawan, four are delighted:

1279.g: ਨਾਗਾਂ ਮਿਰਗਾਂ ਮਛੀਆਂ ਰਸੀਆਂ ਘਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
1279.t: naagaa(n) miragaa(n) machheeaa(n) raseeaa(n) ghar dhan hoi ||1||
1279.e: the snake, the deer, the fish and the wealthy people who seek pleasure. ||1||

1279.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1279.e: First Mehla:

1279.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਚਹੁ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
1279.t: naanak saavan je vasai chahu vechhoRaa hoi ||
1279.e: O Nanak, when it rains in the month of Saawan, four suffer the pains of separation:

1279.g: ਗਾਈ ਪੁਤਾ ਨਿਰਧਨਾ ਪੰਥੀ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
1279.t: gaiee putaa niradhanaa pa(n)thee chaakar hoi ||2||
1279.e: the cow's calves, the poor, the travellers and the servants. ||2||

1279.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1279.t: pauRee ||
1279.e: Pauree:

1279.g: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: too sachaa sachiaar jin sach varataiaa ||
1279.e: You are True, O True Lord; You dispense True Justice.

1279.g: ਬੈਠਾ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇ ਕਵਲੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: baiThaa taaRee lai kaval chhapaiaa ||
1279.e: Like a lotus, You sit in the primal celestial trance; You are hidden from view.

1279.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: brahamai vaddaa kahai a(n)t na paiaa ||
1279.e: Brahma is called great, but even he does not know Your limits.

1279.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇ ਕਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: naa tis baap na mai kin too jaiaa ||
1279.e: You have no father or mother; who gave birth to You?

1279.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਵਰਨ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: naa tis roop na rekh varan sabaiaa ||
1279.e: You have no form or feature; You transcend all social classes.

1279.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੁਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਜਾ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: naa tis bhukh piaas rajaa dhaiaa ||
1279.e: You have no hunger or thirst; You are satisfied and satiated.

1279.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਸਮੋਇ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: gur meh aap samoi sabadh varataiaa ||
1279.e: You have merged Yourself into the Guru; You are pervading through the Word of Your Shabad.

1279.g: ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
1279.t: sache hee pateeaai sach samaiaa ||2||
1279.e: When he is pleasing to the True Lord, the mortal merges in Truth. ||2||

1279.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1279.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1279.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1279.g: ਵੈਦੁ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ਵੈਦਗੀ ਪਕੜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲੇ ਬਾਂਹ ॥
1279.t: vaidh bulaiaa vaidhagee pakaR dda(n)ddole baa(n)h ||
1279.e: The physician was called in; he touched my arm and felt my pulse.

1279.g: ਭੋਲਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਰਕ ਕਲੇਜੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
1279.t: bholaa vaidh na jaaniee karak kaleje maeh ||1||
1279.e: The foolish physician did not know that the pain was in the mind. ||1||

1279.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
1279.e: Second Mehla:

1279.g: ਵੈਦਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਵੈਦੁ ਤੂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਰੋਗੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
1279.t: vaidhaa vaidh suvaidh too pahilaa(n) rog pachhaan ||
1279.e: O physician, you are a competent physician, if you first diagnose the disease.

1279.g: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ॥
1279.t: aaisaa dhaaroo loR lahu jit va(n)n(j)ai rogaa ghaan ||
1279.e: Prescribe such a remedy, by which all sorts of illnesses may be cured.

1279.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਰੋਗ ਉਠਿਅਹਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥
1279.t: jit dhaaroo rog uThieh tan sukh vasai aai ||
1279.e: Administer that medicine, which will cure the disease, and allow peace to come and dwell in the body.

1279.g: ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਵੈਦੁ ਸਦਾਇ ॥੨॥
1279.t: rog gavaieh aapanaa ta naanak vaidh sadhai ||2||
1279.e: Only when you are rid of your own disease, O Nanak, will you be known as a physician. ||2||

1279.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1279.t: pauRee ||
1279.e: Pauree:

1279.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਦੇਵ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: brahamaa bisan mahes dhev upaiaa ||
1279.e: Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and the deities were created.

1279.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਦਿਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: brahame dhite bedh poojaa laiaa ||
1279.e: Brahma was given the Vedas, and enjoined to worship God.

1279.g: ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
1279.t: dhas avataaree raam raajaa aaiaa ||
1279.e: The ten incarnations, and Rama the king, came into being.

1279.g: ਦੈਤਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਧਾਇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: dhaitaa maare dhai hukam sabaiaa ||
1279.e: According to His Will, they quickly killed all the demons.

1279.g: ਈਸ ਮਹੇਸੁਰੁ ਸੇਵ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: e'ees mahesur sev tin(h)ee a(n)t na paiaa ||
1279.e: Shiva serves Him, but cannot find His limits.

1279.g: ਸਚੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: sachee keemat pai takhat rachaiaa ||
1279.e: He established His throne on the principles of Truth.

1279.g: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ਆਪੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
1279.t: dhuneeaa dha(n)dhai lai aap chhapaiaa ||
1279.e: He enjoined all the world to its tasks, while He keeps Himself hidden from view.

1280.g: ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਮ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
1280.t: dharam karaae karam dhurahu furamaiaa ||3||
1280.e: The Primal Lord has ordained that mortals must practice righteousness. ||3||

1280.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
1280.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
1280.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

1280.g: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਕੰਤੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
1280.t: saavan aaiaa he sakhee ka(n)tai chit kareh ||
1280.e: The month of Saawan has come, O my companions; think of your Husband Lord.

1280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਅਵਰੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
1280.t: naanak jhoor mareh dhohaaganee jin(h) avaree laagaa neh ||1||
1280.e: O Nanak, the discarded bride is in love with another; now she weeps and wails, and dies. ||1||

1280.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
1280.e: Second Mehla:

1280.g: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਜਲਹਰੁ ਬਰਸਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
1280.t: saavan aaiaa he sakhee jalahar barasanahaar ||
1280.e: The month of Saawan has come, O my companions; the clouds have burst forth with rain.

1280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
1280.t: naanak sukh savan sohaaganee jin(h) seh naal piaar ||2||
1280.e: O Nanak, the blessed soul-brides sleep in peace; they are in love with their Husband Lord. ||2||

1280.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1280.t: pauRee ||
1280.e: Pauree:

1280.g: ਆਪੇ ਛਿੰਝ ਪਵਾਇ ਮਲਾਖਾੜਾ ਰਚਿਆ ॥
1280.t: aape chhi(n)jh pavai malaakhaaRaa rachiaa ||
1280.e: He Himself has staged the tournament, and arranged the arena for the wrestlers.

1280.g: ਲਥੇ ਭੜਥੂ ਪਾਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਚਿਆ ॥
1280.t: lathe bhaRathoo pai gurmukh machiaa ||
1280.e: They have entered the arena with pomp and ceremony; the Gurmukhs are joyful.

1280.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਰੇ ਪਛਾੜਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਚਿਆ ॥
1280.t: manmukh maare pachhaaR moorakh kachiaa ||
1280.e: The false and foolish self-willed manmukhs are defeated and overcome.

1280.g: ਆਪਿ ਭਿੜੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਰਚਿਆ ॥
1280.t: aap bhiRai maare aap aap kaaraj rachiaa ||
1280.e: The Lord Himself wrestles, and He Himself defeats them. He Himself staged this play.

1280.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
1280.t: sabhanaa khasam ek hai gurmukh jaaneeaai ||
1280.e: The One God is the Lord and Master of all; this is known by the Gurmukhs.

1280.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਲਿਖੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਲਮ ਮਸਵਾਣੀਐ ॥
1280.t: hukamee likhai sir lekh vin kalam masavaaneeaai ||
1280.e: He writes the inscription of His Hukam on the foreheads of all, without pen or ink.

1280.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
1280.t: satasa(n)gat melaap jithai har gun sadhaa vakhaaneeaai ||
1280.e: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, Union with Him is obtained; there, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are chanted forever.

1280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੪॥
1280.t: naanak sachaa sabadh salaeh sach pachhaaneeaai ||4||
1280.e: O Nanak, praising the True Word of His Shabad, one comes to realize the Truth. ||4||

1280.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1280.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1280.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1280.g: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਅਵਰਿ ਕਰੇਂਦਾ ਵੰਨ ॥
1280.t: uoo(n)nav uoo(n)nav aaiaa avar kare(n)dhaa va(n)n ||
1280.e: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds are changing color.

1280.g: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਵ ਰਹਸੀ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
1280.t: kiaa jaanaa tis saeh siau kev rahasee ra(n)g ||
1280.e: How do I know whether my love for my Husband Lord shall endure?

1280.g: ਰੰਗੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
1280.t: ra(n)g rahiaa tin(h) kaamanee jin(h) man bhau bhaau hoi ||
1280.e: The love of those soul-brides endures, if their minds are filled with the Love and the Fear of God.

1280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
1280.t: naanak bhai bhai baaharee tin tan sukh na hoi ||1||
1280.e: O Nanak, she who has no Love and Fear of God - her body shall never find peace. ||1||

1280.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1280.e: Third Mehla:

1280.g: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸੈ ਨੀਰੁ ਨਿਪੰਗੁ ॥
1280.t: uoo(n)nav uoo(n)nav aaiaa varasai neer nipa(n)g ||
1280.e: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds come, and pure water rains down.

1280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੰਤੈ ਸਿਉ ਮਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
1280.t: naanak dhukh laagaa tin(h) kaamanee jin(h) ka(n)tai siau man bha(n)g ||2||
1280.e: O Nanak, that soul-bride suffers in pain, whose mind is torn away from her Husband Lord. ||2||

1280.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1280.t: pauRee ||
1280.e: Pauree:

1280.g: ਦੋਵੈ ਤਰਫਾ ਉਪਾਇ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ॥
1280.t: dhovai tarafaa upai ik varatiaa ||
1280.e: The One Lord created both sides and pervades the expanse.

1280.g: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਰਤਾਇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
1280.t: bedh baanee varatai a(n)dhar vaadh ghatiaa ||
1280.e: The words of the Vedas became pervasive, with arguments and divisions.

1280.g: ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਨਿਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਹਾਠਾ ਦੋਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਰੈਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
1280.t: paravirat niravirat haaThaa dhovai vich dharam firai raibaariaa ||
1280.e: Attachment and detachment are the two sides of it; Dharma, true religion, is the guide between the two.

1280.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਚੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
1280.t: manmukh kache kooRiaar tin(h)ee nihachau dharageh haariaa ||
1280.e: The self-willed manmukhs are worthless and false. Without a doubt, they lose in the Court of the Lord.

1280.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ ਹੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
1280.t: gurmatee sabadh soor hai kaam karodh jin(h)ee maariaa ||
1280.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings are the true spiritual warriors; they have conquered sexual desire and anger.

1280.g: ਸਚੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
1280.t: sachai a(n)dhar mahal sabadh savaariaa ||
1280.e: They enter into the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, embellished and exalted by the Word of the Shabad.

1280.g: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
1280.t: se bhagat tudh bhaavadhe sachai nai piaariaa ||
1280.e: Those devotees are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord; they dearly love the True Name.

1280.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੫॥
1280.t: satigur sevan aapanaa tin(h)aa viTahu hau vaariaa ||5||
1280.e: I am a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru. ||5||

1280.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1280.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1280.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1280.g: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸੈ ਲਾਇ ਝੜੀ ॥
1280.t: uoo(n)nav uoo(n)nav aaiaa varasai lai jhaRee ||
1280.e: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds come, and water rains down in torrents.

1280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਕੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਲੀ ॥੧॥
1280.t: naanak bhaanai chalai ka(n)t kai su maane sadhaa ralee ||1||
1280.e: O Nanak, she walks in harmony with the Will of her Husband Lord; she enjoys peace and pleasure forever. ||1||

1280.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1280.e: Third Mehla:

1280.g: ਕਿਆ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬਪੁੜੇਂ ਇਸੁ ਮੇਘੈ ਹਥਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1280.t: kiaa uTh uTh dhekhahu bapuRe(n) is meghai hath kichh naeh ||
1280.e: Why are you standing up, standing up to look? You poor wretch, this cloud has nothing in its hands.

1280.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਘੁ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹਿ ॥
1280.t: jin eh megh paThaiaa tis raakhahu man maa(n)h ||
1280.e: The One who sent this cloud - cherish Him in your mind.

1280.g: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਸੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
1280.t: tis no ma(n)n vasaisee jaa kau nadhar karei ||
1280.e: He alone enshrines the Lord in his mind, upon whom the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

1280.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸਭ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
1280.t: naanak nadharee baaharee sabh karan palaeh karei ||2||
1280.e: O Nanak, all those who lack this Grace, cry and weep and wail. ||2||

1280.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1280.t: pauRee ||
1280.e: Pauree:

1280.g: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਾਰ ॥
1280.t: so har sadhaa sareveeaai jis karat na laagai vaar ||
1280.e: Serve the Lord forever; He acts in no time at all.

1280.g: ਆਡਾਣੇ ਆਕਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
1280.t: aaddaane aakaas kar khin meh ddaeh usaaranahaar ||
1280.e: He stretched the sky across the heavens; in an instant, He creates and destroys.

1280.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
1280.t: aape jagat upai kai kudharat kare veechaar ||
1280.e: He Himself created the world; He contemplates His Creative Omnipotence.

1280.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਾਰ ॥
1280.t: manmukh agai lekhaa ma(n)geeaai bahutee hovai maar ||
1280.e: The self-willed manmukh will be called to account hereafter; he will be severely punished.

1281.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
1281.t: gurmukh pat siau lekhaa nibaRai bakhase sifat bha(n)ddaar ||
1281.e: The Gurmukh's account is settled with honor; the Lord blesses him with the treasure of His Praise.

1281.g: ਓਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਅਪੜੈ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
1281.t: othai hath na apaRai kook na suneeaai pukaar ||
1281.e: No one's hands can reach there; no one will hear anyone's cries.

1281.g: ਓਥੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਅੰਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
1281.t: othai satigur belee hovai kadd le a(n)tee vaar ||
1281.e: The True Guru will be your best friend there; at the very last instant, He will save you.

1281.g: ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਹੋਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੬॥
1281.t: enaa ja(n)taa no hor sevaa nahee satigur sir karataar ||6||
1281.e: These beings should serve no other than the True Guru or the Creator Lord above the heads of all. ||6||

1281.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1281.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1281.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1281.g: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਪੂਕਾਰਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
1281.t: baabeehaa jis no too pookaaradhaa tis no lochai sabh koi ||
1281.e: O rainbird, the One unto whom you call - everyone longs for that Lord.

1281.g: ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਸੀ ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
1281.t: apanee kirapaa kar kai vasasee van tiran hariaa hoi ||
1281.e: When He grants His Grace, it rains, and the forests and fields blossom forth in their greenery.

1281.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
1281.t: gur parasaadhee paieeaai viralaa boojhai koi ||
1281.e: By Guru's Grace, He is found; only a rare few understand this.

1281.g: ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1281.t: bahadhiaa uThadhiaa nit dhiaaieeaai sadhaa sadhaa sukh hoi ||
1281.e: Sitting down and standing up, meditate continually on Him, and be at peace forever and ever.

1281.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
1281.t: naanak a(n)mrit sadh hee varasadhaa gurmukh dhevai har soi ||1||
1281.e: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar rains down forever; the Lord gives it to the Gurmukh. ||1||

1281.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1281.e: Third Mehla:

1281.g: ਕਲਮਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
1281.t: kalamal hoiee medhanee aradhaas kare liv lai ||
1281.e: When the people of the world are suffering in pain, they call upon the Lord in loving prayer.

1281.g: ਸਚੈ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਕੰਨੁ ਦੇ ਧੀਰਕ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
1281.t: sachai suniaa ka(n)n dhe dheerak dhevai sahaj subhai ||
1281.e: The True Lord naturally listens and hears and gives comfort.

1281.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੈ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
1281.t: ei(n)dhrai no furamaiaa vuThaa chhahabar lai ||
1281.e: He commands the god of rain, and the rain pours down in torrents.

1281.g: ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1281.t: an dhan upajai bahu ghanaa keemat kahan na jai ||
1281.e: Corn and wealth are produced in great abundance and prosperity; their value cannot be estimated.

1281.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
1281.t: naanak naam salaeh too sabhanaa jeeaa dhedhaa rijak sa(n)baeh ||
1281.e: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He reaches out and gives sustenance to all beings.

1281.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
1281.t: jit khaadhai sukh uoopajai fir dhookh na laagai aai ||2||
1281.e: Eating this, peace is produced, and the mortal never again suffers in pain. ||2||

1281.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1281.t: pauRee ||
1281.e: Pauree:

1281.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਚੇ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
1281.t: har jeeau sachaa sach too sache laih milai ||
1281.e: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. You blend those who are truthful into Your Own Being.

1281.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਤਰਫ ਹੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
1281.t: dhoojai dhoojee taraf hai kooR milai na miliaa jai ||
1281.e: Those caught in duality are on the side of duality; entrenched in falsehood, they cannot merge into the Lord.

1281.g: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਐ ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
1281.t: aape joR vichhoRiaai aape kudharat dhei dhikhai ||
1281.e: You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; You display Your Creative Omnipotence.

1281.g: ਮੋਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
1281.t: moh sog vijog hai poorab likhiaa kamai ||
1281.e: Attachment brings the sorrow of separation; the mortal acts in accordance with pre-ordained destiny.

1281.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
1281.t: hau balihaaree tin kau jo har charanee rahai liv lai ||
1281.e: I am a sacrifice to those who remain lovingly attached to the Lord's Feet.

1281.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਐਸੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
1281.t: jiau jal meh kamal alipat hai aaisee banat banai ||
1281.e: They are like the lotus which remains detached, floating upon the water.

1281.g: ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
1281.t: se sukhe'ee sadhaa sohane jin(h) vichahu aap gavai ||
1281.e: They are peaceful and beautiful forever; they eradicate self-conceit from within.

1281.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
1281.t: tin(h) sog vijog kadhe nahee jo har kai a(n)k samai ||7||
1281.e: They never suffer sorrow or separation; they are merged in the Being of the Lord. ||7||

1281.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1281.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1281.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1281.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1281.t: naanak so saalaaheeaai jis vas sabh kichh hoi ||
1281.e: O Nanak, praise the Lord; everything is in His power.

1281.g: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਿਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਹੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
1281.t: tisai sarevih praaneeho tis bin avar na koi ||
1281.e: Serve Him, O mortal beings; there is none other than Him.

1281.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1281.t: gurmukh har prabh man vasai taa(n) sadhaa sadhaa sukh hoi ||
1281.e: The Lord God abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, and then he is at peace, forever and ever.

1281.g: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
1281.t: sahasaa mool na hoviee sabh chi(n)taa vichahu jai ||
1281.e: He is never cynical; all anxiety has been taken out from within him.

1281.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1281.t: jo kichh hoi su sahaje hoi kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||
1281.e: Whatever happens, happens naturally; no one has any say about it.

1281.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
1281.t: sachaa saahib man vasai taa(n) man chi(n)dhiaa fal pai ||
1281.e: When the True Lord abides in the mind, then the mind's desires are fulfilled.

1281.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣੇ ਜਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
1281.t: naanak tin kaa aakhiaa aap sune j lian pa(n)nai pai ||1||
1281.e: O Nanak, He Himself hears the words of those, whose accounts are in His Hands. ||1||

1281.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1281.e: Third Mehla:

1281.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਬੂਝਨਿ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰ ॥
1281.t: a(n)mrit sadhaa varasadhaa boojhan boojhanahaar ||
1281.e: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down continually; realize this through realization.

1281.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1281.t: gurmukh jin(h)ee bujhiaa har a(n)mrit rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
1281.e: Those who, as Gurmukh, realize this, keep the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar enshrined within their hearts.

1281.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
1281.t: har a(n)mrit peeveh sadhaa ra(n)g raate haumai tirasanaa maar ||
1281.e: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and remain forever imbued with the Lord; they conquer egotism and thirsty desires.

1281.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਰਸੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1281.t: a(n)mrit har kaa naam hai varasai kirapaa dhaar ||
1281.e: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar; the Lord showers His Grace, and it rains down.

1281.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
1281.t: naanak gurmukh nadharee aaiaa har aatam raam muraar ||2||
1281.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh comes to behold the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||

1282.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1282.t: pauRee ||
1282.e: Pauree:

1282.g: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਤੋਲੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1282.t: atul kiau toleeaai vin tole paiaa na jai ||
1282.e: How can the unweighable be weighed? Without weighing Him, He cannot be obtained.

1282.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
1282.t: gur kai sabadh veechaareeaai gun meh rahai samai ||
1282.e: Reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and immerse yourself in His Glorious Virtues.

1282.g: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਤੋਲਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
1282.t: apanaa aap aap tolasee aape milai milai ||
1282.e: He Himself weighs Himself; He unites in Union with Himself.

1282.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1282.t: tis kee keemat naa pavai kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||
1282.e: His value cannot be estimated; nothing can be said about this.

1282.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਦਿਤੀ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
1282.t: hau balihaaree gur aapane jin sachee boojh dhitee bujhai ||
1282.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; He has made me realize this true realization.

1282.g: ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
1282.t: jagat musai a(n)mrit luTeeaai manmukh boojh na pai ||
1282.e: The world has been deceived, and the Ambrosial Nectar is being plundered. The self-willed manmukh does not realize this.

1282.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਸੀ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
1282.t: vin naavai naal na chalasee jaasee janam gavai ||
1282.e: Without the Name, nothing will go along with him; he wastes his life, and departs.

1282.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਘਰੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਦੂਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਇ ॥੮॥
1282.t: gurmatee jaage tin(h)ee ghar rakhiaa dhootaa kaa kichh na vasai ||8||
1282.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings and remain awake and aware, preserve and protect the home of their heart; demons have no power against them. ||8||

1282.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1282.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1282.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1282.g: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਨਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ਨਾ ਤਰਸਾਇ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ॥
1282.t: baabeehaa naa bilalai naa tarasai eh man khasam kaa hukam ma(n)n ||
1282.e: O rainbird, do not cry out. Do not let this mind of yours be so thirsty for a drop of water. Obey the Hukam, the Command of your Lord and Master,

1282.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਤਿਖ ਉਤਰੈ ਚੜੈ ਚਵਗਲਿ ਵੰਨੁ ॥੧॥
1282.t: naanak hukam ma(n)niaai tikh utarai chaRai chavagal va(n)n ||1||
1282.e: and your thirst shall be quenched. Your love for Him shall increase four-fold. ||1||

1282.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1282.e: Third Mehla:

1282.g: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
1282.t: baabeehaa jal meh teraa vaas hai jal hee maeh firaeh ||
1282.e: O rainbird, your place is in the water; you move around in the water.

1282.g: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਕੂਕਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
1282.t: jal kee saar na jaanahee taa(n) too(n) kookan paeh ||
1282.e: But you do not appreciate the water, and so you cry out.

1282.g: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1282.t: jal thal chahu dhis varasadhaa khaalee ko thaau naeh ||
1282.e: In the water and on the land, it rains down in the ten directions. No place is left dry.

1282.g: ਏਤੈ ਜਲਿ ਵਰਸਦੈ ਤਿਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1282.t: etai jal varasadhai tikh mareh bhaag tinaa ke naeh ||
1282.e: With so much rain, those who are die of thirst are very unfortunate.

1282.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਜਿਨ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
1282.t: naanak gurmukh tin sojhee piee jin vasiaa man maeh ||2||
1282.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs understand; the Lord abides within their minds. ||2||

1282.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1282.t: pauRee ||
1282.e: Pauree:

1282.g: ਨਾਥ ਜਤੀ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1282.t: naath jatee sidh peer kinai a(n)t na paiaa ||
1282.e: The Yogic Masters, celibates, Siddhas and spiritual teachers - none of them has found the limits of the Lord.

1282.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
1282.t: gurmukh naam dhiaai tujhai samaiaa ||
1282.e: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, and merge in You, O Lord.

1282.g: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1282.t: jug chhateeh gubaar tis hee bhaiaa ||
1282.e: For thirty-six ages, God remained in utter darkness, as He pleased.

1282.g: ਜਲਾ ਬਿੰਬੁ ਅਸਰਾਲੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
1282.t: jalaa bi(n)b asaraal tinai varataiaa ||
1282.e: The vast expanse of water swirled around.

1282.g: ਨੀਲੁ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਸਰਜੀਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
1282.t: neel aneel aga(n)m sarajeet sabaiaa ||
1282.e: The Creator of all is Infinite, Endless and Inaccessible.

1282.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਵਾਦੁ ਭੁਖ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
1282.t: agan upaiee vaadh bhukh tihaiaa ||
1282.e: He formed fire and conflict, hunger and thirst.

1282.g: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1282.t: dhuneeaa kai sir kaal dhoojaa bhaiaa ||
1282.e: Death hangs over the heads of the people of the world, in the love of duality.

1282.g: ਰਖੈ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
1282.t: rakhai rakhanahaar jin sabadh bujhaiaa ||9||
1282.e: The Savior Lord saves those who realize the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

1282.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1282.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1282.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1282.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਲੁ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਵਰਸੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
1282.t: eih jal sabh tai varasadhaa varasai bhai subhai ||
1282.e: This rain pours down on all; it rains down in accordance with God's Loving Will.

1282.g: ਸੇ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
1282.t: se birakhaa hareeaavale jo gurmukh rahe samai ||
1282.e: Those trees become green and lush, which remain immersed in the Guru's Word.

1282.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
1282.t: naanak nadharee sukh hoi enaa ja(n)taa kaa dhukh jai ||1||
1282.e: O Nanak, by His Grace, there is peace; the pain of these creatures is gone. ||1||

1282.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1282.e: Third Mehla:

1282.g: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਚਮਕਿਆ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
1282.t: bhi(n)nee rain chamakiaa vuThaa chhahabar lai ||
1282.e: The night is wet with dew; lightning flashes, and the rain pours down in torrents.

1282.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੈ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
1282.t: jit vuThai an dhan bahut uoopajai jaa(n) sahu kare rajai ||
1282.e: Food and wealth are produced in abundance when it rains, if it is the Will of God.

1282.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਜੀਆਂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
1282.t: jit khaadhai man tirapateeaai jeeaa(n) jugat samai ||
1282.e: Consuming it, the minds of His creatures are satisfied, and they adopt the lifestyle of the way.

1282.g: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਦੇ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
1282.t: eih dhan karate kaa khel hai kadhe aavai kadhe jai ||
1282.e: This wealth is the play of the Creator Lord. Sometimes it comes, and sometimes it goes.

1282.g: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
1282.t: giaaneeaa kaa dhan naam hai sadh hee rahai samai ||
1282.e: The Naam is the wealth of the spiritually wise. It is permeating and pervading forever.

1282.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
1282.t: naanak jin kau nadhar kare taa(n) ih dhan palai pai ||2||
1282.e: O Nanak, those who are blessed with His Glance of Grace receive this wealth. ||2||

1282.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1282.t: pauRee ||
1282.e: Pauree:

1282.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
1282.t: aap karaae kare aap hau kai siau karee pukaar ||
1282.e: He Himself does, and causes all to be done. Unto whom can I complain?

1282.g: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਾਰ ॥
1282.t: aape lekhaa ma(n)gasee aap karaae kaar ||
1282.e: He Himself calls the mortal beings to account; He Himself causes them to act.

1282.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
1282.t: jo tis bhaavai so theeaai hukam kare gaavaar ||
1282.e: Whatever pleases Him happens. Only a fool issues commands.

1282.g: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
1282.t: aap chhaddaae chhuTeeaai aape bakhasanahaar ||
1282.e: He Himself saves and redeems; He Himself is the Forgiver.

1282.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
1282.t: aape vekhai sune aap sabhasai dhe aadhaar ||
1282.e: He Himself sees, and He Himself hears; He gives His Support to all.

1282.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1282.t: sabh meh ek varatadhaa sir sir kare beechaar ||
1282.e: He alone is pervading and permeating all; He considers each and every one.

1283.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1283.t: gurmukh aap veechaareeaai lagai sach piaar ||
1283.e: The Gurmukh reflects on the self, lovingly attached to the True Lord.

1283.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧੦॥
1283.t: naanak kis no aakheeaai aape dhevanahaar ||10||
1283.e: O Nanak, whom can we ask? He Himself is the Great Giver. ||10||

1283.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1283.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1283.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1283.g: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਤ ਕੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
1283.t: baabeehaa eh jagat hai mat ko bharam bhulai ||
1283.e: This world is a rainbird; let no one be deluded by doubt.

1283.g: ਇਹੁ ਬਾਬੀਂਹਾ ਪਸੂ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
1283.t: eih baabee(n)haa pasoo hai is no boojhan naeh ||
1283.e: This rainbird is an animal; it has no understanding at all.

1283.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
1283.t: a(n)mrit har kaa naam hai jit peetai tikh jai ||
1283.e: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.

1283.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
1283.t: naanak gurmukh jin(h) peeaa tin(h) bahuR na laagee aai ||1||
1283.e: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs who drink it in shall never again be afflicted by thirst. ||1||

1283.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1283.e: Third Mehla:

1283.g: ਮਲਾਰੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
1283.t: malaar seetal raag hai har dhiaaiaai saa(n)t hoi ||
1283.e: Malaar is a calming and soothing raga; meditating on the Lord brings peace and tranquility.

1283.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
1283.t: har jeeau apanee kirapaa kare taa(n) varatai sabh loi ||
1283.e: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, then the rain falls on all the people of the world.

1283.g: ਵੁਠੈ ਜੀਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਧਰਣੀ ਨੋ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1283.t: vuThai jeeaa jugat hoi dharanee no seegaar hoi ||
1283.e: From this rain, all creatures find the ways and means to live, and the earth is embellished.

1283.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
1283.t: naanak ih jagat sabh jal hai jal hee te sabh koi ||
1283.e: O Nanak, this world is all water; everything came from water.

1283.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
1283.t: gur parasaadhee ko viralaa boojhai so jan mukat sadhaa hoi ||2||
1283.e: By Guru's Grace, a rare few realize the Lord; such humble beings are liberated forever. ||2||

1283.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1283.t: pauRee ||
1283.e: Pauree:

1283.g: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਇਕੋ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ॥
1283.t: sachaa veparavaahu iko too dhanee ||
1283.e: O True and Independent Lord God, You alone are my Lord and Master.

1283.g: ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦੂਜੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਗਣੀ ॥
1283.t: too sabh kichh aape aap dhooje kis ganee ||
1283.e: You Yourself are everything; who else is of any account?

1283.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਕੂੜਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਣੀ ॥
1283.t: maanas kooRaa garab sachee tudh manee ||
1283.e: False is the pride of man. True is Your glorious greatness.

1283.g: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
1283.t: aavaa gaun rachai upaiee medhanee ||
1283.e: Coming and going in reincarnation, the beings and species of the world came into being.

1283.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਣੀ ॥
1283.t: satigur seve aapanaa aaiaa tis ganee ||
1283.e: But if the mortal serves his True Guru, his coming into the world is judged to be worthwhile.

1283.g: ਜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਕੇਹੀ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀ ॥
1283.t: je haumai vichahu jai ta kehee ganat ganee ||
1283.e: And if he eradicates eogtism from within himself, then how can he be judged?

1283.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਭੁਲਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਣੀ ॥
1283.t: manmukh moh gubaar jiau bhulaa ma(n)jh vanee ||
1283.e: The self-willed manmukh is lost in the darkness of emotional attachment, like the man lost in the wilderness.

1283.g: ਕਟੇ ਪਾਪ ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਵੈ ਇਕ ਕਣੀ ॥੧੧॥
1283.t: kaTe paap asa(n)kh naavai ik kanee ||11||
1283.e: Countless sins are erased, by even a tiny particle of the Lord's Name. ||11||

1283.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1283.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1283.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1283.g: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
1283.t: baabeehaa khasamai kaa mahal na jaanahee mahal dhekh aradhaas pai ||
1283.e: O rainbird, you do not know the Mansion of your Lord and Master's Presence. Offer your prayers to see this Mansion.

1283.g: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
1283.t: aapanai bhaanai bahutaa boleh boliaa thai na pai ||
1283.e: You speak as you please, but your speech is not accepted.

1283.g: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥
1283.t: khasam vaddaa dhaataar hai jo ichhe so fal pai ||
1283.e: Your Lord and Master is the Great Giver; whatever you desire, you shall receive from Him.

1283.g: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਗਤੈ ਕੀ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
1283.t: baabeehaa kiaa bapuRaa jagatai kee tikh jai ||1||
1283.e: Not only the thirst of the poor rainbird, but the thirst of the whole world is quenched. ||1||

1283.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1283.e: Third Mehla:

1283.g: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
1283.t: baabeehaa bhi(n)nee rain boliaa sahaje sach subhai ||
1283.e: The night is wet with dew; the rainbird sings the True Name with intuitive ease.

1283.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
1283.t: eih jal meraa jeeau hai jal bin rahan na jai ||
1283.e: This water is my very soul; without water, I cannot survive.

1283.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
1283.t: gur sabadhee jal paieeaai vichahu aap gavai ||
1283.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, this water is obtained, and egotism is eradicated from within.

1283.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
1283.t: naanak jis bin chasaa na jeevadhee so satigur dheeaa milai ||2||
1283.e: O Nanak, I cannot live without Him, even for a moment; the True Guru has led me to meet Him. ||2||

1283.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1283.t: pauRee ||
1283.e: Pauree:

1283.g: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਅਸੰਖ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
1283.t: kha(n)dd pataal asa(n)kh mai ganat na hoiee ||
1283.e: There are countless worlds and nether regions; I cannot calculate their number.

1283.g: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਗੋਈ ॥
1283.t: too karataa govi(n)dh tudh sirajee tudhai goiee ||
1283.e: You are the Creator, the Lord of the Universe; You create it, and You destroy it.

1283.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
1283.t: lakh chauraaseeh medhanee tujh hee te hoiee ||
1283.e: The 8.4 million species of beings issued forth from You.

1283.g: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਕੋਈ ॥
1283.t: eik raaje khaan malook kaheh kahaaveh koiee ||
1283.e: Some are called kings, emperors and nobles.

1283.g: ਇਕਿ ਸਾਹ ਸਦਾਵਹਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
1283.t: eik saeh sadhaaveh sa(n)ch dhan dhoojai pat khoiee ||
1283.e: Some claim to be bankers and accumulate wealth, but in duality they lose their honor.

1283.g: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
1283.t: eik dhaate ik ma(n)gate sabhanaa sir soiee ||
1283.e: Some are givers, and some are beggars; God is above the heads of all.

1283.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀਆ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
1283.t: vin naavai baajaareeaa bheehaaval hoiee ||
1283.e: Without the Name, they are vulgar, dreadful and wretched.

1283.g: ਕੂੜ ਨਿਖੁਟੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੨॥
1283.t: kooR nikhuTe naanakaa sach kare su hoiee ||12||
1283.e: Falsehood shall not last, O Nanak; whatever the True Lord does, comes to pass. ||12||

1283.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1283.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1283.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1283.g: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
1283.t: baabeehaa gunava(n)tee mahal paiaa aauganava(n)tee dhoor ||
1283.e: O rainbird, the virtuous soul-bride attains the Mansion of her Lord's Presence; the unworthy, unvirtuous one is far away.

1283.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
1283.t: a(n)tar terai har vasai gurmukh sadhaa hajoor ||
1283.e: Deep within your inner being, the Lord abides. The Gurmukh beholds Him ever-present.

1283.g: ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
1283.t: kook pukaar na hoviee nadharee nadhar nihaal ||
1283.e: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, the mortal no longer weeps and wails.

1283.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥
1283.t: naanak naam rate sahaje mile sabadh guroo kai ghaal ||1||
1283.e: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam intuitively merge with the Lord; they practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

1284.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1284.e: Third Mehla:

1284.g: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨ ॥
1284.t: baabeehaa benatee kare kar kirapaa dheh jeea dhaan ||
1284.e: The rainbird prays: O Lord, grant Your Grace, and bless me with the gift of the life of the soul.

1284.g: ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਊਤਰੈ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
1284.t: jal bin piaas na uootarai chhuTak jaa(n)h mere praan ||
1284.e: Without the water, my thirst is not quenched, and my breath of life is ended and gone.

1284.g: ਤੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨੇਧਾਨੁ ॥
1284.t: too sukhadhaataa bea(n)t hai gunadhaataa nedhaan ||
1284.e: You are the Giver of peace, O Infinite Lord God; You are the Giver of the treasure of virtue.

1284.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
1284.t: naanak gurmukh bakhas le a(n)t belee hoi bhagavaan ||2||
1284.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is forgiven; in the end, the Lord God shall be your only friend. ||2||

1284.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1284.t: pauRee ||
1284.e: Pauree:

1284.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1284.t: aape jagat upai kai gun aaugan kare beechaar ||
1284.e: He created the world; He considers the merits and demerits of the mortals.

1284.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1284.t: trai gun sarab ja(n)jaal hai naam na dhare piaar ||
1284.e: Those who are entangled in the three gunas - the three dispositions - do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

1284.g: ਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
1284.t: gun chhodd aaugan kamaavadhe dharageh hoh khuaar ||
1284.e: Forsaking virtue, they practice evil; they shall be miserable in the Court of the Lord.

1284.g: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
1284.t: jooaai janam tinee haariaa kit aae sa(n)saar ||
1284.e: They lose their life in the gamble; why did they even come into the world?

1284.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
1284.t: sachai sabadh man maariaa ahinis naam piaar ||
1284.e: But those who conquer and subdue their minds, through the True Word of the Shabad - night and day, they love the Naam.

1284.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
1284.t: jinee purakhee ur dhaariaa sachaa alakh apaar ||
1284.e: Those people enshrine the True, Invisible and Infinite Lord in their hearts.

1284.g: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਹਿ ਅਸੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰ ॥
1284.t: too gunadhaataa nidhaan heh asee avaganiaar ||
1284.e: You, O Lord, are the Giver, the Treasure of virtue; I am unvirtuous and unworthy.

1284.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧੩॥
1284.t: jis bakhase so paisee gur sabadhee veechaar ||13||
1284.e: He alone finds You, whom You bless and forgive, and inspire to contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||13||

1284.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
1284.t: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
1284.e: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

1284.g: ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਵਿਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਕਤਾਂ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
1284.t: raat na vihaavee saakataa(n) jin(h)aa visarai naau ||
1284.e: The faithless cynics forget the Name of the Lord; the night of their lives does not pass in peace.

1284.g: ਰਾਤੀ ਦਿਨਸ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਂਉ ॥੧॥
1284.t: raatee dhinas suheleeaa naanak har gun gaa(n)au ||1||
1284.e: Their days and nights become comfortable, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

1284.t: mahalaa panjavaa ||
1284.e: Fifth Mehla:

1284.g: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕਾ ਹਭੇ ਮਣੀ ਮਥੰਨਿ ॥
1284.t: ratan javehar maanakaa habhe manee matha(n)n ||
1284.e: All sorts of jewels and gems, diamonds and rubies, shine forth from their foreheads.

1284.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
1284.t: naanak jo prabh bhaaniaa sachai dhar soha(n)n ||2||
1284.e: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God, look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

1284.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1284.t: pauRee ||
1284.e: Pauree:

1284.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿਆ ॥
1284.t: sachaa satigur sev sach sam(h)aaliaa ||
1284.e: Serving the True Guru, I dwell on the True Lord.

1284.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਖਲੋਆ ਆਇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
1284.t: a(n)t khaloaa aai j satigur agai ghaaliaa ||
1284.e: The work you have done for the True Guru shall be very useful in the end.

1284.g: ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
1284.t: poh na sakai jamakaal sachaa rakhavaaliaa ||
1284.e: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch that person who is protected by the True Lord.

1284.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲਿਆ ॥
1284.t: gur saakhee jot jagai dheevaa baaliaa ||
1284.e: Lighting the lamp of the Guru's Teachings, my awareness has been awakened.

1284.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
1284.t: manmukh vin naavai kooRiaar fireh betaaliaa ||
1284.e: The self-willed manmukhs are false; without the Name, they wander around like demons.

1284.g: ਪਸੂ ਮਾਣਸ ਚੰਮਿ ਪਲੇਟੇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥
1284.t: pasoo maanas cha(n)m paleTe a(n)dharahu kaaliaa ||
1284.e: They are nothing more than beasts, wrapped up in human skin; they are black-hearted within.

1284.g: ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
1284.t: sabho varatai sach sachai sabadh nihaaliaa ||
1284.e: The True Lord is pervading all; through the True Word of the Shabad, He is seen.

1284.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੪॥
1284.t: naanak naam nidhaan hai poorai gur dhekhaaliaa ||14||
1284.e: O Nanak, the Naam is the greatest treasure. The Perfect Guru has revealed it to me. ||14||

1284.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1284.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1284.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1284.g: ਬਾਬੀਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
1284.t: baabeehai hukam pachhaaniaa gur kai sahaj subhai ||
1284.e: The rainbird realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command with intuitive ease through the Guru.

1284.g: ਮੇਘੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
1284.t: megh varasai dhiaa kar gooRee chhahabar lai ||
1284.e: The clouds mercifully burst forth, and the rain pours down in torrents.

1284.g: ਬਾਬੀਹੇ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਰਹਿ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
1284.t: baabeehe kook pukaar reh giee sukh vasiaa man aai ||
1284.e: The cries and wailings of the rainbird have ceased, and peace has come to abide in its mind.

1284.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਜੀਆ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
1284.t: naanak so saalaaheeaai j dhe(n)dhaa sabhanaa(n) jeeaa rijak samai ||1||
1284.e: O Nanak, praise that Lord, who reaches out and gives sustenance to all beings and creatures. ||1||

1284.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1284.e: Third Mehla:

1284.g: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤੂ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਿਖਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
1284.t: chaatirak too na jaanahee kiaa tudh vich tikhaa hai kit peetai tikh jai ||
1284.e: O rainbird, you do not know what thirst is within you, or what you can drink to quench it.

1284.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰੰਮਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
1284.t: dhoojai bhai bhara(n)miaa a(n)mirat jal palai na pai ||
1284.e: You wander in the love of duality, and you do not obtain the Ambrosial Water.

1284.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
1284.t: nadhar kare je aapanee taa(n) satigur milai subhai ||
1284.e: When God casts His Glance of Grace, then the mortal automatically meets the True Guru.

1284.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
1284.t: naanak satigur te a(n)mirat jal paiaa sahaje rahiaa samai ||2||
1284.e: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Water is obtained from the True Guru, and then the mortal remains merged in the Lord with intuitive ease. ||2||

1284.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1284.t: pauRee ||
1284.e: Pauree:

1284.g: ਇਕਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਦੁ ਨ ਦੇਵਹੀ ॥
1284.t: eik van kha(n)dd baiseh jai sadh na dhevahee ||
1284.e: Some go and sit in the forest realms, and do not answer any calls.

1284.g: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਕਰੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਜਲੁ ਹੇਂਵਹੀ ॥
1284.t: eik paalaa kakar bha(n)n seetal jal he(n)vahee ||
1284.e: Some, in the dead of winter, break the ice and immerse themselves in freezing water.

1284.g: ਇਕਿ ਭਸਮ ਚੜੑਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵਹੀ ॥
1284.t: eik bhasam chaR(h)aaveh a(n)g mail na dhovahee ||
1284.e: Some rub ashes on their bodies, and never wash off their dirt.

1284.g: ਇਕਿ ਜਟਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਕੁਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਖੋਵਹੀ ॥
1284.t: eik jaTaa bikaT bikaraal kul ghar khovahee ||
1284.e: Some look hideous, with their uncut hair matted and dishevelled. They bring dishonor to their family and ancestry.

1285.g: ਇਕਿ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਹੀ ॥
1285.t: eik nagan fireh dhin raat na(n)eedh na sovahee ||
1285.e: Some wander naked day and night and never sleep.

1285.g: ਇਕਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਆਪੁ ਵਿਗੋਵਹੀ ॥
1285.t: eik agan jalaaveh a(n)g aap vigovahee ||
1285.e: Some burn their limbs in fire, damaging and ruining themselves.

1285.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਰੋਵਹੀ ॥
1285.t: vin naavai tan chhaar kiaa keh rovahee ||
1285.e: Without the Name, the body is reduced to ashes; what good is it to speak and cry then?

1285.g: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਖਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੀ ॥੧੫॥
1285.t: sohan khasam dhuaar j satigur sevahee ||15||
1285.e: Those who serve the True Guru, are embellished and exalted in the Court of their Lord and Master. ||15||

1285.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1285.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1285.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1285.g: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਦਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
1285.t: baabeehaa a(n)mirat velai boliaa taa(n) dhar sunee pukaar ||
1285.e: The rainbird chirps in the ambrosial hours of the morning before the dawn; its prayers are heard in the Court of the Lord.

1285.g: ਮੇਘੈ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਰਸਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1285.t: meghai no furamaan hoaa varasahu kirapaa dhaar ||
1285.e: The order is issued to the clouds, to let the rains of mercy shower down.

1285.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
1285.t: hau tin kai balihaaranai jinee sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
1285.e: I am a sacrifice to those who enshrine the True Lord within their hearts.

1285.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
1285.t: naanak naame sabh hareeaavalee gur kai sabadh veechaar ||1||
1285.e: O Nanak, through the Name, all are rejuvenated, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

1285.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1285.e: Third Mehla:

1285.g: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਇਵ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
1285.t: baabeehaa iv teree tikhaa na utarai je sau kareh pukaar ||
1285.e: O rainbird, this is not the way to quench your thirst, even though you may cry out a hundred times.

1285.g: ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1285.t: nadharee satigur paieeaai nadharee upajai piaar ||
1285.e: By God's Grace, the True Guru is found; by His Grace, love wells up.

1285.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੨॥
1285.t: naanak saahib man vasai vichahu jaeh vikaar ||2||
1285.e: O Nanak, when the Lord and Master abides in the mind, corruption and evil leave from within. ||2||

1285.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1285.t: pauRee ||
1285.e: Pauree:

1285.g: ਇਕਿ ਜੈਨੀ ਉਝੜ ਪਾਇ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
1285.t: eik jainee ujhaR pai dhurahu khuaaiaa ||
1285.e: Some are Jains, wasting their time in the wilderness; by their pre-ordained destiny, they are ruined.

1285.g: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨੑਾਇਆ ॥
1285.t: tin mukh naahee naam na teerath n(h)aiaa ||
1285.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is not on their lips; they do not bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

1285.g: ਹਥੀ ਸਿਰ ਖੋਹਾਇ ਨ ਭਦੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
1285.t: hathee sir khohai na bhadh karaiaa ||
1285.e: They pull out their hair with their hands, instead of shaving.

1285.g: ਕੁਚਿਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1285.t: kuchil raheh dhin raat sabadh na bhaiaa ||
1285.e: They remain unclean day and night; they do not love the Word of the Shabad.

1285.g: ਤਿਨ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਨ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
1285.t: tin jaat na pat na karam janam gavaiaa ||
1285.e: They have no status, no honor, and no good karma. They waste away their lives in vain.

1285.g: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਵੇਜਾਤਿ ਜੂਠਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
1285.t: man jooThai vejaat jooThaa khaiaa ||
1285.e: Their minds are false and impure; that which they eat is impure and defiled.

1285.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਆਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1285.t: bin sabadhai aachaar na kin hee paiaa ||
1285.e: Without the Shabad, no one achieves a lifestyle of good conduct.

1285.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
1285.t: gurmukh oa(n)kaar sach samaiaa ||16||
1285.e: The Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord God, the Universal Creator. ||16||

1285.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1285.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1285.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1285.g: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
1285.t: saavan sarasee kaamanee gur sabadhee veechaar ||
1285.e: In the month of Saawan, the bride is happy, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

1285.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
1285.t: naanak sadhaa suhaaganee gur kai het apaar ||1||
1285.e: O Nanak, she is a happy soul-bride forever; her love for the Guru is unlimited. ||1||

1285.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1285.e: Third Mehla:

1285.g: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਦਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1285.t: saavan dhajhai gun baaharee jis dhoojai bhai piaar ||
1285.e: In Saawan, she who has no virtue is burned, in attachment and love of duality.

1285.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਸਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
1285.t: naanak pir kee saar na jaaniee sabh seegaar khuaar ||2||
1285.e: O Nanak, she does not appreciate the value of her Husband Lord; all her decorations are worthless. ||2||

1285.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1285.t: pauRee ||
1285.e: Pauree:

1285.g: ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਹਠਿ ਨ ਪਤੀਜਈ ॥
1285.t: sachaa alakh abheau haTh na pateejiee ||
1285.e: The True, Unseen, Mysterious Lord is not won over by stubbornness.

1285.g: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀਆ ਰਾਗਿ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ ॥
1285.t: eik gaaveh raag pareeaa raag na bheejiee ||
1285.e: Some sing according to traditional ragas, but the Lord is not pleased by these ragas.

1285.g: ਇਕਿ ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ॥
1285.t: eik nach nach pooreh taal bhagat na keejiee ||
1285.e: Some dance and dance and keep the beat, but they do not worship Him with devotion.

1285.g: ਇਕਿ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜਈ ॥
1285.t: eik a(n)n na khaeh moorakh tinaa kiaa keejiee ||
1285.e: Some refuse to eat; what can be done with these fools?

1285.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਧੀਜਈ ॥
1285.t: tirasanaa hoiee bahut kivai na dheejiee ||
1285.e: Thirst and desire have greatly increased; nothing brings satisfaction.

1285.g: ਕਰਮ ਵਧਹਿ ਕੈ ਲੋਅ ਖਪਿ ਮਰੀਜਈ ॥
1285.t: karam vadheh kai loa khap mareejiee ||
1285.e: Some are tied down by rituals; they hassle themselves to death.

1285.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜਈ ॥
1285.t: laahaa naam sa(n)saar a(n)mrit peejiee ||
1285.e: In this world, profit comes by drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

1285.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਅਸਨੇਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘੀਜਈ ॥੧੭॥
1285.t: har bhagatee asaneh gurmukh gheejiee ||17||
1285.e: The Gurmukhs gather in loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||17||

1285.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
1285.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
1285.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

1285.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਲਾਰ ਰਾਗੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
1285.t: gurmukh malaar raag jo kareh tin man tan seetal hoi ||
1285.e: Those Gurmukhs who sing in the Raga of Malaar - their minds and bodies become cool and calm.

1285.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
1285.t: gur sabadhee ek pachhaaniaa eko sachaa soi ||
1285.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they realize the One, the One True Lord.

1285.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
1285.t: man tan sachaa sach man sache sachee soi ||
1285.e: Their minds and bodies are true; they obey the True Lord, and they are known as true.

1285.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
1285.t: a(n)dhar sachee bhagat hai sahaje hee pat hoi ||
1285.e: True devotional worship is deep within them; they are automatically blessed with honor.

1285.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
1285.t: kalijug meh ghor a(n)dhaar hai manmukh raahu na koi ||
1285.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there is utter darkness; the self-willed manmukh cannot find the way.

1285.g: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
1285.t: se vaddabhaagee naanakaa jin gurmukh paragaT hoi ||1||
1285.e: O Nanak, very blessed are those Gurmukhs, unto whom the Lord is revealed. ||1||

1285.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
1285.e: Third Mehla:

1285.g: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
1285.t: ei(n)dh varasai kar dhiaa lokaa(n) man upajai chaau ||
1285.e: The clouds rain down mercifully, and joy wells up in the minds of the people.

1285.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਂਉ ॥
1285.t: jis kai hukam i(n)dh varasadhaa tis kai sadh balihaarai jaa(n)au ||
1285.e: I am forever a sacrifice to the One, by whose Command the clouds burst forth with rain.

1286.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
1286.t: gurmukh sabadh sam(h)aaleeaai sache ke gun gaau ||
1286.e: The Gurmukhs dwell on the Word of the Shabad. They sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

1286.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
1286.t: naanak naam rate jan niramale sahaje sach samaau ||2||
1286.e: O Nanak, those humble beings who are imbued with the Naam are pure and immaculate. They are intuitively merged in the True Lord. ||2||

1286.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1286.t: pauRee ||
1286.e: Pauree:

1286.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
1286.t: pooraa satigur sev pooraa paiaa ||
1286.e: Serving the Perfect True Guru, I have found the Perfect Lord.

1286.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
1286.t: poorai karam dhiaai pooraa sabadh ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
1286.e: Meditating on the Perfect Lord, by perfect karma, I have enshrined the Shabad within my mind.

1286.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
1286.t: poorai giaan dhiaan mail chukaiaa ||
1286.e: Through perfect spiritual wisdom and meditation, my filth has been washed away.

1286.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
1286.t: har sar teerath jaan manooaa naiaa ||
1286.e: The Lord is my sacred shrine of pilgrimage and pool of purification; I wash my mind in Him.

1286.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
1286.t: sabadh marai man maar dha(n)n janedhee maiaa ||
1286.e: One who dies in the Shabad and conquers his mind - blessed is the mother who gave birth to him.

1286.g: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
1286.t: dhar sachai sachiaar sachaa aaiaa ||
1286.e: He is true in the Court of the Lord, and his coming into this world is judged to be true.

1286.g: ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ਜਾਂ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
1286.t: puchh na sakai koi jaa(n) khasamai bhaiaa ||
1286.e: No one can challenge that person, with whom our Lord and Master is pleased.

1286.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
1286.t: naanak sach salaeh likhiaa paiaa ||18||
1286.e: O Nanak, praising the True Lord, his pre-ordained destiny is activated. ||18||

1286.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1286.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1286.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1286.g: ਕੁਲਹਾਂ ਦੇਂਦੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਵਡੇ ਨਿਲਜ ॥
1286.t: kulahaa(n) dhe(n)dhe baavale lai(n)dhe vadde nilaj ||
1286.e: Those who give out ceremonial hats of recognition are fools; those who receive them have no shame.

1286.g: ਚੂਹਾ ਖਡ ਨ ਮਾਵਈ ਤਿਕਲਿ ਬੰਨੑੈ ਛਜ ॥
1286.t: choohaa khadd na maaviee tikal ba(n)n(h)ai chhaj ||
1286.e: The mouse cannot enter its hole with a basket tied around its waist.

1286.g: ਦੇਨਿੑ ਦੁਆਈ ਸੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਨਿ ਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
1286.t: dheni(h) dhuaaiee se mareh jin kau dhen s jaeh ||
1286.e: Those who give out blessings shall die, and those that they bless shall also depart.

1286.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
1286.t: naanak hukam na jaapiee kithai jai samaeh ||
1286.e: O Nanak, no one knows the Lord's Command, by which all must depart.

1286.g: ਫਸਲਿ ਅਹਾੜੀ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
1286.t: fasal ahaaRee ek naam saavanee sach naau ||
1286.e: The spring harvest is the Name of the One Lord; the harvest of autumn is the True Name.

1286.g: ਮੈ ਮਹਦੂਦੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
1286.t: mai mahadhoodh likhaiaa khasamai kai dhar jai ||
1286.e: I receive a letter of pardon from my Lord and Master, when I reach His Court.

1286.g: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੇ ਦਰ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
1286.t: dhuneeaa ke dhar ketaRe kete aaveh jaa(n)h ||
1286.e: There are so many courts of the world, and so many who come and go there.

1286.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
1286.t: kete ma(n)geh ma(n)gate kete ma(n)g ma(n)g jaeh ||1||
1286.e: There are so many beggars begging; so many beg and beg until death. ||1||

1286.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1286.e: First Mehla:

1286.g: ਸਉ ਮਣੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਘਿਉ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਪੰਜਿ ਸੈ ਦਾਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
1286.t: sau man hasatee ghiau guR khaavai pa(n)j sai dhaanaa khai ||
1286.e: The elephant eats a hundred pounds of ghee and molasses, and five hundred pounds of corn.

1286.g: ਡਕੈ ਫੂਕੈ ਖੇਹ ਉਡਾਵੈ ਸਾਹਿ ਗਇਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
1286.t: ddakai fookai kheh uddaavai saeh giaai pachhutai ||
1286.e: He belches and grunts and scatters dust, and when the breath leaves his body, he regrets it.

1286.g: ਅੰਧੀ ਫੂਕਿ ਮੁਈ ਦੇਵਾਨੀ ॥
1286.t: a(n)dhee fook muiee dhevaanee ||
1286.e: The blind and arrogant die insane.

1286.g: ਖਸਮਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥
1286.t: khasam miTee fir bhaanee ||
1286.e: Submitting to the Lord, one become pleasing to Him.

1286.g: ਅਧੁ ਗੁਲ੍ਹਾ ਚਿੜੀ ਕਾ ਚੁਗਣੁ ਗੈਣਿ ਚੜੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
1286.t: adh gulhaa chiRee kaa chugan gain chaRee bilalai ||
1286.e: The sparrow eats only half a grain, then it flies through the sky and chirps.

1286.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਓਹਾ ਚੰਗੀ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
1286.t: khasamai bhaavai ohaa cha(n)gee j kare khudhai khudhai ||
1286.e: The good sparrow is pleasing to her Lord and Master, if she chirps the Name of the Lord.

1286.g: ਸਕਤਾ ਸੀਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੈ ਮਿਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਪਿਛੈ ਪੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
1286.t: sakataa seeh maare sai miriaa sabh pichhai pai khai ||
1286.e: The powerful tiger kills hundreds of deer, and all sorts of other animals eat what it leaves.

1286.g: ਹੋਇ ਸਤਾਣਾ ਘੁਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਵੈ ਸਾਹਿ ਗਇਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
1286.t: hoi sataanaa ghurai na maavai saeh giaai pachhutai ||
1286.e: It becomes very strong, and cannot be contained in its den, but when it must go, it regrets.

1286.g: ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਬੁਕਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
1286.t: a(n)dhaa kis no buk sunaavai ||
1286.e: So who is impressed by the roar of the blind beast?

1286.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1286.t: khasamai mool na bhaavai ||
1286.e: He is not pleasing at all to his Lord and Master.

1286.g: ਅਕ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਕ ਤਿਡਾ ਅਕ ਡਾਲੀ ਬਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
1286.t: ak siau preet kare ak tiddaa ak ddaalee beh khai ||
1286.e: The insect loves the milkweed plant; perched on its branch, it eats it.

1286.g: ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਓਹੋ ਚੰਗਾ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
1286.t: khasamai bhaavai oho cha(n)gaa j kare khudhai khudhai ||
1286.e: It becomes good and pleasing to its Lord and Master, if it chirps the Name of the Lord.

1286.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਕੀਤੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
1286.t: naanak dhuneeaa chaar dhihaaRe sukh keetai dhukh hoiee ||
1286.e: O Nanak, the world lasts for only a few days; indulging in pleasures, pain is produced.

1286.g: ਗਲਾ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੈਨਿ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਛਡਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
1286.t: galaa vaale hain ghanere chhadd na sakai koiee ||
1286.e: There are many who boast and brag, but none of them can remain detached from the world.

1286.g: ਮਖਂੀ ਮਿਠੈ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
1286.t: makha(n)ee miThai maranaa ||
1286.e: The fly dies for the sake of sweets.

1286.g: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਰਖਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
1286.t: jin too rakheh tin neR na aavai tin bhau saagar taranaa ||2||
1286.e: O Lord, death does not even approach those whom You protect. You carry them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

1286.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1286.t: pauRee ||
1286.e: Pauree:

1286.g: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
1286.t: agam agochar too dhanee sachaa alakh apaar ||
1286.e: You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable, O Invisible and Infinite True Lord Master.

1286.g: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਇਕੋ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
1286.t: too dhaataa sabh ma(n)gate iko dhevanahaar ||
1286.e: You are the Giver, all are beggars of You. You alone are the Great Giver.

1286.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1286.t: jinee seviaa tinee sukh paiaa gurmatee veechaar ||
1286.e: Those who serve You find peace, reflecting on the Guru's Teachings.

1286.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1286.t: eikanaa no tudh evai bhaavadhaa maiaa naal piaar ||
1286.e: Some, according to Your Will, are in love with Maya.

1286.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1286.t: gur kai sabadh salaaheeaai a(n)tar prem piaar ||
1286.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, praise the Lord with love and affection within.

1286.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1286.t: vin preetee bhagat na hoviee vin satigur na lagai piaar ||
1286.e: Without love, there is no devotion. Without the True Guru, love is not enshrined.

1286.g: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਇਕ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
1286.t: too prabh sabh tudh sevadhe ik ddaaddee kare pukaar ||
1286.e: You are the Lord God; everyone serves You. This is the prayer of Your humble minstrel.

1286.g: ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧੯॥
1286.t: dheh dhaan sa(n)tokheeaa sachaa naam milai aadhaar ||19||
1286.e: Please bless me with the gift of contentment, that I may receive the True Name as my Support. ||19||

1287.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1287.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1287.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1287.g: ਰਾਤੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
1287.t: raatee kaal ghaTai dhin kaal ||
1287.e: Through the night the time ticks away; through the day the time ticks away.

1287.g: ਛਿਜੈ ਕਾਇਆ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਲੁ ॥
1287.t: chhijai kaiaa hoi paraal ||
1287.e: The body wears away and turns to straw.

1287.g: ਵਰਤਣਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
1287.t: varatan varatiaa sarab ja(n)jaal ||
1287.e: All are involved and entangled in worldly entanglements.

1287.g: ਭੁਲਿਆ ਚੁਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਤਪ ਤਾਲੁ ॥
1287.t: bhuliaa chuk giaa tap taal ||
1287.e: The mortal has mistakenly renounced the way of service.

1287.g: ਅੰਧਾ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਪਇਆ ਝੇਰਿ ॥
1287.t: a(n)dhaa jhakh jhakh piaa jher ||
1287.e: The blind fool is caught in conflict, bothered and bewildered.

1287.g: ਪਿਛੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਲਿਆਵਹਿ ਫੇਰਿ ॥
1287.t: pichhai roveh liaaveh fer ||
1287.e: Those who weep after someone has died - can they bring him back to life?

1287.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
1287.t: bin boojhe kichh soojhai naahee ||
1287.e: Without realization, nothing can be understood.

1287.g: ਮੋਇਆ ਰੋਂਹਿ ਰੋਂਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਂੀ ॥
1287.t: moiaa ro(n)h ro(n)dhe mar jaa(n)ha(n)ee ||
1287.e: The weepers who weep for the dead shall themselves die as well.

1287.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
1287.t: naanak khasamai evai bhaavai ||
1287.e: O Nanak, this is the Will of our Lord and Master.

1287.g: ਸੇਈ ਮੁਏ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
1287.t: seiee mue jin chit na aavai ||1||
1287.e: Those who do not remember the Lord, are dead. ||1||

1287.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1287.e: First Mehla:

1287.g: ਮੁਆ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੁਈ ਮੁਆ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਾਦੀ ॥
1287.t: muaa piaar preet muiee muaa vair vaadhee ||
1287.e: Love dies, and affection dies; hatred and strife die.

1287.g: ਵੰਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਰੂਪੁ ਵਿਣਸਿਆ ਦੁਖੀ ਦੇਹ ਰੁਲੀ ॥
1287.t: va(n)n giaa roop vinasiaa dhukhee dheh rulee ||
1287.e: The color fades, and beauty vanishes; the body suffers and collapses.

1287.g: ਕਿਥਹੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਹ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਸੀਓ ਕਿਹੁ ਸੀ ॥
1287.t: kithahu aaiaa keh giaa kih na seeo kih see ||
1287.e: Where did he come from? Where is he going? Did he exist or not?

1287.g: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਲਾ ਗੋਈਆ ਕੀਤਾ ਚਾਉ ਰਲੀ ॥
1287.t: man mukh galaa goieeaa keetaa chaau ralee ||
1287.e: The self-willed manmukh made empty boasts, indulging in parties and pleasures.

1287.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਖੁਰ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਟੀ ॥੨॥
1287.t: naanak sache naam bin sir khur pat paaTee ||2||
1287.e: O Nanak, without the True Name, his honor is torn away, from head to foot. ||2||

1287.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1287.t: pauRee ||
1287.e: Pauree:

1287.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
1287.t: a(n)mirat naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa a(n)te hoi sakhaiee ||
1287.e: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever the Giver of peace. It shall be your Help and Support in the end.

1287.g: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
1287.t: baajh guroo jagat bauraanaa naavai saar na paiee ||
1287.e: Without the Guru, the world is insane. It does not appreciate the worth of the Name.

1287.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
1287.t: satigur seveh se paravaan jin(h) jotee jot milaiee ||
1287.e: Those who serve the True Guru are accepted and approved. Their light merges into the Light.

1287.g: ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
1287.t: so saahib so sevak tehaa jis bhaanaa ma(n)n vasaiee ||
1287.e: That servant who enshrines the Lord's Will within his mind, becomes just like his Lord and Master.

1287.g: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
1287.t: aapanai bhaanai kahu kin sukh paiaa a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaiee ||
1287.e: Tell me, who has ever found peace by following his own will? The blind act in blindness.

1287.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਹੀ ਰਜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
1287.t: bikhiaa kadhe hee rajai naahee moorakh bhukh na jaiee ||
1287.e: No one is ever satisfied and fulfilled by evil and corruption. The hunger of the fool is not satisfied.

1287.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਗਿ ਵਿਗੁਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
1287.t: dhoojai sabh ko lag vigutaa bin satigur boojh na paiee ||
1287.e: Attached to duality, all are ruined; without the True Guru, there is no understanding.

1287.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
1287.t: satigur seve so sukh paae jis no kirapaa kare rajaiee ||20||
1287.e: Those who serve the True Guru find peace; they are blessed with Grace by the Will of the Lord. ||20||

1287.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1287.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1287.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1287.g: ਸਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੇ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
1287.t: saram dharam dhui naanakaa je dhan palai pai ||
1287.e: Modesty and righteousness both, O Nanak, are qualities of those who are blessed with true wealth.

1287.g: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਚੋਟਾਂ ਖਾਇ ॥
1287.t: so dhan mitr na kaa(n)ddeeaai jit sir choTaa(n) khai ||
1287.e: Do not refer to that wealth as your friend, which leads you to get your head beaten.

1287.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਲੈ ਧਨੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਫਕੀਰ ॥
1287.t: jin kai palai dhan vasai tin kaa naau fakeer ||
1287.e: Those who possess only this worldly wealth are known as paupers.

1287.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੧॥
1287.t: jin(h) kai hiradhai too vaseh te nar gunee gaheer ||1||
1287.e: But those, within whose hearts You dwell, O Lord - those people are oceans of virtue. ||1||

1287.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1287.e: First Mehla:

1287.g: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਹੇੜੀਐ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਲਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
1287.t: dhukhee dhunee saheReeaai jai ta lageh dhukh ||
1287.e: Worldly possessions are obtained by pain and suffering; when they are gone, they leave pain and suffering.

1287.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
1287.t: naanak sache naam bin kisai na lathee bhukh ||
1287.e: O Nanak, without the True Name, hunger is never satisfied.

1287.g: ਰੂਪੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਾਂ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਾਂ ਭੁਖ ॥
1287.t: roopee bhukh na utarai jaa(n) dhekhaa(n) taa(n) bhukh ||
1287.e: Beauty does not satisfy hunger; when the man sees beauty, he hungers even more.

1287.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਰਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਕੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਲਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥੨॥
1287.t: jete ras sareer ke tete lageh dhukh ||2||
1287.e: As many as are the pleasures of the body, so many are the pains which afflict it. ||2||

1287.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1287.e: First Mehla:

1287.g: ਅੰਧੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
1287.t: a(n)dhee ka(n)mee a(n)dh man man a(n)dhai tan a(n)dh ||
1287.e: Acting blindly, the mind becomes blind. The blind mind makes the body blind.

1287.g: ਚਿਕੜਿ ਲਾਇਐ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਥਰ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
1287.t: chikaR laiaai kiaa theeaai jaa(n) tuTai pathar ba(n)dh ||
1287.e: Why make a dam with mud and plaster? Even a dam made of stones gives way.

1287.g: ਬੰਧੁ ਤੁਟਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਨਾ ਹਾਥ ॥
1287.t: ba(n)dh tuTaa beRee nahee naa tulahaa naa haath ||
1287.e: The dam has burst. There is no boat. There is no raft. The water's depth is unfathomable.

1287.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਕੇਤੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਸਾਥ ॥੩॥
1287.t: naanak sache naam vin kete ddube saath ||3||
1287.e: O Nanak, without the True Name, many multitudes have drowned. ||3||

1287.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1287.e: First Mehla:

1287.g: ਲਖ ਮਣ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਲਖ ਮਣ ਰੁਪਾ ਲਖ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹ ॥
1287.t: lakh man suinaa lakh man rupaa lakh saahaa sir saeh ||
1287.e: Thousands of pounds of gold, and thousands of pounds of silver; the king over the heads of thousands of kings.

1287.g: ਲਖ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਵਾਜੇ ਨੇਜੇ ਲਖੀ ਘੋੜੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
1287.t: lakh lasakar lakh vaaje neje lakhee ghoRee paatisaeh ||
1287.e: Thousands of armies, thousands of marching bands and spearmen; the emperor of thousands of horsemen.

1287.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਲੰਘਣਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
1287.t: jithai sair la(n)ghanaa agan paanee asagaeh ||
1287.e: The unfathomable ocean of fire and water must be crossed.

1287.g: ਕੰਧੀ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਧਾਹੀ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਾਹ ॥
1287.t: ka(n)dhee dhis na aaviee dhaahee pavai kahaeh ||
1287.e: The other shore cannot be seen; only the roar of pitiful cries can be heard.

1287.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਸਾਹ ਕੇਈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥
1287.t: naanak othai jaane'eeh saeh keiee paatisaeh ||4||
1287.e: O Nanak, there, it shall be known, whether anyone is a king or an emperor. ||4||

1287.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1287.t: pauRee ||
1287.e: Pauree:

1287.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਗਲੀਂ ਜੰਜੀਰ ਬੰਦਿ ਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
1287.t: eikanaa galee(n) ja(n)jeer ba(n)dh rabaaneeaai ||
1287.e: Some have chains around their necks, in bondage to the Lord.

1287.g: ਬਧੇ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥
1287.t: badhe chhuTeh sach sach pachhaaneeaai ||
1287.e: They are released from bondage, realizing the True Lord as True.

1288.g: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
1288.t: likhiaa palai pai so sach jaaneeaai ||
1288.e: One whose pre-ordained destiny is activated, comes to know the True Lord.

1288.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
1288.t: hukamee hoi nibeR giaa jaaneeaai ||
1288.e: By God's Command, it is ordained. When the mortal goes, he knows.

1288.g: ਭਉਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥
1288.t: bhaujal taaranahaar sabadh pachhaaneeaai ||
1288.e: Realize the Word of the Shabad, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

1288.g: ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਜੂਆਰ ਪੀੜੇ ਘਾਣੀਐ ॥
1288.t: chor jaar jooaar peeRe ghaaneeaai ||
1288.e: Thieves, adulterers and gamblers are pressed like seeds in the mill.

1288.g: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹੜੑਵਾਣੀਐ ॥
1288.t: ni(n)dhak laitabaar mile haR(h)vaaneeaai ||
1288.e: Slanderers and gossipers are hand-cuffed.

1288.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥੨੧॥
1288.t: gurmukh sach samai su dharageh jaaneeaai ||21||
1288.e: The Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord, and is famous in the Court of the Lord. ||21||

1288.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
1288.t: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
1288.e: Shalok, Second Mehla:

1288.g: ਨਾਉ ਫਕੀਰੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
1288.t: naau fakeerai paatisaahu moorakh pa(n)ddit naau ||
1288.e: The beggar is known as an emperor, and the fool is known as a religious scholar.

1288.g: ਅੰਧੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਏਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਆਉ ॥
1288.t: a(n)dhe kaa naau paarakhoo evai kare guaau ||
1288.e: The blind man is known as a seer; this is how people talk.

1288.g: ਇਲਤਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
1288.t: eilat kaa naau chaudharee kooRee poore thaau ||
1288.e: The trouble-maker is called a leader, and the liar is seated with honor.

1288.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕਲਿ ਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੧॥
1288.t: naanak gurmukh jaaneeaai kal kaa eh niaau ||1||
1288.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs know that this is justice in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||

1288.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1288.e: First Mehla:

1288.g: ਹਰਣਾਂ ਬਾਜਾਂ ਤੈ ਸਿਕਦਾਰਾਂ ਏਨੑਾ ਪੜਿੑਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
1288.t: haranaa(n) baajaa(n) tai sikadhaaraa(n) en(h)aa paRi(h)aa naau ||
1288.e: Deer, falcons and government officials are known to be trained and clever.

1288.g: ਫਾਂਧੀ ਲਗੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਫਹਾਇਨਿ ਅਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
1288.t: faa(n)dhee lagee jaat fahain agai naahee thaau ||
1288.e: When the trap is set, they trap their own kind; hereafter they will find no place of rest.

1288.g: ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
1288.t: so paRiaa so pa(n)ddit beenaa jin(h)ee kamaanaa naau ||
1288.e: He alone is learned and wise, and he alone is a scholar, who practices the Name.

1288.g: ਪਹਿਲੋ ਦੇ ਜੜ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਤਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਛਾਂਉ ॥
1288.t: pahilo dhe jaR a(n)dhar ja(n)mai taa upar hovai chhaa(n)au ||
1288.e: First, the tree puts down its roots, and then it spreads out its shade above.

1288.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਸੀਹ ਮੁਕਦਮ ਕੁਤੇ ॥
1288.t: raaje seeh mukadham kute ||
1288.e: The kings are tigers, and their officials are dogs;

1288.g: ਜਾਇ ਜਗਾਇਨਿੑ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
1288.t: jai jagaini(h) baiThe sute ||
1288.e: they go out and awaken the sleeping people to harass them.

1288.g: ਚਾਕਰ ਨਹਦਾ ਪਾਇਨਿੑ ਘਾਉ ॥
1288.t: chaakar nahadhaa paini(h) ghaau ||
1288.e: The public servants inflict wounds with their nails.

1288.g: ਰਤੁ ਪਿਤੁ ਕੁਤਿਹੋ ਚਟਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
1288.t: rat pit kutiho chaT jaahu ||
1288.e: The dogs lick up the blood that is spilled.

1288.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਜੀਆਂ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
1288.t: jithai jeeaa(n) hosee saar ||
1288.e: But there, in the Court of the Lord, all beings will be judged.

1288.g: ਨਕਂੀ ਵਢਂੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰ ॥੨॥
1288.t: naka(n)ee vadda(n)ee laitabaar ||2||
1288.e: Those who have violated the people's trust will be disgraced; their noses will be cut off. ||2||

1288.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1288.t: pauRee ||
1288.e: Pauree:

1288.g: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
1288.t: aap upaae medhanee aape karadhaa saar ||
1288.e: He Himself creates the world, and He himself takes care of it.

1288.g: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
1288.t: bhai bin bharam na kaTeeaai naam na lagai piaar ||
1288.e: Without the Fear of God, doubt is not dispelled, and love for the Name is not embraced.

1288.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
1288.t: satigur te bhau uoopajai paieeaai mokh dhuaar ||
1288.e: Through the True Guru, the Fear of God wells up, and the Door of Salvation is found.

1288.g: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
1288.t: bhai te sahaj paieeaai mil jotee jot apaar ||
1288.e: Through the Fear of God, intuitive ease is obtained, and one's light merges into the Light of the Infinite.

1288.g: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਭੈਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1288.t: bhai te bhaijal la(n)gheeaai gurmatee veechaar ||
1288.e: Through the Fear of God, the terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, reflecting on the Guru's Teachings.

1288.g: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
1288.t: bhai te nirabhau paieeaai jis dhaa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
1288.e: Through the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord is found; He has no end or limitation.

1288.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
1288.t: manmukh bhai kee saar na jaananee tirasanaa jalate kareh pukaar ||
1288.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not appreciate the value of the Fear of God. Burning in desire, they weep and wail.

1288.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰ ॥੨੨॥
1288.t: naanak naavai hee te sukh paiaa gurmatee ur dhaar ||22||
1288.e: O Nanak, through the Name, peace is obtained, by enshrining the Guru's Teachings within the heart. ||22||

1288.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1288.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1288.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1288.g: ਰੂਪੈ ਕਾਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਭੁਖੈ ਸਾਦੈ ਗੰਢੁ ॥
1288.t: roopai kaamai dhosatee bhukhai saadhai ga(n)dd ||
1288.e: Beauty and sexual desire are friends; hunger and tasty food are tied together.

1288.g: ਲਬੈ ਮਾਲੈ ਘੁਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਚਲਿ ਊਂਘੈ ਸਉੜਿ ਪਲੰਘੁ ॥
1288.t: labai maalai ghul mil michal uoo(n)ghai sauR pala(n)gh ||
1288.e: Greed is bound up in its search for wealth, and sleep will use even a tiny space as a bed.

1288.g: ਭੰਉਕੈ ਕੋਪੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਫਕੜੁ ਪਿਟੇ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
1288.t: bha(n)aukai kop khuaar hoi fakaR piTe a(n)dh ||
1288.e: Anger barks and brings ruin on itself, blindly pursuing useless conflicts.

1288.g: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਗੰਧੁ ॥੧॥
1288.t: chupai cha(n)gaa naanakaa vin naavai muh ga(n)dh ||1||
1288.e: It is good to be silent, O Nanak; without the Name, one's mouth spews forth only filth. ||1||

1288.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
1288.e: First Mehla:

1288.g: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਪੰਜੇ ਠਗ ॥
1288.t: raaj maal roop jaat joban pa(n)je Thag ||
1288.e: Royal power, wealth, beauty, social status and youth are the five thieves.

1288.g: ਏਨੀ ਠਗੀਂ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਰਖੀ ਲਜ ॥
1288.t: enee Thagee(n) jag Thagiaa kinai na rakhee laj ||
1288.e: These thieves have plundered the world; no one's honor has been spared.

1288.g: ਏਨਾ ਠਗਨਿੑ ਠਗ ਸੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
1288.t: enaa Thagani(h) Thag se j gur kee pairee paeh ||
1288.e: But these thieves themselves are robbed, by those who fall at the Guru's Feet.

1288.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
1288.t: naanak karamaa baahare hor kete muThe jaeh ||2||
1288.e: O Nanak, the multitudes who do not have good karma are plundered. ||2||

1288.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
1288.t: pauRee ||
1288.e: Pauree:

1288.g: ਪੜਿਆ ਲੇਖੇਦਾਰੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ॥
1288.t: paRiaa lekhedhaar lekhaa ma(n)geeaai ||
1288.e: The learned and educated are called to account for their actions.

1288.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਤੰਗੀਐ ॥
1288.t: vin naavai kooRiaar aaukhaa ta(n)geeaai ||
1288.e: Without the Name, they are judged false; they become miserable and suffer hardship.

1288.g: ਅਉਘਟ ਰੁਧੇ ਰਾਹ ਗਲੀਆਂ ਰੋਕੀਆਂ ॥
1288.t: aaughaT rudhe raeh galeeaa(n) rokeeaa(n) ||
1288.e: Their path becomes treacherous and difficult, and their way is blocked.

1288.g: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ॥
1288.t: sachaa veparavaahu sabadh sa(n)tokheeaa(n) ||
1288.e: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True and Independent Lord God, one becomes content.

1288.g: ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ॥
1288.t: gahir gabheer athaahu haath na labhiee ||
1288.e: The Lord is deep and profound and unfathomable; His depth cannot be measured.

1288.g: ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਛੁਟਸੀ ॥
1288.t: muhe muh choTaa khaahu vin gur koi na chhuTasee ||
1288.e: Without the Guru, the mortals are beaten and punched in the face and the mouth, and no one is released.

1288.g: ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
1288.t: pat setee ghar jaahu naam vakhaaneeaai ||
1288.e: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one returns to his true home with honor.

1288.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਹ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥੨੩॥
1288.t: hukamee saeh giraeh dhe(n)dhaa jaaneeaai ||23||
1288.e: Know that the Lord, by the Hukam of His Command, gives sustenance and the breath of life. ||23||

1289.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
1289.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
1289.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

1289.g: ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਆ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਪੀੜ ॥
1289.t: paunai paanee aganee jeeau tin kiaa khuseeaa kiaa peeR ||
1289.e: Living beings are formed of air, water and fire. They are subject to pleasure and pain.

1289.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਵਜੀਰ ॥
1289.t: dharatee paataalee aakaasee ik dhar rahan vajeer ||
1289.e: In this world, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in the Akaashic ethers of the heavens, some remain ministers in the Court of the Lord.

1289.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਇਕਿ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਹੀਰ ॥
1289.t: eikanaa vaddee aarajaa ik mar hoh jaheer ||
1289.e: Some live long lives, while others suffer and die.

1289.g: ਇਕਿ ਦੇ ਖਾਹਿ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫਕੀਰ ॥
1289.t: eik dhe khaeh nikhuTai naahee ik sadhaa fireh fakeer ||
1289.e: Some give and consume, and still their wealth is not exhausted, while others remain poor forever.

1289.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਢਾਹੇ ਏਕ ਚਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਲਖ ॥
1289.t: hukamee saaje hukamee ddaahe ek chase meh lakh ||
